tei:div.tei:p: bka' brgyud bstan srung rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las kyitsho cho ga dzeni gnyis lhun grub/༵༵༵ neshā1 lnga〉kyi/spu 'i ri / 111 5 1 1/1121 lnga〉 8 111 ri'i(31 0111 111 / d+ngha/5 571 0khyi(32 d+ngha/(/(311 211〉1 ri /khrikyi/11
sgo rjo———————— tor gyi brgyud 'debs bzhung—— — do

—༄gyi/ /gso pa ba 'debs/ /gnam/ /sdugs me 'bar dharma rā dza dang / /bkra shis ngu/na tshogs dkon mamig ratsware zhabadrushā/ skore gami bi ja ya/ /'phrin las bzang po don kun grub pa'i sde / /bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul zhabs la gso /3debaṅge/ /dpal /ldan mgar chen rje bcun sat+ya'i mchan// /ji/d+ma'i rgyal ra/chan mthu stobs 'od zer zhabs// /rnga'adzin byang chub dharma ta ma ṇi/ /thugs rje ni ma gu ṇa (de shwa ra / /nus lda na rdo rje'i /zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

kyi blo gros rgyal sras zhi ba'i mchan/ /bde chen rdo rje rgod phu sgrub brgyud pa/ /dngos grub kun snyesprubyung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /rim byon brgyud pa/ra bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde stong gnyis med ldan skyes drwa ba sdom/ /ye shes mthu stobs kun 'dus nag po che/ /sprul pa'i rgyan gyur dkyil snyeselar lha tshogs dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol/ /da ma can rgya mtsho'i tshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas snyel/ /mos pas gdung ba'i nga ros bskul ba'i mthus/ /ye shes thugs rje'i mthu dpung drag tu bskyed/ /byin rlabs nus pa/'i sprin chen cher lda nga zhing / /don gnyis myur 'grub char rgyun tshil cidu gsol/ /las mnar nyis tshogs sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ /srid zhi phan bde'i

༄༅/ /legs tshogs yongs su rgyas/ /snang srid 'khor 'das rang snang dbyingasasu 'du/ /log 'dren thams cad gtan nas brlag byed pa'i/ /lasabazhi 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod nas/ /sadang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogasate/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob rbesgog/ // cesadapal ye shesamagon po phyag bzhi pa'i brgyud pa'i gsola'adebs 'di yang kho bos bgyi pa'igasol kha nyer bsdusagasang chen thugs dmanang gi gtor ma'i kha 'gengasasus skyong lo mdo khamasase ra lung du/ / lho rjedrung o rgyan nusaldan rdo rjes ra pyodage'o// //
༄7/ /dpal 'khar lo sdom pa'i las rim gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me bzhugs so/ /

༄tsho/ /dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogasabagyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par 3(ga /lan gsum dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bdeba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig lan

gsum dang / ko rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugasapa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shesapa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' sde/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ko nang mar byin rlabasani/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ :hā gh+rihā hūm̐ hūm̐ kla ṭa/ sgrihā pa ya lha: pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wa na/ bidu rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shukhro3lha/ stong pa

༄tsho/ /nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kai las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ulas thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub du e las byang sems e gyis ma tshan pa/ lhor traṃ las rak+ta traṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūṃ gis mtshan pa// shar lhor lo las ba glang gi sha yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu paṃ las khyi'i sha mo gyisamatshan pa/ nub byang du paṃ las glang po che'i sha paṃ gyis

mtshan pa/ byang shar du haṃ las rta'i sha haṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas nyi ma 'char ga'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ u dmar po/ oṃ dkar po gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu/ zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogasapar gyur/

༄༅/ /oṃ a'i hūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ mchad pa byin rlabasani/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ :hū :hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ :hā pa ya :hā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bidu rā dza ya hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shurnyo3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rka las byung ba'i mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ ulas byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ par dmigs oṃ badz+ra arnya gisahūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pubye āḥ: swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nguzhi gisahūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra —sgru paṃcachihūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a 'o1 ke asnyihūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra garnye asnyihūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra

ni wi traṃ u: swā hā/oṃ badz+ra shap+ta ulha swā hā/༈de nasalas gtor gsumal dmigasate/oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ sgrihā k+ṣihā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/〉hā pa ya snyiṇ+ḍa pa ya hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ ā na ya ho/bha ga wan/bir+ya rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba sto swa bha wa shudhe3nya/stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa rnams su gyur/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan tā ta oṃlo9hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gzugasamadzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs

no༅bya/ /pa sku 'byams klas la/ phyag 'chal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal 34/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ sa bdag sa'i lha mo bstan ma sa 'dzin lag pa chen po gnyis kyi gtso byas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug /srid pa chagasapa'i lha dgu /rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ mtsho ma pham/ gangs ti se/ rtswa ri rtsa gong / la phyi chu bar/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ rgya mche'i mtha' dbus/ ri rab kyi steng shod/ stong gsum 'dzam bu gling na gnas pa'i gnas

bdag gzhi bdag /dkar po'i chos la mngon par dga' ba rnams dang / khyad par du'ang chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po/ bar lha lha dang bcas pa/sog ra btsan dang bcas pa/ chu 'phen klu dang bcas pa/ gter sgrom sman dang bcas pa/ tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po/ sa ris sa skor/ yul ris yul skor/ sa phyogs 'di kun la gnasapa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar po'i chos la mngon par dga' ba rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhesanas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po mchod cing sgrub pa la ru nga dang phrag dog ma mdzad par/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig gnyan po bsrung / byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang lda na par gyur cig gzhi bdag lha klu rnams

༄༅/ /la 'dod yon tshogs/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lusapar/ /thogasapa med par 'byung gyur cig / / sa sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sgrihā sgrihā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ :hā pa ya 〉〉 pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bidu rā dza ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha rme shud+dhinyunya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ lasarin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba lasabyung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nusapa rnams su gyur/o.a kwa ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā khaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+ma twa ta oṃ u/ phaṭa swā hā/ bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin

gnyegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang skusnangs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo gi te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhesapa sa byin gyis brlabs la/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi na ya gas gtso byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga la sogs pa/ mi 'dod pa bskyed par byed pa/ dge ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod nga/ra byed pa'i gdon bgegs bye ba'i rigs/ gdug nga/ can sngags nyan par mi bzod cing / phyag rgya blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'dis tshim par gyis la/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'ibasam pa mtha'

༄༅/ /dag zhi nas/ phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dge ba'i sdong grogasamadzod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du dengs shig sarba bhu ta gats+tsha bgegs rigs lan chags rnams la 'dod yon tshogs/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur gcig / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ khrigra la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa

yin/ /bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyingasakyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig /skyabs chen dkon mchog bden pa dang / /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang / /lha dang snying po sngags dang ni/ /phyag rgya dam tshig bden pa yis/ /gnod cing bar du gcod pa yi/ /'byung po ma rung khyod la sogs/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab spangs nas/ /rdzogs pa'i

no༅༅/ /byang chub thob par hā|ga /ces chas bshad la zhi bsabaskrad/ desam song ba rnams la/ ko na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba da nga brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang /dpal 'khor lo sdom nga/ dang nag po chen po/ beng chen lcam dral/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang / gzungs sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rang bzhinarnam par dag cing rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ 'byung po gdug pa can gang yin pa/ bdag cag rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ chosasgrub

pa la bar du gcod pa 'di dag thams cad gnas 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig phaṭaḥ o sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ pha ṭa/ oṃ :hā :hū hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ :hū pa ya sgrihā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tso( ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bidu rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag sngagasathams cad bzlas la/ de nas 'di skad brjod par bya'o// ༈ tso/ phya9hūṃ/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab bsgom zhing / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed/ /gal te nga las 'gal 'dod na/ /de dag shes bya gzhan du min/ /oṃ āḥ//lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab bsgom zhing / /

༄༅/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed/ /gal te nga las 'gal 'dod na/ /de dag shes bya gzhan du min/ /oṃ u// lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab bsgom zhing / /ral gri 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed/ /gal te nga las 'gal 'dod na/ /de dag shes bya gzhan du min/ /oṃ 6〉lha/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab bsgom zhing / /pad+ma 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed/ /gal te nga las 'gal 'dod na/ /de dag shes bya gzhan du

min/ /oṃ u// lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab bsgom zhing / /rin chen 'bar ba'i lus kyisani/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed/ /gal te nga las 'gal 'dod na/ /de dag shesabya gzhan du min/ / ko ྅/ dkyil 'bar khang pa'i shar gyi sar gnas pa'i/ /dri za'igadon tshogs ma lusakun nyan cig /khwa gdong rab 'jigasakhro ma'igazugasakyisagang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnasasu dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas

༄༅/ /su dengs/ /hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor khang pa byang gi sar gnas pa'i/ /gnod sbyin gdon tshogasam lus kun nyon cig /lug gdong rab 'jigasakhro ma'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnasasu dengs/ /hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor khang pa nub kyi sar gnas pa'i/ /klu bdud gdon tshogasam lus kun nyen cig /khyi gdong rab 'jigs khro ma'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu

dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor khang pa lho'i sar gnas pa'i/ /grul bum gdon tshogs ma lus kun nyon cig /phag gdong rab 'jigs khro mo'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor khang pa shar lha'i sar gnas pa'i/ /me lha'i gdon tshogs ma lus kun nyon cig /gshin rje

༄༅/ /bstan ma khro ma'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor khang pa lto nub sar gnas pa'i/ /srin po'i gdon tshogs ma lus kun nyon cig /gzhin rje pho nya khro mo'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung

la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor khang pa nub byang sar gnas pa'i/ /rlung lha'i gdon tshogasam lus kun nyen cig /gshin rje mche ba khro ma'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi phyed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lusasrog nyamasapar gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor khang pa byang shar sar gnas pa'i/ /dbang ldan gdon tshogs ma lus kun nyen cig /gshin rje 'joms ma khro mo'i gzugs kyis gang / /thos pa tsam gyis rang rang gnas su dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro mnyam par 'dug gyur na/ /nga yi

༄༅/ /rab 'bar rdo rje phur bu dang / /mi byed rdo rje tho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs kyi lus srog nyams par gyur ta re/ /de bas rang rang rnams kyi srog bsrung la/ /myur ba nyid du rang rang gnas su dengs/ / / lha/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun/ /kun kyang badz+ra he ru ka /khro bor gyur bas nam mkha' gang / /khro mor gyur bas sa gzhi gang / /khro chung sprul pasabar snang gang / /khro bo khro mo dbyings su rol/ /byang chub sems kyis byin rlabs pas/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /brgya la srid kyang rdul du rlog /hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags

tshal kun/ /kun kyang rat+na he ru ka /khro bor gyur bas nam mkha' gang / /khro mor gyur bas sogazhi gang / /khro chung sprul pasabar snang gang / /khro bo khro mo dbyings su rol/ /byang chub sems kyis byin rlabs pas/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /brgya la srid kyang rdul du rlog /hūṃ/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /nub phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun/ /kun kyang pad+ma he ru ka /khro bor gyur bas nam mkha' gang / /khro mor gyur bas sa gzhi gang / /khro chung sprul pas bar snang gang /khro bo khro mo dbyingasasu rol/ /byang chub sems kyisabyin rlabs pas/ /mtshamasakyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /bgegs zhesabya ba'i ming yang med/ /brgya la

༄༅/ /srid kyang rdul du rlog /hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun/ /kun kyang game he ru ka //bro bor gyur bas nam mkha' gang / /khro mor gyur bas sa gzhi gang / /khro chung sprul pas bar snang gang / /khro bo khro mo dbyings su rol/ /byang chub sems kyis byin rlabs pas/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /bshegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /brgya la srid kyang rdul du rlog /hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /dbus phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun/ /kun kyang bud+dha he ru ka /khro bor gyur bas nam mkha' gang / /khro mor gyur bas sa gzhi gang / /khro chung sprul pas bar snang gang / /khro bo khro mo dbyings su rol/ /byang

bdubye —tshams kyis byin rlabs pas/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rgya la srid kyang rdul du rlog / / dzaḥ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can/ /lha mo'i lus la khā gdong ma/ /badz+ra rka ka zhesabya ba/ shinar sgo bsrung ba'i phra men ma/ /dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la babs/ /shar sgo bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /dzaX 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can/ /lha ma'i lus la lug gdong ma/ /badz+ra3mo'i zhes bya ba/ /byang sgo bsrung ba'i phra men ma/ /dzaḥ phra men rdo rje'i dus la babs/ /byang sgo bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can/ /lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma/ /badz+ra shwa na zhes bya ba/ /nub sgo bsrung ba'i phra men ma/ /dzaḥ phra men rdo rje'i dus la babs/ /nub sgo bsrung ba'i las

༄༅/ /mdzod cig /dzaḥ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can/ /lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma/ /badz+ra su ka zhes bya ba/ /lho sgo bsrung ba'i phra men ma/ /dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la babs/ /lho sgo bsrung ba'i lasamadzod cig /dzaḥsgo ma rnams kyis sgo bsrungs la/ /mtshams ma rnams kyisamatshams bsdoms shig /mtshams bcad gnas 'di'i tshun chad du/ /bgegs rnams ldang bar ma byed cig / / 'gro rnamasabasgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangasargyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang ldan pa'i/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyasamadun du gnasabacas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ / / rang gi spyi bor paṃ lasapad+ma dang /

aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim de yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ /gnyis ga'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabasakyis bzhengs pa'i zhabs mthil gnyis rang gi tshangs bug la gtad pa/ de'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ yig dngul chu'i kha dog can gyi tha mar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub semasadapa' thams cad la

༄༅/ /mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse dang nus mthu thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ he ru ga'i thugasaka'i sngagasa'aphreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pas/ hūm̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs sku gang / sbyor mtshams dang zhabs mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang / 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag lus sems la bde stong gi nyams myong khyad par can bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la bskyed par gyur/ / yo badz+ra he ru ka sam ya/ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tilga : lho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ a nu ralto me bha wa/ su pastso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyizle pra ya rtso sarba rkarma su

ca me tsirta shri yeḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me mulga he ru ko3 bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa akli phaṭa/ cesanyer snyag brjod/bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabasamadzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs/ /he ru ga'i zhal nas khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go zhes gsung zhing / he ru ka rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi lus shel gong bzhin du dag cing / ltar gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin lasa'od 'phros lus gang / 'od zer phyir 'phros pas chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis

༄༅/ /mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar til gyi gang bu lta bur gang ba bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chagasapa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lwa ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud/ /yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab/ /bkra shis sna tshogs 'o ma'i chu rgyun 'di/ /rgyal ba'i zhal la zhal bsil 'di phul bas/ /'gro kun bkra shis phun sum tshogs par rbe|ga /

spos dang tsan+dan la sogs sbyar ba yi/ /lasakun byed pa'i chu gtsang dwangasam 'di/ /rgyal ba'i zhabs la zhabs bsil 'di phul bas/ /'gro kun blo bur dri ma dag gyur cig /chu dang thang skyes yid las byung ba yi/ /byang chub yan lag mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ /sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul/ /'gro kun 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /lhan cig skyesadang yongs su sbyar ba yi/ /rab tu tshims ldan bdug sposadam pa 'di/ /tshul khrims rang bzhin rgyal ba'i shangs la 'bul/ /'gro kun dal 'byor yon tan rdzogs par shog /gsal zhing mi g.yo mdzes par snang ba yi/ /mi shes mun gsal dpal gyi sgron me 'di/ /bzod pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul/ /'gro kun mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs par shog /

༄7/ /gur kum ga bur tsan+dan la sogasadri/ /rnam mang dri zhim bdug spos dam pa 'di/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul /'gro kun yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i zhal zas mchog /phun tshogs yon tan 'byung ba bdud rtsi'i rigs/ /bsam gtan rang bzhin rgyal ba'i ljags la 'bul/ /'gro kun ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /yan lag lnga ldan sil snyan rol mo 'di/ /shesarab rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul/ /bsod myoms 'di yisazag med chos rnams kun/ /'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la 'char bar shog /dbang po tshims byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /phun sum tshogs pa dpal gyi longs spyod rnams/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba rnams la 'bul/ /'gro kun

zag med phung po lnga thob shog /zhing skyes sngags skyes rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /yid las byung ba sprul pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /stobs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gzugs la 'bul/ /'gro ba kun gyi bde mchog thob par shog /rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus dge ba'i tshogs/ /dang ba'i yid kyis gus shing gsol ba 'di/ /smon lam rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas yon tan thob par shog /zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa las/ /yang dag par ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i don/ /ye shes rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul/ /'gro ba kun gyis chos nyid rtogs par shog /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis/ /nyon mongs dbang gi kun nas blangs gyur pa'i/ /lus ngag yid kyis mi dge ci

༄༅/ /bgyisapa/ /dusagasum rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las rmad du byung ba dang / /rgyal dang rgyal srasarang rgyal dgra bcom dang / /so skye'i dge dang dge gzhan ci mchis pa/ /ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rang / /'gro kun smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems la/ /zab cing rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rgyun mi 'chad pa bskor bar bskul ma 'debs/ /semasacan ji srid gnasakyi bar du ni/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs nasakyang / /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad par/ /thal sbyar gusapa'i mchog gis gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /log pa'i bas ma pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing / /nyon mongs rnam rtog

tshogs rnams zhi nas kyang / /dkar pa'i yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /bla mar bsnyen cing dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /mos gus ltem kyang nam yang mi 'byung zhing / /theg mchog lam gyi sgrub pa byed pa la/ /skad cig tsam yang le lo med par sgo ga /bsdu ba bzhi dang zhi sogs la rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par byed pa dang / /sems can kun gyi bsam pa'i don rnamasakun/ /de dag ma lus bdag gis 'grub par shog /'gro ba'i don la g.yel ba med pa dang / /lus dang longs spyod dngosapo thams cad la/ /'dzin chags ser sna nam yang mi 'byung zhing / /zad mi shesapa kun la gtong bar shog /dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /sdig dang sgrib pa'i tshogasarnams byang gyur te/ /bsam pa'i don

༄༅/ /kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro kun bla med byang chub myur thob shog /tshogasazhing rnams 'od du zhu nasarang lathim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cigasems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyisadang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnasapar gyur cig chosathams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med cing kun rdzob btags pa tsam gyi sgyu ma lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shurnyo3nya/ thugs ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te/ 'od du zhu ba rang la

thim zhing / rang gi lus kyang stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig lū ha la/ ha mgo bo la mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la thig le nā da la/ nā da shin tu phra ba'ang mi dmigs par gyur/ / e shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3nya/ chosathams cad rab tu gnas pa med pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa lta bu'i 'od gsal du gyur/ /de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus te/ stong pa nyid las langs nas rang gi rlung sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du bsgreng ba shin tu phra ba/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang /raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ dra ba/ gur bla

༄༅/ /re/ mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo chen po gyur/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung / re las me lo las chu/ yaṃ las sa/ sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba ge sar dang ldan pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i sī/ u lū ṛ dṛ/ '-i lī/ e i/ o skyes ༷ e yis dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang / slar yang a ā/ i yī/ u lū/ ṛ dṛ/ '-i lī/ e e/ ochusaḥ e āḥ dbyangs dkar po bcudrug pa phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khor/ de'i phyi rol

du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dhe ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa dhe da dha ya la dang bcas te gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang / slar yang ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dhe ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa saha k+ṣaḥ ḍa dhe da dha ya la dang bcas te gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khor/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la/ dbyangs gsal rnams gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang / zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar

༄༅/ /ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can mthong ba na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbus su skye ba blangs la/ sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las/ thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ /de las ha'i lus/ de las lū grub pa'i tshur gyis dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa hūm̐ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ yig de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams he ru ga'i go 'phang la bkod/ bsdus pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad he ru ka yab yum lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/

snyoms par zhugs pas sngon du 'gro ba zhu bas/ hūm̐ yig nā da la thim zhing / hūm̐ yig lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ zla ba dbyangs gsal sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ / / de yang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yasakhang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsigs pa rim pa lngas bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba'i rtsigs pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo du masamachod rdzas thogs nasabaskor ba sgo bzhi soso'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis nye bar btegs

༄༅/ /pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gibatamadzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de na gnas pa'i phyogasaskyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ lha brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ me brgyad/ chu brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre srin po/ sha za/ ro langs/ lce spyang la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbusasngo ba/ de lta bu'i gzhal ya sa khang gi dbus su sna tshogasapad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i

lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sto rang nyid bcom ldan 'dasadapal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yab yum/ yab sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba'i myu gu bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa dang bcas pas yum la 'khrud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan cing / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo brdzis pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang /g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon gyi cha la zla ba phyed pa bsil ba'i 'od dang ldan pas brgyan pa/ mtshog ma'i steng du rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod

༄༅/ /pas mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i thag pa la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga rin po che'i rtse phran gyis brgyan pa/ thod rlan lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ sum khugs su 'khyogs shing gyes la rnam par bkra ba'i dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ rus chen gyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub skor/ ska rags/ thal chen gyi rgyan te/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa se ral khar thogs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung / rgod dang gshe dang rngams pa dang / snying rje zhi ba ngo mtshar che/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid/ de'i dpang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog me tog brtse dzi wa ga'i mdog ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyisakyi/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang

ba ridzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub kyisaphyogs bcur sdigasapa/ gcer bu spyan gsum ma skra grol ba/rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal gyi ngur sgra sgrogs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi ga yas dang lhan cig tu brkyang zhing / g.yas yab kyi rked la 'khril ba/ gzhen zhing mdzes pa/ lo bcu drug 31na pa'i na tshod can/ sha rgyas pa/ nu ma 'bur ba/ bha ga rgyasapa/ gnyis med kyi sgor ba la brtson zhing ci/ zag med kyi bde ba rgyas pa ste/ snang ba dang thabs dang / lhag mthong dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo/ yab he ru ga'i phung po sgro/ rigs lnga/ stong pa dang / shes rab dang / zhi gnas dang / bde ba chen

༄༅/ /po'i ngo bo yum phag mo'i 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi skye mched drug sems dpa' drug ste/ kun nasakha sbyor zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du chu khams kyi ngo bo mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du rlung khams kyi ngo bo lwa ma ljang gu /nub tu me khams kyi ngo bo dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor sa khams kyi ngo bo gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing / gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs gar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa'i mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnamasapa/ phyag rgya lngasabargyan cing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang

bas 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa banyis mtshan pa ste/ rten dang brten pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa dwangs shing thogs pa dang bral ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol du gyur/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūm̐/ thugs ma'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'bor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sem/sa dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ peṃ/ / / srid zhi mnyam nyid rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings/ /ma bcos spros bral bde ba chen po'i ngang / /'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog

༄༅/ /nyams re dga'/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /srid pa mthar phyin bcom ldan bde mchog ni/ /mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag gis spras/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad dpa' bo dbyings nas bzhengs/ /'dod chags chen mo sku la 'khril ba'i yum/ /rdo rje phag mo gcer bu khrag 'jag ma/ /bde chen mchod pa rtag tu yab la 'bul/ /yab yum gnyis med thabs dang shes rab rol/ /'dod chags 'joms phyir mdog dmar khro mo'i tshul/ /dga' ba bzhi ldan rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor/ /ḍa ma ru dang rus rgyan khra la la/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gnasa'adir gshegs su gsol/ /pū li la sogs mkha' spyod yul brgyad nas/ /thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo

dpa' bo mkha' 'grornams byin gyis brlabasabyer gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ka ma ru sogs sa steng yul brgyad nas/ /myu gu can dang sa bsrung ma la sogs/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /pre bur la sogs sa 'og yul brgyad nas/ /stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can sogs/ /sku yi 'khor lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'thung spyod la sogs 'dzam gling yul brgyad nas/ /khwa gdong lug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong sogs/ /dam tshig 'bar lo bdud 'dul dpa' mo rnams/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje me ri chu brgyad dud ——

༄༅/ /khrod brgyad/ /dur khrod brgyad na phyogs skyong zhing skyong brgyad/ /klu chen brgyad sogs bkod pa ma lusapa/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyan gyur gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dza/ sto bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ arnya pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ | ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrusagasol/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ55 bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdag dngu 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu'aphrul mthu yisani/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom

ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ me tog bdug spos dam pa 'di dag dang / /'jig rten khams kyi me tog bdug spos kun/ /thamasacad blo yis blangasanas ni/ /bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcasal 'bul/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ sa pa ri wā ra pu/ dhu pe pū dza mer gha sa mu dra slar ra ṇa sa ma ye 〉lha/ snang gsal dri mchog dam pa 'di dag dang / /'jig rten khams kyi snang gsal dri mchog kun/ /thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni/ /bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ sa pa ri wā ra.a lo ke gharnye pū dza mer gha sa mu dra sbar ra ṇa sa ma ye mi3/ zhal zas sgra snyan dam pa 'di dag dang/ /'jig rten khams kyi zhal zas sgra snyan kun/ /thams cad blo yis blangs nas

༄༅/ /ni/ /bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ sa pa ri wā ra ni li hūm̐ hūṃ dza mer gha sa mu dra slar ra ṇa sa ma ye gisahūṃ/ / bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /khrag 'thung dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nasadakon mchog spyi la bstod pa ni/ / lhu/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing blta bas mchog mi shes/ /bsam

gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangasapa'i dbyangs/ /'gags med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' (sprudra/ /bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang / /rnam thar gsum la legs gnasapa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mig gi 'bras/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam ston pa/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes la 'dud/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /

༄༅/ /rdo rje can zhabasapad la 'dud/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thamasacad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'chal bstod/ /gzhen nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab tu brgyan/ /'jig rten gti mug mun sel ba/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas mang pos rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan mchog gi gter gyur pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan

gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba po/ /bdud dgra ma lus 'duspru mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / / lha/ bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar med byung ba/ /'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad ma rgyalapo'i sras/ /rigs ni za tor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs / /o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad/ /bsil ba'i tshal du dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes/ /'jig rten khams su gdug pa can rnams btul/ /kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ /lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru ka/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog de dusa'adir dran/ /gsang sngags rgyal po sa

༄༅/ /gnas 'dir byin phob la/ /rkyen ngan bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / / e sku yi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /lha dbang lus la bskur du gsol/ /lus skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /āṇa gsung gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /sngags dbang ngag la bskur du gsol/ /ngag snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol/ /sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis brlabs/ /dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ /sku bzhi grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshig dbang don mchog rtogs pa dang / /mchog

dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phe phe/ oṃ badz+ra a: gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pāshu a'ihūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pu/ mihūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sgru paṃ āṇahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe u3/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi bye lhalha/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥ(/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nasadabang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ yab larigasakyi bdag po mi bskyod pa dang / yum la rnam par snang mdzad/

༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan cing / /dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ skyed sgrihā :hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ āhā pa ya :hā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ skyed ā na ya theto/ bha ga wan/ bidu rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ skyed swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dhi3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las kai las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ 'bas bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas byed 'a/sa so so'i dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi

bde ba bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra arnya sa// oṃ badz+ra pā:losahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pun+ya lha// oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ sa// oṃ badz+ra a sku1 ke gisahūm̐/ tsotshe badz+ra garnye gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi hūm̐ gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta gisahūm̐/ oṃ rū pa badzi gisahūm̐/ oṃ shap+ta badzi gisahūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhe badzi gisahūṃ/ oṃ ra sa badzi u// oṃ sparnye badzi u// oṃ dharma dhā tu badzi u3/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sapa ri wā ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra garnye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sparnye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra

༄༅/ /mṛ haṃ ge hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze rnyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā gye hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nirti hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra di pe hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā pa badz+re hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sparnye badz+re rinyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+re hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/nang mchod byin gyisabarlabs pa ni gong lta ra byas la/ / o āṇahūm̐/ bla ma rnams dang mchog gsum kun 'dus pa'i/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma mchog gi zhal du oṃ mi hūm̐/ /rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa/ /dza lan dha ra nag po spyod pa dang / /til+li pa dang nā ro par+ṇa ri/ /rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs/ /rtswa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa/ /chos rje spyan snga

bcu gnyis dbang bsod pa/ /grags pa shesarab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba/ /bla ma blo bzang rin bzang bsod nams mtshan/ /sna tshogs rang grol chos rgyal phun tshogs zhabs/ /bkra shis phun tshogs chos dbyings rang grol dang / /chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal/ /game bha dra don grub chos rgyal dang / /bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpal ldan mgar chen pa/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma sogs/ /dngos grub rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi zhal du oṃ u3/ slar yang rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ sa// klu sgrub snying po'i zhal du oṃ u// ār+ya de wa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ a bha yā ka ra'i zhal du oṃ gisahūm̐/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i zha la du oṃ u3/ dpal chen rga lo pa'i zhal du oṃ snyahūṃ/ grub thob

༄༅/ /khams pa rgya gar pa'i zhal du oṃ u// ston pa bkra shis 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ u// bla ma grags pa seṅge'i zhal du oṃ u// bla ma dar ma rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐/ bla ma gzhen nu ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ ā&/ bla ma shākya seṅge'i zhal du oṃ u// bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ u3/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ u// sprul sku bsod rgyam pa'i zhal du oṃ u3/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa'i zhal du oṃ sa//chos kyi hūṃ zla ba 'od kyi zhal du oṃ mi// khams gsum chosakyi rje kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang pe'i zhal du oṃ lha// rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ u// mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ sa3/ bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i

zhal du oṃ sa// rgyal dbang dkon mchog rat+na'i zhal du oṃ ā// rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ u:/ dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ u:/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i zhal du oṃ sa// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma ra dza'i zhal du oṃ u:/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi zhal du oṃ āḥshā/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ ulha/ rje bcun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥ(/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ lha// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal rnams kyi zhal du oṃ u3/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ salhu/

༄༅/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ oṃ u:/ 63ཿha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u// oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye nyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u// oṃ ḍā ki ni ye oṃ u hūm̐/ oṃ lwa me oṃlosahūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he oṃphamihūm̐/ oṃ ྅ pi ṇi ye oṃ u// bka' sdod dam pa chosaskyong ba'i bsrung ma rnamasakyi zhal du oṃ u hūṃ/ rmi ༷༷ ha ha rnyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ rnam lnga 'dod kor gyi phyag rgyabacas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bha wa at+pa ko3nya/ zhes 'byud pa'i phyag rgya bos/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigasapa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ dkar po lasardo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po nor bu oṃ gyisamatshan zhing bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ ulas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma

brgyad pa ze'u 'bru snyamatshan zhing / bde ba chen po 'dzags pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba/ spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan skyes nyams su myong bar gyur/ lha thams cad bde ba chen po nyams su myong zhing thams cad he ru ga'i cha shas cam du zad pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ / snyi chos kyi dbyingasalas 'gyur ba med rtags su/ /sku mdog mthing nag cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs/ /byang chub sems dang stong nyid dbyer med pa/ /rtag chad 'gro 'ong bral ba phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ /

༄༅/ /bdud rtsi ro yis nges gang tshul ston pa/ /mchog la phan mdzad rdo rje phag mo dang / /gnyis med rol par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad pa'i tshul/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod/ /g.yon pa dril bu dngos por 'dzin pa spong / /snang stong dbyer med 'byud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jig rten spyod grol dbu skra gyen du bcings/ /ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /chos nyid thugs chud rdo rje'i thag pas brgyus/ /yul dang yul can dbyer med khyod la bstod/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gosapad+ma'i gdan/ /byang chub myu gu smin mdzad nyi steng du/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs byed dusamatshan mnan/ /ma rungs tshar gcod mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrib

gnyisabasregs mdzad me dpung nang na bzhugs/ /nyon mongs gdung sel zla ba phyed pas spras/ /phrin las bzhi yi sems can don mdzad phyir/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yid bzhin re skong nor bu gtsug na mdzes/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya drug /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i skur gsal ba/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spang bya spong dang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir/ /stag gi pags pa mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno dkar mche ba gtsigs/ /thugs rjes 'dzum bcas khros la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag 'dra blo dman yon tan med pa yis/ /lha mchog khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lta mchag khyod

༄༅/ /dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /khams bzhi rnam dag mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi/ /phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas las bzhi sgrub pa wang / /ye shes bzhi yi rang gzugasamakha' 'gro ma/ /lwa ma dum skyes gzugs can ma la 'dud/ /mtshams bzhir gnas pa'i stobs chen lngasagang ba'i/ /bum thod bzhi yis mchog gi bde stsol zhing / /ye shes lnga yi rang snang gzhal yas khang / /rten dang brten par bcasal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshogs brgyad dag pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong shing dang chu rlung sprin/ /ri dang mchod rten mi ro 'phyung pa'i tshogs/ /mi ma thun bsrung skyob srung ba'i 'khor lor bstod/ /gdod nas dag pa bde chen ye shes brgyad/ /lam du lha yi 'bor lo gsal dag bstan/ /'bras bu bde chen

'bar lor bdag gyur nas/ /khams gsum bde ba che la sbyor bar shog / ༈ bdag he ru gar gnas pa'i thugs shar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te/ bzlasapa byas pas sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yon nga/ nas thon/ /khams gsum gyi sems can ltar gnas pa'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim hūṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba sems can gyi sna bug gasku na pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yasapar zhugs snying ga'i hūm̐ gnasapa la thim zhing 'khor ba ladamigasate/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rmi ༷ཿha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ be+e ro tsa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi

༄༅/ /steng du/ me lam̐ paṃ haṃ bzhi'i tha mar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dusarang rang gi sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim zhing 'khor ba ladamigasate/ oṃ ḍā ki ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lwa me hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ྅ pi ṇi ye hūṃ phaṭa/ / // gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa kun/ /dran pa tsam gyis zhi mdzad pa/ /bla med byang chub mchog la 'god/ /bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /skye med ngang nas thugs rje chen po yis/ /pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng du/ /bdud 'dul hūm̐ las khro chen skur sprul pa'i/ /bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dag pa chos sku'i pho brang nas/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying brtse yis/ /gzugasasku sgyu mar ston mdzad pa'i/ /phag mo

yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing / /ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' 'gro lwa ma dum skyesam/ /gzugs can ma dang lha mo bzhi/ /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan sna chen dpa' mo'i blo/ /mi'u thung lang ga'i dbang phyug ma/ 'ung grib ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sa srung ma dang 'jigs byed che/ /rlung shugs chang 'thung ljang lha mo/ /shin tu bzang dang rta sna ma/ /bya gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor shugs khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang / /chang 'tshong go cha rab dpa' mo/ /stobs chen 'khor los bsgyur ma dang / /brtson chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thod pa'i dum bu keng rusache/ /keng rusamache gtsigs lha yi sgra/ /'od dpag med dang

༄༅/ /rdo rje'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /myu gu can dang ral pa can/ /dpal chen hūṃ mdzad rab bzang dang / /rdo rje bzang dang 'jigasabyed che/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stobs chen rin chen rdo rje dang / /rta mgrin nam snying he ru ka/ /pad+ma gar dbang rnam snang mdzad/ /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams srung byed pa'i/ /khā gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ /de bzhin khyi yi gdong pa can/ /phag gdong ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yid 'phrog gzugs ni gnyis ma ste/ /bsregs ma dang ni pho nya mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang 'joms ma ste/ /gshin rje bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa mar pas mdzad pa'o// / // ri bo chen po'i lho phyogasasu/ /o rgyan rang byung dur khrod na/ /ri bo thams

cad rus pa'i ri/ /rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung / /chu klung thams cad khrag dang zhag /sa gzhi thams cad keng rus la/ /sgra skad thams cad hūṃ dang phaṭa/ khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing / /stobs chen thamasacad 'joms pa'i sa/ /yum rdo rje phag mo de na bzhugs/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa rab tu 'bul/ /ma yi sku mdog dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba las/ /bde chen nyams dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /zhabs gnyis gar stabs skyil krung phyed pa las/ /bdud bzhi thal bar rlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa las/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /zhal gnyisarab gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa las/ /skye 'chi

༄༅/ /rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /don dam rang bzhin phag zhal nag po las/ /chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba las/ /bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /phyag g.yon bhan+ta khrag bkang bsnams pa las/ /rtog med zas la rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /thod skam lnga yisadabu la rgyan pa las/ /rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba las/ /sems can bde la 'god pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba las/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rdo rje kha ṭī nam mkhar 'phyar ba las/ /gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /de la mi mgo

gsum gyis rgyan pa las/ /dug gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rdo rje 'khor los rab tu rgyan pa las/ /'phrin lasarnam bzhi mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /dar sna lnga yi ba dan 'phyar ba las/ /yon tan nub pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /gser gyi bum pa rab tu ldir ba las/ /chos sku yon tan 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /ḍā ma ru yi sil sgra 'brol ba las/ shes rab snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /yu ba drang zhing dkar la ldem pa/ las/ /bdud kyi rgyal mtshan snyil ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rdo rje phyed pa thur du bstan pa las/ /dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /thod rlan lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i rmekha' 'gro 'bum/ /yum gyi mkha'

༄༅/ /la mtho dman med pa las/ /chos rnams ma lus bzhugasapa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /ro yi gdan la dgyes par bzhugs pa las/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangasapa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbusan bzhugasapa las/ /nyen mongs rnam rtog bsregasapa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /gcer bur sku mdog dpal gyi be'u las/ /'dod chags bde bar sgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /'di rnams thams cad ma yi sprul pa ste/ /khro mo'i gzugasacan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang phyug gtso mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /lha mo khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mkha' 'gro lathum phrag nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bstod pa slob dpon ḍi bhi he ru dasamadzad pa/ dur

khrod dang tshogasagral ma gtogs gnan du gnyan pas mi bya'o// / lha/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum thugs/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa/ /ji bzhin nyid du rtogasagyur pas/ /gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon pa phyag sogs khro cho 'i zhal/ /g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal/ /bdag meng skye med chos kyi dbyings/ /rnal 'byar ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab

༄༅/ /'jug gam/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khril/ /zag med bde ba'i sku nyams ldan/ /sems can rnams la bde ster ma/ /phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma/ /phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor ma la mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub gnang phyir bzhes su gsol/ /zhes bstod do// / de nas tshogasabya ba ni/ mdun du nang 46 sna tshogs rdzas tshang bar bsags la / /e sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lhahā sgrihā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ :hā pa ya lhahā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bidu

rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shudhe3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ kai las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du aḥlas thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ tshogs rdzas sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ snyahūm̐ ha hoḥhrīX gsum brjod/ hūṃ/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /brgyud pa'i tshogasakyis bskor ba dang / /yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa la/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /yum chen rdo rje phag mo la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /tshogasadang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyisamed ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhesasu gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /

༄༅/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /bcom ldan bud+dha he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /bcom ldan badz+ra he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /bcom ldan rat+na he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis

bskor ba dang / /yum chen rin chen mkha' 'gro la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /tshogasadang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /bcom ldan garma he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / /yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro la/ /dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba

༄༅/ /dang / /tshogasadang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ / / lha/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ /'jigasasu rung dang bskal pa'i me/ /dmar nag 'khrugasapa'i klong dkyil nas/ /chos skyong ma hā kā la dang / /yum mchag tsaṇ+ḍidabang phyug ma/ /'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /ma lus 'khor bcasathams cad la/ /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyisamed ngang du 'bul lags na/ /blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ / / spyi/ pho brang mkha' spyod rtsa ri ṭa/ /bdud mgon seng gdong yab

yum la/ /'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ma lus 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ /blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ / / lhu/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas/ /kyis phyi chos kyi sgrol ma la/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma lus 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ /blang dor med par bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par rol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /de nas tshogs srin te gtor ma byin rlabasagator bsngosagong nas byung ba rnams rdzogs par 'don/ ༈ de nasarkang brgyad bya ba ni/ ༈ skyed

༄tsho/ /grub par gyur cig /ha ha hūm̐ dang ki li ki li sga yis 'argyung po ro langs tshogs kyis myur bskor nas/ sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mar sbrel ba'i phreng bas kun nas rgyan cing zhal du gsol/ 'dod pa'o gzugs dang mi sdug gzugs can phyag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas pa'i mi yi thod pa bsnams/smin ma ser zhing spyan dmar ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong mdzod/ peṃ pho phaṭa ces sgrogs pas so sor bskyed pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su rab bzhugs nas/rab tu gsal zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas 'jigs pa'i sku rgyan gshin rje dang mtshungs pa/ drag shul phyag gis bsad pa rnams kyi mi mgo ma lus bzung nas khrag rgyun 'bab pa gsol/ rol bas rol ba sel zhing mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod

kyis bsrung bar mdzod/ /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ zhes bzod pa'i skad can ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug can rnams bzung ste/ gcig pus sna tshogs mnan cing mnan nas ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad char sprin nag po'i mdog lha hri shri zhes sngags kyi gsung can pa tsa pa tsa rigs kyi sngags kyis kun nas bsreg /sgrub po rnamasakyi bgegasarnams myur du bskyod par mdzod cig zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod/ /hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa cesadrag po'i sgra yi srid pa gsum gyi khong rnams ma lus 'gengs nus shing / /ha ha ḍa ḍa zhes bzhad gang zhig dus kun tu ni shin tu rab tu 'jigs mdzad pa/ /phyugs rnams kyis ni nyin re bzhin du sdig dang bgegs 'joms dri med brnyas pa chu nyi bzhin/ /dbu skra dang ni sma ra dmar ser nye bar bskyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis

༄༅/ /zhing skyong mdzod/ /raṃ raṃ raṃ zhes span dmar 'khrug cing bsgyur mdzad r+ghaṃ 4 4 zhes khros pa'i span gyis gzigs/ /khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes gtum pa'i phyag g.yas gri gug ral gyis bgegs rnazlos ma lus sgrol mdzad byung / /ru dra ru zhes khrag ni phyag gir+sha bsnamasashing zhal du gsol mdzad 'thung ba la dgyes pa/ /ḍi ḍi ḍi zhesaḍa ma ru can 'di yis gdul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrungs/ /rka kai rka zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras shing nag po'i mchu dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /rtsa rtsa c-i zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyisarab g.yos rmad byung sa yi 'jig rten snang mdzad cing / /kṛ kṛ kṛ zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par ma lus 'joms mdzad cing / /saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin

gang yin zhing skyong khyod kyisaskyongs/ /baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes sna tshogs gshin rje ltar 'gro dri ma med pa'i chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ zhesarlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen/ /bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ zhes nus pa mchog gi khro gnyer 'dzigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs sha za zhing / /k+ṣe k+ṣ-i k+ṣe zhes phan par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig sel zhing skyong khyod kyi mdzod/ /kli kli kli zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyi srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang / /paṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba/ sngags bdag sngags kyi sku can thugs kyi sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster/ /zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis

༄༅/ /'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol/ /sgrub pa po'am slob dpon gang zhing dam tshig thoga'adzin blo ldan gus pa dang bcas pas/ /thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed 'di ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur pa gang / /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor pa 'dzin cing blo gros mtshungs med rgyas pa dang / /sa steng dang ni mtho ris su yang 'di yis bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rtag tu nyams par 'khru/ra/ /dpal nag po chen pa'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhesabya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'o/ / / de nas bsnang ba'i rim pa ni/ phyi nangagasang gsum gyi mchad pa rten rdzas rnamasalegasapar bsags/ sposakyi dud sprin dang bayogate 'di skad do// ༈ // 'og min gnas mchog yon tan kun gyi gter/ /byang chub semasakyi rang bzhin sku gsung

thugs/ /'gro ba ma lus thugs rjes skyob mdzad pa'i/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /chos dbyings skye med ngang lasam g.yos kyang / /thabs kyisakhro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /lha yi lha mchog he ru ka dpal sogs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogasathugasadam bskang / /rkang gnyis gtso bo rgyal ba shākya thub/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i skyabs mchog sngar 'das dang / /da lta bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /mkha' la spyod cing nyer bzhi'i yul kun nyul/ /gang gis bsgrubasal mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dam tshig ldan la ma yi bu bzhin skyong / /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang / /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyi mchod/ /dam

༄༅/ /rdzas zag med zhal zas ji snyed dang / /ba ling bdud rtsi sman raka rgya mtsho kun/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul ma tshang med pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong bar gyur pa nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / / 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs/ /bdud 'dul nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod dkyil 'khor dbus/ /thugs mgon bya rog gdong dun srog gi bdag /nag po stong bcas rgyal ba'i bsta na pa bsrung / /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /sha rusaphung por

spungs pa'i ri rab nas/ /phyag gnyan rab 'jigs zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong / /sha za 'bum gyi tshogasabacas dam nyams gshed/ /'khor dang bcasapa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /rak+ta rba klong 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil na/ /dus mtshan nag mo khrag 'thung re ma ti/ /ma mo bye ba dang bcas bstan pa bsrung / /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /gzhan yang khrag 'thung 'khor du gtogs pa yi/ /lnga sprul pho nya chos skyong sde dpon dang / /ro langs gnod sbyin pho bdud mo bdud bcas/ /sprul pa'i bya gcan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /rta lug g.yag khyi gos zhwa nag po dang / /dar gdugs rgyal mtshan rnam bzhi phyi mchod lnga/ /'dod yon bya rog rgyal mtshan nang gi rten/ /gri snying chas zhugs gsang ba'i rten gyis bskang / /

༄༅/ /mdor na dngos 'byor yid sprul ji snyed dang / /'bod bod gsad bzlog mnan bsreg zor gyi rdzas/ /las bzhi sgrub byed ting 'dzin gsang sngags kyis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs te/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'phrin las sgrub ces pa'i/ /dben gnas chos 'khor skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams/ /rang rang yid mthun mchod rdzas rnams kyis bskang / /de ltar bla ma yi dam bud+dha dang / /byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kun/ /dgyes dgu'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang ba la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas skabs tshe 'di'i bar chad kun zhi zhing / /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa

rgyas gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin spel nyams len la/ /bar gcod dgra 'dre gyod byur mi kha dang / /chags chen nyam nga byad zor mchis gyur na/ /mthar mnan thal ba'i rdul bzhin drag pos sgrol/ /ces pa yang 'bri gung gi phyogasasu gnas pa'i sgom lasapa gnam lcags me 'bar gyisabakad pa'o/ /skabasa'adir tshogs lhag rdo rje slob dpon gyi 'al chusabran te/ a kā ro mu /baṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pasno tā ta oṃ yisahūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsumagyisabyin rlabs la/ phud dang lhag ma'i gtar ma bzang zhing rgya che ba zad mi shes pa 'dod pa 'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa ra gyur/ bh+yoḥ dpal chen tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /sngags las skyes dang zhing las skyes/ /las la skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/snye /'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ /dpal gyi pha babs 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /rkyen ngan bar

༄༅/ /chad zhi bar mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogasakyi lhag ma'i bdag /phyogasabazhi dur khrod gnas nyul zhing / /tshogasakyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni/ shar nas glang gi mgo can dang / /lho nasam he'i mgo can dang / /nub nas chu srin mgo can dang / /byang nasaseng ge'i mgo can sogs/ /lhag masdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'diragashegasalhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ /dpal gyi pha babs 'di bzhesal/ /rnala'abyor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /rkyen ngan bar go zhi bar mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ gas yang tshogasakyi lhag ma'i bdag /mtshamasabazhi dur khrod gnas nyul zhing / /tshogasakyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni/ shar lto ra skyesamago can dang / /lho nub mi ro'i mgo ༅ dang/ khub byang shwa ba'i mgo can dang/ /byang shar khyu mchog mgo can sogs/ lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro

ma/ /'dir gshegasalhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ /dpal gyi pha babasa'adi bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /la la sha yi lhag ma sdud/ sha za so sgra chemasase chem/ /la la khrag gi lhag mo'athung / /khrag 'thung mid pa kyu ru sa /la la chu ser lhag ma 'dag /khrag 'dag lce dmar yugasaseyug /la la tshogasakyi lhag ma sdud/ /rnal 'byor pho mo'i gralarnamasanyul/ /la la gtor ma'i lhag ma sdud/ /gtor len lag pa yabasase yab/ / 'dir gshegasalhag ma'igator ma bzhes/ /dpal gyi pha babs 'dibazhes la/ zhol 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcasakyi/ /rkyen ga bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ khurtsis ba ling ta bhak+ṣa kāswā hā//
— ———— —— ————— —— — — —— —— ——————— —— ——————— ste ———————— ———— ༄/ /gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'phrin las kun khrub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /āḥtshe/ /brtsegs las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi bkug /'dres shing yig gsum zla bar bcas/ /'od zhu bdud rtsir thim pa yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ u/ ha to hrīḥ gsum brjod/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phrosabla ma yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro chosaskyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /nor lha phyogasaskyong gzhi bdag dang / /bgegasarigasalan chagasa'agro drug bcas/ /spyan drangasasprin ltar mdun du btibs/ /a/ pathu puṣ+ṭi sgru pes lo gegarnye ni wi

hūm̐ shap+ta pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ mgron rigs gong ma gnas rim bzhin/ /ljags 'od rdo rjes sbu gu yis/ /gtor ma drangs gsol mnyes tshims gyur/ /oṃ snya hūm̐ 0 drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /drug pa rdo rje 'chang la sogs/ /dbang lung man ngag gdams pa yi/ /gsar rnying brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang mchog thob par/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzung / /oṃ u/ཿ yi dam bya spyod rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor bla med kyis bsdus pa'i/ /bde dgyes dus gsang 'jigs byed dang / /dmar nag ma ya sgyu ma dang / /gdan bzhi la sogs rgyal ba'i lha/ /zhi khro rab 'byams gsar rnying gi/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /mi mthun

༄༅/ /sdig sgrib tshogs dag nas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyisastsal du gsol/ /oṃ gis:: zil gnon 'jam dpal tshe yi bdag /yab yum sras sprul 'khor dang bcas/ /ki kai dmar nag khro 'char sogs/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogasarnams/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /bsrung bzlog bsad mnan las bzhi dang / /grub brgyad mya ngan 'da' la sogs/ /'phral yun don kun lhun grub mdzod/ /oṃ u(ཿ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /gzho stod gter sgrom tshogs khang dang / /phyogs bcu gnasachen gnas phran sogs/ /ma lus kun la kha raṃ khā hi/ /'dod yon re bskang tshogs rdzogs shog /oṃ lha/ dam can rgya mtsho mthu stobs can/ /dpal mgon phyag bzhi bya rog mtshan/ /phyag drug gur zhal beng ma

ning/ /stag zhon la sogs mgon po'i tshogs/ /bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma dang / /tshe ring mched lnga brtan ma'i bdag /skrug nag lcam dral ha ra nag /zhing skyong seng gdong rā hu la/ /pe har gnod sbyin rtsi dmar sogs/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas gtor ma rnams/ /bzhesashig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /bar chad nad gdon dgra bgegs sgrol/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe bsring / /chos dang bstan pa srung zhing spel/ /bdag gi bsam don grub par mdzod/ /oṃlo9shāḥ rnam mang thos sras dze+e bha la/ /gnod sbyin nor bdag pho mo rnams/ /mchad sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon bcas/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /chos ldan longs spyod spel bar mdzod/ /oṃ u3: lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen dang / /phyogs skyong bcu sogs gtsang ris kyi/ /

༄༅/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs/ /mchod sbyin mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /skyed a'i/ཿ gnam sa bar gsum phyogs bcu yi/ /gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas rnams dang / /khyad par yul gnas 'di dag gi /bdag po 'khor bcas gtor ma 'di/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /bdag 'dod chos bzhin grub par mdzod/ /oṃ sa: bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs/ /lan chags bu lon sha 'khon bdag /gang yin mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /gnod sems zhi nas phan sems bskyed/ /lan chags byang zhing bu lon 'khor/ /sha 'khon dag cing 'khor bar mdzod/ /oṃ lha3: 'gro drug

semasacan mtha' yas tshogs/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi/ /rang rang sdug bsngal tshogs zhi nas/ /phan bde byang semasaldan gyur cig /arnya sogasakyi mchod/ yig brgya brjod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron rigs rnams/ /mkha' la sprin tshogs dengs par ltar/ /rang rang gnas su badz+ra muḥ gang tshe spyan drangs 'arkyu1na par gsol/ /cesadang / bsngo ba smon lam yang bya'o/ /gtor bsngos tshang la bsdusapa 'di/ /mnga' ris chos mdzad ma yis ni/ /bskul nas skyu ra grags pa'i ming/ /'dzin des sbyarabasa'agro phan shog /dge'o//
༄༅/ /dpal ldan 'bri gang bka' brgyud kyi chos srung rnams kyi gso wa/ smu/ched bsdus pa las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

—'byorā snye rnye — me wa rgyud sde skre / /zlo rgezlu 'du rtse /bye bye rdo rje/ /dmar ——nag nā/ lar+sha sgyu ma dang /cingaX re bye trī ༷ riX sa ༷ cirel ring spo sogs/ /yi dam dkyil /'khor rab 'byam/sa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin kun/ /dmigs me da bde ba chen pos ma/chod/ /rjo ge ri pre —4) —ring —— kyis ༄rngogaXri rdzogs shing / /sgribasgo sa bag chags kun /zhi nas/ /grub brgyad lho gi dngos grub ——— ————— ———— ———————— ————————

༄༅/ /stsol/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /phyag drug gter mgon sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las mgon po bcas/ /ye shesabadud rtsisamanyes byas nas/ /bsrung bzlog bsad mnan las bzhi yi/ /dmigasapa'i don kun lhun 'grub mdzod/ /ḍāk+ki gtso mo chos kyi sgrol/ /ye shesadam tshig mkha' 'gro dang / /dbang dang sha za las kyi sgrol/ /jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /mi g.yo gtad dkar mthing gi zhal/ /cod pan mgrin bzang gtso 'khor sogs/ /ḍāk+ki bye ba bsam yas la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi mchod sprin gyis/ /thugasadam gnyan po bskangs byasanas/ /tshe ring nad med bkra shis shing / /'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi nas/ /mthun rkyen rnam lnga bstsal tu gsol/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /btsun mo sras dang

gnod sbyin brgyad/ /rta bdag brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i sde 'khor gyis/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /tshe dpal snyan grags chos srid rgyas/ /lung rtogs 'dus sde 'phel gyur cig /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dang / /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun sogs/ /btsan dmag bye ba dgu khri bcas/ /mchod sprin sna tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /khamasagasum pho mo dbang du sdud/ /srid gsum ma lus grogs su khug /'du ba gsum gyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum dang / /rgyal po sku lnga 'khor bcas dang / /smug nag lcam dral ha ra nag /khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /'khor tshogs dregs pa rgya mtsho yis/ /skong rdzas sna tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /dkon mchog bstan la gnod 'tshe ba'i phyi

༄༅/ /nang dam nyams dgra bgegasakun/ /snying khrag dren mo zhal du stobs/ /srog rtsa dmar po bod kyis chod/ /tshe bsod dbang thang bdag la stims/ /rnam shesadag pa/'i zhing du sgrol/ /drag po'i las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /mdor na bstan dang 'gro ba kun/ /'gal rkyen chu 'dzin dbyings su zhi/ /chosasrid nyi zla rab 'bar zhing / /phun tshogs snang ba dbang bsgyur nas/ /gdon bgeshes smag mun 'joms pa yi/ /las bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces pa gcen po bstan pa'i yi/ /gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ /rgod tshang skyesabu don 'grub kyis/ /kun gzhi'i klong nas shar ba de/ /mthe mdzub bar nasabyung bar byas/ /dgebasalasabazhi lhun grubanas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen shog /

no༅༅//la g.yel med can//mchod pa'i thabasa'aphrul mdor bsdus spro//'jigs byed khrag 'thung chen mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor chog bya ba'i rim pa la/sbyor ba dang dngosagazhi dang rjes bosagasum mo//dang po ni/'di lbi ṣ+ka du sgrub pa'i gnas phyi nang gi rten dang brten gyi gtor ma sogasargyun du yod pa'i par/mchod gtor dang phyi mchod gso bran bya/'bul gtor dang sman raka gi phud mchod bshams/rten med cing nyi tshe ba'i gsol mchod lta bu la/lcagasasam thod pa'i snod du mchod gtor gru gsumabra gzugs ma grong nge rtse mogasumadzo'igayasagayonasadun logs thod gzugs kyi

nang sku gsung thugasasprul gsum/ de'i rgyab ma mo bzhi/ de'i rgyab gdong can brgyad/ de'i rgyab sgo ma bzhi rnams la zur gsum rim par sum chasachung du btang ba'i mthar thebasakyu grangs mang g.yas bskor du bskor/ nyi zla dang zhi rgyan gyi rtser me ri dung khog mas mtshan pa/ gtor rtse g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du man thig res brgyan pasanor bu sumatshogasasu dod pa la sha sna snying sna'i 'phan dar gyisabargyan/ khur ba shingatog chang dang khrag sna khyad pa ra bya mo nag mo dang ra rog po'i sha brag blugs/ 'bul gtor zur gsum rtse gsum nyams tsam dod cing thebasakyu bstodagusabaskor ba me ri dung khog masabargyan pa dang / phyi mchod grangasatshar/ sman rag phud skyems rnamasabasham mo/ /gnyisapa dngos gzhi ni/ bsnyen sgrub skabs bdag bskyed kyang lha mor bsgomasapa yin rung / gtor chog tsam la dgyesardor dang bde ma chog gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdusagang su nga sngon tu sgrub par byasanas/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du lha mo bdag bsgom gyi dus su yi dam lha
