༄༅/ /gsal ba'i mdun du zhesapa 'di mi dgosalha mo dud sol ma rnam smin gyi lus can du gsal ba'i thugs shar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po/ de las me 'bar bas gzung 'dzin rnam smin gyi lus thul gyisabasregs nasathal ba'i phung por gyur/ de'i steng du srog gi i dkar po 'od zer dang bcasapa'i steng du baṃ dkar po las bum pa dkar por gyur pa'i kha nas bdud rtsi dkar lhung thugs shar babs e la thim pas i yig 'od du 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ yaṃ ma hā kā lī de bī kā lī bi grwan+ta kā la rā tri tsaṇ+ḍa3 bi māṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ de yongs su gyur pa las dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang thod mkhar zur gsum pa zum rim dang bcas pa me rlung dmar nag 'tshubs

pa'i dbus su/ ye shesakyi dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma nag po sprin dang bung ba ltar gnag pa/ shin tu sbeg la keng rus kyi lus can zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na tshoral gri me 'bar ba phyar zhing gnyis pa na thod rlon dmar gyis bkang nas zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shasti'i mtshon cha 'dzin cing 'og ma na tri shā la rtse gsum nga/'i mgul na dar dpyangs 'phur ba bsnams pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po zlog cing khams gsum la lta ba/ /dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing 'a/na bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ dbu la sprul dang thod phreng gis brgyan cing rma bya'i rgyal mtshan spyi gtsug na phyar ba/ snyan cha g.yas pa sprul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsol zhing g.yon pa

༄༅/ /seng ge ral dmar can phya can 'phyo ba/ rna ltag gnyis na me tog dang dar nag gi cod pan 'phur ba/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i thod pas do shal du byas/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko rlon chan pas dras pa la re lde ser po'i sham bu btags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing klu chen po brgyad gshibs pa'i ska rags can/ khrag zhag dang thal chen gyi thig le tshom bur bkod pa/ zhabs gnyis lcagasasgrog gis mdzes par brgyan cing bong bu dmar gwa'i steng na btsan skyil brjid pa'i tshul gyisabagying zhing rol pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbusan gsung ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bur sgrog cing ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i skur gyur/ thod

mkhar nang gi gru gsum du sku gsung thugs sprul gyi ma mo gsum/ nag po gcer bu mi snying dang thod khrag thogs shing bong bu la zhen pa/ zhing gos re lde rus pas brgyan pa/ thod mkhar phyi'i phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas can bong bu la zhan pa/ de rgyab shar du seng gdong ma/ lhor stag gdong ma/ nub tu spyang gdong ma/ byang du phag gdong ma/ byang shar bya rgod gdong ma/ shar lhor cung ga'i gdong ma/ lto nub tu dur bya'i gdong ma/ nub byang du bya rog gdong ma rnamasakyang gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas can dril rta la zhan pa/ phyogs bzhir sgo srung spu sha'i gdong can mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing dril nag stag spyang spre'u la zhon pa/ gzhan yang thugs sprul nag mo 'bum sde

༄༅/ /sogs sprul pa'i las mkhan bye ba 'bum phrag ye shesadang las dang 'jig rten las grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ lha mo'i thugs gar 'od sgo nga'i dbyibs lta bu sor bzhi'i tshad me dmar lta bu'i dbus su hūṃ mthing nag zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad dregs byed thams cad kyi srog gi snying po bsdus te tshul 'dusapas hūṃ gi mtha' skor 'od kyi thig le'i nang du/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kwa li kwa li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las hūṃ gcig chad de lha mo'i bha gar thim/ badz+ra lā su rā ga ya mi hūṃ/ 'di ni gsang ba'i lha mo bha gar gzhug pa zhesabya ste lha mo bdag bsgom du byed pa'i tshe/ rang gi

thugasaka'i hū go de bdag nyid kyi gsang bar gzhug pa yin no/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ u hūm̐/ 'khor thams cad kyi thugs shar bh+yo yig gis mtshan pa/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal lha mo nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs par gyur/ ye shesapa spyan drangasazhing bstim pa ni/ tshil chen gyi dud pa dang / rolamo gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bskul te/ bh+yoḥ thod pa dgu brtsegs 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang / /me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus shed nas/ /dbang phyug sras mo lha mo dud sol ma/ /char sprin mdog 'dra'i lha mo dud sol ma/ /khros pa'i tshul ston gtum mo dud sol ma/ /mi yi gzugs can 'jigs byed dud

༄༅/ /sol ma/ /thub pa'i bstan 'dzin srung ma dud sol ma/ /dam tshig bsrung phyir khrag 'thung dud sol ma/ /rnal 'byor skyong phyir ma cig dud sol ma/ /las rnams bsgrub phyir dam can dud sol ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug mthu chen dud sol ma/ /dmar chen khrag gis spyan 'dren gnas 'dir byon/ /snum chen gsur gyis spyan 'dren gnas 'dir byon/ /thal mo bde yisaspyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /g.yab dar nag posaspyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /mi rkang gling bus spyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /dam tshig dril bus spyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /cang te'u'i snyan pasaspyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /mi thod rnga yis spyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyisaspyan 'dren 'dir byon cig /ma g.yel ma g.yel chos skyong

srung ma'i tshogs/ /ma cig bosapa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /rtse gcig bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma bsrings/ /dam can sgrub pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel/ /bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /gsol cig mchod pa'i tshe na thugs ma g.yel/ /ma hā kā la'i dam tshig can khyod kyis/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ /dam la dgongs te gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpas mdzad pa'o/ /gal che ba srin po da sha shrī ba'i gdung glur grags pa ni/ bh+yo/ ri rab chen po'i byang shar mtshams/ /g.yu mtsho mu le mthing gi dbus/ /rin chen sna lnga'i gzhal yas khang / /de dbusasrid gsum thod rme khar nang / /gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ /sku mdog nag

༄tsho/ /mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bong bu chibs/ /'khor yang ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegasasu gsol/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus nyid du/ /dam can bzhud par mi 'os kyang / /sngon tshe byang chub shing drung du/ /thub pa chen po'i spyan snga mā /ji ltar khas blang dam bcasaltar/ /sangs rgyasabastan pa srung ba dang / /'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /gsang sngags srung ma dam tshig can/ /'khor bcasagashegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /bh+yo/ gzhan yang gshin rje'i pho brang dang / /lha khang dur khrod ri sul nas/ /chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod pa 'bul ba bzhes slad du/ /da lta nyid du byon nas kyang / /gnyis med brtan par bzhugs su

gsol/ /oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī ka li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ 'dṛ sh+ya dzaḥ/ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho zhes brjod pas ye shesakyi lha mo 'khor dang bos pa sprin gyi phungapo ltar thigathib byon nas dmotshigapa la thim par bas/ bho/ rlung dmar drag po'i shugs ldan bong bu'i steng / /dur khrod chas ldan zhabasaganyisalcags sgrog mdzes/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ki li gi la sgrogs/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug gdan la bzhugs/ /pad+ma ka ma lwa ya s+t+waṃ/ bka' bsgo zhing dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug 'jigs byed khrag 'thung dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas la sku dngos su ston cig gal te sku dngos su mi ston na/ bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar dam bcas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bstan

༄༅/ /pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / khyad par du nges gsang mar pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rtag brtan mi nub par rgyas par mdzod cig bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs shig sngags 'chang sgrub pa po bdag cag gi dgra bgegs thams cad myur du sgrol cig tshe dang ye shes yon tan gyi dpal rnams skyed par mdzod cig gzhan yang bdag cag gi yid la gang 'dod pa thams cad khyed kyis sgrubs shig cha hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kwa li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ e ā ral+li hrī dzaḥ dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ myong mchod 'thor la/ 'di ni khyed kyi dam tshig chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngosagrub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya a ti kra ma rna hūṃ phaṭa/ mar gol thog mar 4bo rdzasarnams/ 'ose sho

dha ne hūṃ phaṭa/ kyisabasangs/ aswabhāwa shud+dhaḥ sogs kyisasbyang / o.u: ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ mchod rdzas kyi kha dog dri ro ngan pa bsal nas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por gyur/ phyimarani/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kwa li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra arnya pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hāsamar yon/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra pra ba ra sad ka ra pra tits+tsha hūṃ dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ swā hāsazhabs bskul/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi pā dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hāsametog yo hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ swā hāsagadug spos/

༄༅/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra garnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hāsadri m+mu/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra ni bi du pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hāsazhupa zas/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ dzo me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ swā hāsasnang gsal/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hāsarol mo dbul/ nang mchod ni/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa shap+ta gan+dhe ra sasparnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swā hā bcasamachod/ gsang mchod ni/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ sa rak+ta la khā hi/ gtor ma 'bulab ni/ skyed saṃ re dha sne hūṃ phaṭa/ cesabasang gtor bya/ swabhāwas sbyang / gtor

ma'i nang du ha ser pos kha dog ngan pa bcom nas kha dog phun sum tshogs par gyur/ stodakar pos dri ngan pa bcom nas dri phun sum tshogs par gyur/hrīX sngon posaro ngan pa bcom nas ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ sa// lan gsum/ yotahoḥhrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum brjod pasabyin brlab/ thal mo brkyang nas yid kyisabategs la zhal du bstab lo'i tshul gyis/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /keng rus gsar rnying tshogs ni ri ltar spungs/ /bhan+ta mang po'i tshogs ni rdza ltar lhag /tsit+ta mang po'i tshogs ni byung ltarngo brtsegs/ /rak+ta mang po'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /zhing chen gsar rnying tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs ni skar ltar 'khrugs/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i tshogs ni bran ltar 'khol/ /ma sring

༄༅/ /byams pa'i tshogs ni gshegasasu gsol/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham gshegs su gsol/ /dmar chen khrag la rol te mchod pa bzhes/ /rus chen rkang la rol te mchod pa bzhes/ /snum chen tshil la rol te mchod pa bzhes/ /bhan+ta lcang lo 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong 'di/ /snod kyi 'jig rten bas kyang rgya re che/ /'dod yon lnga las grub pa'i dpal bsdodas 'di/ /ri rgyal lhun po bas kyang dpang re mtho/ /ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i gtor kyu 'di/ /gling bsnye gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs/ /sha chen gsar rnying tshogs pa'i rgyan ldan 'di/ /gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rol ba'i mtsho bdun bas kyang ro re zhim/ /rak+ta gsar rnying tshogs pa'i rba rlabs 'di/ /phyi yi rgya

mtsho bas kyang gting re zab/ /klad pa gsar rnying tshogasapa'i sprin chen 'di/ /gangs ri dkar po bas kyang lhun sdug mdzes/ /zhun chen gsar rnying tshogs pa'i snang gsal 'di/ /nyi zla zung gcig bas kyang 'od re gsal/ /tshil chen gsar rnying tshogasapa'i dud sprin 'di/ /na bun g.yu bun bas kyang 'grul re mkhas/ /tsit+ta gsar rnying tshogasapa'i tshom bu 'di/ khrigra skar rtsa brgyad bas kyang grangs re mang / /zhing chen gsar rnying tshogs pa'i bla re 'di/ /lho sprin sngon po bas kyang ngos re 'thug /rgyu ma gsar rnying tshogs pa'i zhags pa 'di/ /dgu tshigs rgyal mo bas kyang gzhung re ring / /bla med tshogs kyi mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ /bla ma yi dam lha la mchod par 'bul/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo'i thugasadam bskang / /mkha' 'gro chosaskyong

༄༅/ /rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /slob dpon rgyud kyi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang / /dam can rgyud kyi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang / /gtsug lag khang gi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang / /zhesadang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig cing / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo zhing rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rdo rje'i mched dang yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa thams cad dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'khoro dang bcas pa'i zhal du mā ra ya kha kha khā hi/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo sa pā ri bā ra/ ma hā ba li ta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta

khā hi/ skyes i rda ba kla griṇ+ḍa pā ya grihā pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ skye/ i rda ba l+la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyisa'abul lo/ /lha mo sgos rgyud kyi drang srong seng ge'i nga rosabastod pa/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don bsgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mjad/ /lha mo sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu speg cing keng rus lus can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid bye'i sku/ /ral pa gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil/ /skra ser sprul dang thod pa'i phreng thod can/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ /khrag gi chang gis ra ro spyan gsum dmar/ /mi ro rengs pa khar bcug mche ba

—༄7/ /bzhi/ /rnam par gtsigs nas khrag la shin tu dgyes/ /snyan g.yas sbrul gyi mgul nasadril bsil zhing / /gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrog ma/ /snyan cha g.yon pa seng ge ral pa dmar/ /dpal mo khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po ral gri phyar/ /'og ma bhan+ta rak+ta dmar skyil bkang / /g.yon gyi dang po shāka'i mtshon cha 'dzin/ /'og ma tri shāl mgul nasadar nag 'phyang / āḥ'i ral gri mtshon gyis bsad pa yi/ /lha ma yin gyi thod sogs do shal mdzad/ /glang po che yi ko rlan stod g.yogs mdzes/ /smad ni ba glang ko rlan dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser po'i sham bu dras/ /klu yi dbang po gshibs pa'i sked bcings mdzad/ /zhabs gnyisalcagasasgrog dag gisamadzes par brgyan/ /

khrag zhag me yi thig le tshom bur bris/ /bh+yoḥ bong bu gwa zhen mtshan mor dur khrod rgyu/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi shugs can ma/ /khams gsum skad cig gcig la bskor bar mdzad/ /gsung ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogasagashin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ /dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams mthar yang phyin/ /dbang phyug chen mo'i sku la dgyes 'khrul ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal bzhir byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugs dbyung brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams pham par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag

༄༅/ /byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab che dang 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pasaphyag byas ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem nus/ /sa 'og dbang po kun gyisaphyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin po'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing sngangs/ /tsit+ta rin chen gur phub gzhal yasakhang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dug gi bcud bsdusanas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnamasakyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong mdzad ma/ /de phyir nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'dus/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten

bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams rtsad gcod ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dus/ /gang zhig khyed la dad na ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma gcig nad bdag sman gyi gces/ /lha 31 khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ /de ni sku gsung thugs yonakon phrin las dang bcasapa'i bstod pa'o/ /zhesadangosagrub 'byung ba'i rgyud las so/ /dge bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ bh+yoḥ sngon 'das bskal pa dang po'i pha rol nas/ /dge bcu'i las la rang sems cher sbyangs nas/ /lam gyi khyad par gong ma rab rdzogs kyang / /mtho ris skyes pa rnams la dge bcu yi/ /tshul gyis don mdzad pha rol bsgyur ba yi/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /

༄7/ /'das pa'i dus na srog gcod rab spangs nas/ /sku tshe ring zhing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs/ /gzhan gyis lan chags gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral/ /'chi bdag 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byin len pa'i tshul rnams rab spangs nas/ /bsod nams tshogasakyis longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /gter gyi longs spyod mi 'grib rab brtan mnyes/ /sbyin pa'i gter 'chang khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gtsang spyod pa'i dka' thub rnam bsrungs pas/ /mngal gyi grong khyer smon lam khyad par 'phags/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags rab tu spangs pa ste/ /dge sbyong chen mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs rdzun tshig spangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /bka' btsan gsung gi dngos grub 'jig rten 'dul/ /gsung mchog rnam dag

mnyes pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bden par gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phra ma'i skyon spangs mi phyed 'khor dang ldan/ /nyid la rnam par 'dul ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /lha min bden pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar pa'i 'khor tshogs skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag 'chal spangs pa'i yon tan smin pa ste/ /ting 'dzin rtse gcig mi g.yo bar chad spangs/ /dgongs khrel tshul gyis bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ /byis pa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nga rgyal khengs sems spangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /zhi ba'i tshig 'jam lha mo dbyangs snyan ma/ /tshig rtsub gshe ba'i g.yen po mdzad pa ste/ /ngag rtsub 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brnab sems 'dzin pa spangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /nang gi rtog pa gnas dang bdag med phyir/ /

༄༅/ /snyan cha g.yon pa seng ge'i rna chas brgyan/ /brnab sems spangs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzung ba'i yul la gnod sems spangs pa yis/ /phyi rol yul 'di gnyis med chos su gzigs/ /kun la gnod sems spang phyir snyan g.yas na/ /sprul gyi snyan cha can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /log par lta ba'i chos spyod rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas chos las 'khrungasapa'i gzugs can khyod/ /lta ba rnam par dag pa'i ngang tshul can/ /spros bral don dam ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'di na las gnyis dag ma dag /ma dag mi dge bcu la ngan song sgrub/ /dag pa'i dge ba bcu la mtho ris thob/ /mi dge bcu po'i deng nas rab spangasanas/ /gong nas gong ma'i sa la rab gnas kyang / /dge bcu rtags 'di dman pa'i zhing 'dir

bstan/ /gdug pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad ma/ /bstod par 'os pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cesadapal ldan lha mo dud sol ma la/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis dge po'i sgo nasabastod pa mdzad pa'o// bh+yoḥ g.yu mtsho mer mo'i 'gram shed na/ /rlung 'tshubs dmar nag 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /srin po'i bong bu gu dmar ni/ /zhing chen rusapa'i mthur du byas/ /srin po'i ya 'gal snga ru la/ /ma 'gal dag gis phyi rnga khyas/ /sga g.yogs sprul nag gong smed byas/ /ru dra'i phru gu'i sga long can/ /de steng lha mo dud sol ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum 'khrol/ /zhabs gnyis btsan skyi' brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs g.yon du 'khyil/ /las su khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /gtsug na rma bya'i rgyal mtshan

༄༅/ /btsugs/ /thal chen tshom bus sku la brgyan/ /khrag zhag thig les zo ris bris/ /snyan g.yas sprul nag gdengs ka 'phyo/ /snyan g.yon seng ge ral dmar 'phyo/ /snyan gnyis gser gyi dril bu 'khrol/ /rna ltag me tog chun pos brgyan/ /sku stod glang chen zhing lpags gsol/ /sku smad re lde ser po dang / /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol/ /rin chen rus rgyan sprul gyis spras/ /mche ba zur gsum cung zad gtsigs/ /khro gnyer thod phreng se ral bcas/ /phyag g.yas ral gri me 'od 'phyar/ /'og ma thod rlon khrag bkang gsol/ /phyag g.yon shasti rma bya can/ /'og ma tri shul rtse gsum thogs/ /dpral ba'i dkyil nas zla gsal zhing / /lte ba'i khung nas nyi 'char ma/ /dbang gi lcags sgrog zhabs la gsol/ /bong bu'i steng

nas phyogs bcur gzigs/ /me dpung nang na 'gying bag bzhugs/ /shin tu sgeg pa'i cha byad can/ /srid pa'i ma mo khri phrag dang / /lasakyi ma mo khri phrag ni/ /drug cu rtsa bzhis rab tu bskor/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /dpalaldan lha mo dud sol lasrin pho rgyal po laṅka mgrin 'khodon gyi sgo nasabastod pa'o/ /bh+yoḥ sngon tshe dpag bsam byang chub shing gi drung / /rgyal ba thub pa chen po'i spyan snga sa /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i/ /khrag 'thung dud sol sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi yon tan stobs dang gzi brjid kyis/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba'i dbus/ /gtum zhing 'gying bag rngams pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam mi g.yo sku mdog shin tu gnag /klu rnams sdud phyir

༄༅/ /dbu skra sprul gyis brgyan/ /rigs lnga rnam dag thod skam lnga yis brgyan/ /thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag don rtogs thal chen tshom bus brgyan/ /dug gsum spong byed rma bya'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /dgra bgegs sgrol phyir khrag zhag thig le bris/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang dag phyir snyan g.yas sprul nag 'phyo/ /khams gsum sgra sgrogs snyan g.yon seng ges brgyan/ /snyan pa sgrogs phyir gser gyi dril bu 'phyang / /khams gsum skad cig khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bgegasa'adul phyir spyan gsum phyogasabacur gzigs/ /sha chen gsol phyir mi ro zhal du bcug /bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno gdug mche ba gtsigs/ /ma rungs rdul du rlogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid

don ldan zhing chen pags pa gsol/ /theg mchog sum ldan glang chen ko rlon brgyan/ /stong gsum grags ldan re lde'i sham bu dkris/ /smon lam rnam dag ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra srog gcod phyir phyag g.yas ral gri phyar/ /bdud khrag gsol phyir 'og ma thod rlon 'dzin/ /srid gsum sgrol phyir g.yon pas shasti bsnams/ /g.yul ngo bzlog phyir 'og mas tri shul 'dzin/ /chos nyid don rtogs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /lha min 'dul mjad thod rlon do shal byas/ /rdzu 'phrul ston phyir lcags sgrog 'bar bas brgyan/ /bdud dpung skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po 'dul phyir sprul pa'i bong bu'i chibs/ /stong gsum khyab phyir 'tshub ma'i nang na bzhugs/ /dur khrod gnas phyir sha za mang posabaskor/ /snang srid

༄za/ /dbang sdud gsung ni 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /rnam rtog sreg mdzad me dpung dbusan bzhugs/ /stobasachenadam tshig can laphyag 'tshal bstod/ /bh+yoḥ khyod kyi g.yas nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /dmar mo spyan gsum lcags kyi ral pa can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyusadagra bgegasasnying nasa'agugs/ /dam nyams 'ching byed zhags pa g.yon na thogs/ /stong gsum rgyugs phyir chibasasu bong bu chibs/ /drag mo 'gugs byed gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi g.yon nasasprul pa'i lasamakhan ni/ /nag mo spyan gsum khrag gi ral pa can/ /ma rungasagasod phyir phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar/ /gtso la stobs phyir tsit+ta g.yon na thogs/ /dur khrod chas brgyad chibs su bong bu chibs/ /dgra bgegasagasod byed gsum la phyag

'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi mdun nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /gcer mo spyan gsum dang ni mche ba can/ /gnod byed sun 'byin phyag g.yas dgra snying thogs/ /gdug pa skrag mdzad g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin/ /mkha' la rgyu phyir rlung gi bong bu chibs/ /dmar mo tsa mun ta la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi rgyab nas las byed pho nya ni/ /dmar nag phur pa'i lha mo re mā ti/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs gtum bag dre'u zhen/ /phyag g.yas ral gyis dam nyams srog rtsa gcod/ /g.yon pasalcags phur dgra bo'i snying la 'debs/ /nag mo thun khrag 'debs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro pho nya ni/ /sku la ba glang ko rlon dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser po'i sham bu dras/ /klu yi dbang po gshibasapa'i sked bcingasamadzad/ /

༄༅/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog dag gis mdzesapar brgyan/ /khrag zhag me yi thig le tshom bur bris/ /bh+yoḥ bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mor dur khrod rgyu/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi shugasacan ma/ /khams gsum skad cig gcig la bskor bar mdzad/ /gsung ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ /dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams mthar yang phyin/ /dbang phyug chen mo'i sku la dgyesa'abrul ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal bzhir byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnamasadabugs dbyung brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams

pham par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab che dang 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pasaphyag byas ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem nus/ /sa'og dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin pa'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing sngangs/ /tsit+ta rin chen gur phub gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i 'ji ga rten dug gi bcud bsdus nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong mdzad ma/ /de phyir

༄0//nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'dus//phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad//bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar pa'i phyogs rnams kyi//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams rtsad gcod ma//bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dus//gang zhig khyed la dad na ma bas byams//de phyir ma gcig nad bdag sman gyi gtso//lha mo khyod la bdag gisartag tu bstod//de ni sku gsung thugasabonas phrin lasadang tsos pa'i bstod pho//spyodangos grub yang ba'i rgyud las so//stag mo'i rngam sgra la/bh+yoḥsngon tshe dpag bsam byang chub shing gi drung //rgyal ba thub pa chen po'i spyan snga sa/bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar dam bcasapa'i//khrag 'thung dud sol sku la phyag 'tshal lo//khyod kyi yon tan stobasadangagazi brjid kyis//

ma mo mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba'i dbus/ /gtum zhing 'gying bag rngams pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam mi g.yo sku mdog shin tu gnag /klu rnams sdud phyir dbu skra sprul gyis brgyan/ /rigs lnga rnam dag thod skam lnga yis brgyan/ /thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yang dag don rtogs thal chen tshom busabargyan/ /dug gsum spong byed rma bya'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /dgra bgegs sgrol phyir khrag zhag thig le bris/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang dag phyir snyan g.yas sprul nag 'phyo/ /khams gsum sgra sgrogs snyan g.yon seng shes brgyan/ /snyan pa sgrogs phyir gser gyi dril bu 'phyang / /lams gsum skad cig khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bgegs

༄tsho/ /'dul phyir spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs/ /sha chen gsol phyir mi ro zhal du bcug /bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno gdug mche ba gtsigs/ /ma rungs rdul du rlogs la phyag 'chal lo/ /choganyid don ldan zhing chen pags pa gsol/ /theg mchog sum ldan glang chen ko rlon brgyan/ /stong gsum grags ldan re lde'i sham bu dkris/ /smon lam rnam dag ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra srog gcod phyir phyag g.yas ral gri phyar/ /bdud khrag gsol phyir 'og ma thod rlon 'dzin/ /srid gsum sgrol phyir g.yon pas shaghi bsnams/ /g.yul ngo bzlog phyir 'og mas tri shul 'dzin/ /chos nyid don rtogs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /lha min 'dul mdzad thod rlon do shal byas/ /rdzu 'phrul ston phyir lcags sgrog 'bar bas

brgyan/ /bdud dpung skrag par mdzad la phyag 'cha' lo/ /srin po 'dul phyir sprul pa'i bong bu'i chibs/ /stong gsum khyab phyir 'tshub ma'i nang na bzhugs/ /dur khrod gnas phyir sha za mang pos bskor/ /snang srid dbang sdud gsung ni 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /rnam rtog sreg mdzad me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /stobs chen dam tshig can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bh+yoḥ khyod kyi g.yas nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /dmar mo spyan gsum lcags kyi ral pa can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas 'gugs/ /dam nyams 'ching byed zhags pa g.yon na thogs/ /stong gsum rgyugres phyir chibs su bong bu chibs/ /drag mo 'gugs byed gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi ga yon nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /nag mo spyan gsum

༄༅/ /khrag gi ral pa can/ /ma rungs gsod phyir phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar/ /gtso la stobs phyir tsit+ta g.yon na thogs/ /dur khrod chas brgyad chibs su bong bu chibs/ /dgra bgegs gsod byed gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi mdun nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /gcer mo spyan gsum dang ni mche ba can/ /gnod byed sun 'byin phyag g.yas dgra snying thogs/ /gdug pa skrag mdzad g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin/ /mkha' la rgyu phyir rlung gi bong bu chibs/ /dmar mo tsa mun ta la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi rgyab nas las byed pho nya ni/ /dmar nag phur pa'i lha mo re mā ti/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs gtum bag dre'u shon/ /phyag g.yas ral gris dam nyams srog rtsa gcod/ /g.yon pas lcagasaphur dgra bo'i snying la 'debs/ /

nag mo thun khrag 'debs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro pho nya ni/ /sku mdog dkar ser dmar nag bong bu chibs/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan+dha bsnams/ /phrin las sgrub mdzad bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khrag 'thung nag mo'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i/ /shar nas las mkhan sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis seng ge'i gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /drel nag rkang gsum chibs nas phyogs bcur rgyugs/ /'gying zhing dgra bgegs rol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho nas dmar nag zhal gcig stag gi gdong / /dur khrod chagabargyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag rkang gsum chibs nasaganod byed kyi/ /khro zhing sha khrag rol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /

༄༅/ /nub nas sngo nag zhal gcig spyang zhi'i gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag rkang gsum chibs nas bgegs rnams 'jom/ khu1gas shing dgra sha rol la phyag 'chal bstod/ /byang nas mthing nag zhal gcig phag gi gdong/ /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag rkang gsum chibs nasa'abyung po'i sha/ /'dur zhing zhal du stobs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang shar mtshams nasasmug nag bya rgod gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag zhon nas dgra bgegs sha khrag rnams/ /rngams shing rngam zhing rol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khar lho mtshams nas mun mdog kyung rka'i gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag zhan nas bdud khrag ma lus

pa/ /'chang zhing 'chang zhing gsol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho nub mtshams nas khrag mdog dur bya'i gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag zhon nyams pa'i srog dang 'bral/ /rgod cing rgod cing 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub byang mtshams nas dud mdog bya rog gdong / /dur khrod chas brgyad gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dre'u nag zhon nas dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren/ /lding zhing lding zhing rol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /las mkhan pho nya nag mo rka ga'i gdong / /kun kyang mda' gzhu spu gri bhan+dha dang / /sbrul nag bhan+dha rgyu zhags nad rkyal bsnams/ /ma rung 'ching byed rnams la phyag 'chal bstod/ /zhing chen stod g.yogs re lde'i sham bu dkris/ /thod rlon do shal chibs su stag spyang dang / /spre'u dre'u

༄༅/ /nag zhen nasapho nya 'gyed/ /dgra bgegs sgrol byed bzhi laphyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhan yang las mkhan nag mo 'bum sde dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro bdud mo bye ba'i tshogs/ /nag mo gcer bu 'jigasashing skra shal ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyisagri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /stong khams ma lus sprin gyi tshogs ltar gtib/ /srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing khyed la zhu ba ni/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po brtser dgongs la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa dang / /bstan la rab dad dkar po'i phyogs rnams la/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab nad rnams zhi ba dang / /longs spyod tshe dang 'bru sogs 'phel bar mdzod/ /ma rungasasems 'dzin nag po'i phyogs rnams la/ /dug gi rlung busand kyis

gzir zhing slong / /khong khrag skyugs shing cho nges gnam du 'bod/ /smyo 'bog byed cing bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog /bstan pa srung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /zhes birlu pas mdzad pa'o/ /bh+yoḥ rgya mtsho'i slong nas me 'bar khyod/ /mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhag /rdzong dang dka' zlog nag mo che/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas ma/ /mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes/ /de la 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /sangasargyas bstan pa bsrung ba yi/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥ til mar gyis bskusalen bu gcig 'phyang ro nye'i rna chasasgeg cing cha lugs ma lus

༄tsho/ /'chang / /rgyab tu rkang sgrog lcagasalas byas pa gcig gis rang gi rkang pa mdzes par byas pa ste/ /gcer bu bong bu zhon nas 'gro ba 'di na rgyu ba de ni lha mo khyod yin te/ /bdag gis mdzesapar shes kyis gzhan ltas khyod kyi spyod pa mtsho chen don dag su yis shes/ /'khor ba 'jig pa'i tshe na mi lus dag las khrag dang zhag 'dzag dud pa 'thul ba na/ /lha mo mche ba mi bzad gtsigs pa khyod kyi zhal du 'gro kun skad cig tsam gyis zhugs par gyur/ /nag mo mi thod thogs pa khyod ni rnal 'byar sgrub po'i spyod yul can de dur khrode dgyes/ /khyod ni g.yon can mnan cing nad dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sel zhing mi zad dril yang sgrogs/ /khyod ni dpa' bo dag gi mgo ni cod pan legs spras g.yul du mtshon gyis bsad pa yi/ /

phreng ba thogs shing gar byed lag pa gnyen brkyang nub tshosache zhing klu dbang gshibs pa yi/ /ske rags 'ching zhing lag na mdung dang ral gri thogasashing khrag gi chang gis myos gyur pas/ /mig rtsa dmar por gyur cing mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu ba'i 'byung po phal cher rnams kyis mthor/ /ko rlon chan pas dras te brgyangs pa'i gos kyi na bza'i stod g.yogs smad ni re lde ser pos dkris/ /mi yi rgyu ma gsar pa'i sbubs kyis zhal gyi zla ba brgyan cing dril bu 'gram par 'khrol/ /lus ni snum gyis gsar du byugs shing khrag dang zhag mang 'dzag pa'i thig les tshom bu dkris/ /mi yi sha la so yis chem chem gcod byed thod pa can des bdag la skyong gyur cig /drag po drag mo mi bzad mi sha kha na thogs pa sngon chad ma byung khyod mthong nas/ /

༄7/ /ma mo rnams kyang skrag cing rtab la rngams pa 'don cing mig rtsa rig rig khyod la 'dud/ /nag mo bzang mo lus mdog nag cing bzod par dka' ba khyod la brgya byin la sogs kyang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bstod par byed cing gshin rje'i rgyal po nyid kyang 'dar zhing 'du bar byed/ /mi rnams dang ni 'gro ba ma lus 'jug btul bas na khyod kyi rna ba ya gcig la/ /brang gis 'gro ba'i gdengs ka stong dang ldan pa gcig gis rgyab nas khyod la rgyan du byas/ /ya gcig la ni seng ge mtshungs med 'phyang zhing rgya mtsho'i mtha' bskor sa gzhi ma lus gnon/ /steng nas 'byung ba'i 'od zer stong ldan de ni khyod kyi lte ba'i phyogasasu bzhag /bstod pa 'diganyisagazungs nasaphyung ba'o/ /de ltar bstad pa rnams kyi rjesasu/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi dhiṣ+ṭha ba dh+wa si ka ma la rak+ṣa

si hūṃ bh+yo/ gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ cesabargya rtsa brgyad dam yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla zhesargya gzhung du 'byung / de nas bzlasapa bya ba ni/ lha mo'i thugs rkar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ gi mthar/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ zhes snying po sngags phreng nag pos bskor bar gyur/rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros lha mo'i thugs gar phog thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te sngon gyi g.ya' dam gnyan po dran pas lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor dang dregs pa can thams cad kyi snying dar phog de dag gi rgyud bskul/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gartsa mo'i thugs shar bsdus/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngosagrub 'od zer sna lnga'i tshul du byung ba bdag nyid kyi thugs gar thim par gyur/ cesasnying po ci nusabazla/ rgya gzhung du/ /

da༅༅/ /de ltar byasapasabadunanamabastobazhi yis/ /lha mo gtso 'khor zhalamathong gsung yang thos/ /'bring gis nyamasadang tha masarmi lamaste/ /lusadang grib lta ra 'khor bsaci bsam 'grub/ slusagasungasapa bzhin no/ /de ltar bzlasapa'i mthar lag gnyisakhu tshur bcangasal / mdzub mo gnyisabasgrengasate kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag pa samache galtar byasate bdud rtsi bran la/ skyos bh+yo bha ta li bha ta li tshe/ zhesalan gsum brjod/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /ga tum mo mche gtsigasayi dwagasakha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ /gī li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcasapa sa /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /gsol cig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnasasu gnasapar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyisagrub par mdzod/ /bdag gi

las ni ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs mdzod cig /lha mo nag mo mthu mo che/ /'phagasam khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jig rten 'di na mthu rtsal che/ /bdag gis khyed la bstod lags na/ /bkra shis mchog grub sems bder gnas/ /yid myur rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan/ /ma mor byed cing 'ji ga rten skyod/ /dpal ldan brtan spyod rdzu 'phrul che/ /'thab mo g.yul las shin tu rgyal/ /gshin rje'i sring mo yin par ston/ /gos su zhing chen re lde bsol/ /spyan rtsa dmar la sdang mig can/ /spyan mig mthong na kun kyang dngangs/ /dad cing phyogasapa rnams sdud cing / /drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis ni/ /lha mo khyed la bdag gis bstod/ /rma bya'i sgro ni rgyal mtshan byas/ /rtag tu 'jig rten sdud par byed/ /seng ge stag dang spyang ku

༄༅//dang //phag dang 'ug pa bya rog sogs//rtag tu kun nas bskor bar byed//rdo rje dril chen 'brol bar byed//khyed la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal//bstan la gnod pa'i gdug pa kun//myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod//nyin dang mtshan tu bya ra mdzod//bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//grit+na grot+na sarba du/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa//phre sum̐ 'phro phaṭa swā hā/zhesabarjod la se golagadab cing gtor ma 'bul ba mos/'es paṇa chen nā ro pas gsungs so//tshogs mchod byed pa spro na//rje btsun mar pa yab sras brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar mar lugasargyud sde spyi'i tshogs mchod riga'adzin dgyesaston gyis tshogs mchod bya/sngags mchod kyi skabs su gong du smosapa'i gtor sngags kyisakhyad par du mchod dgosaso//tshogasakyi bskang shigasamajugatu pa mo'i bskarolagasabya dgobos//bskang gagasani/bh+yo/dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas//'das

dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol ba'i/ /chosaskyong srung ma dud sol ma/ /khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po ni/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gis bskang / /dam can srung ma 'dir byon cig /rnal 'byor dgra lha 'dir byon cig /'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang / /sgrub pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos thugasadam bskang / /ma dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi gtor mas thugasadam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang / /bstan pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /dgra bgegs sha dang nal bu'i sha/ /māṃ sa'i bye brag dpag med kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugasadam bskang / /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas

༄༅/ /yin pa'i phyir/ /ra nag khrag dang bya nag khrag /dgra bgegs khrag la sogs pa yi/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtshoba'ithugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegaba'igasur la rngams pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen dud pas thugs dam bskang / /chu dang tshal skyesame tog dang / /tsan+dan a ka ru sposadang / /dri bzang sbyar ba'i yon chab kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gro nas 'bras kyi bshosagatsang dang / /'bru rtsi zhun chen snang gsal sogs/ /phyi yi mchod pa rnam lnga yi/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim pa/ /ro bzang reg bya 'jam pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga yi/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /mi rta glang sogs sha lnga dang / /byang sems rgyungasapa rak+ta sogs/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa yi/ /gsang

ba'i mchod pas thugasadam bskang / /bza' ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /bsgos gtsang dmar gyis brgyan pa dang / /chang dang khur ba sgog btsong sogs/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /bong bu gwa dmar lug nag dang / /dar nag bhalji ma ral gyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rma bya nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / /nal bu'i rgyal mtshan bhanyu yis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ a mṛ ta dang myos byed bcud/ /dgra bgegs gri snying nal bu'i snying / /tsit+ta snying gis thugs dam bskang / /sku yi rten rja sa yin pa'i phyir/ /lugs sku 'dag sku bris sku dang / /dar sku sku 'bag la sogs kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi

༄༅/ /thugs dam bskang / /gsung gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rnga dang rdza rnga rnga chen dang / /'khar rnga dung dang cha lang dang / /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig dril bus thugs dam bskang / /phrin las gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir / /cang te'u sgra yisathugs dam bskang / /'jig rten dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i rnge'u chung thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin dang / /snying po 'dzab kyi bzlas pa yis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /bh+yo/ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis/ /'gugs byed ma dang gsod byed ma/ /las mkhan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /phrin las

rnam bzhi sgrub byed pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol byed pa'i/ /gdong can brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang / /nyams pa'i sha khrag za byed pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /drag po'i las la 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /nag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /dkar mo ser mo dmar mo dang / /ljang nag la sogs 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /bdud kyi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phyir/ /yang sprul bye ba'i thugs dam bskang / /mnyes pa'i rten dang ma nyams phud/ /tshogs dang mchod gtor rgya chen 'dis/ /'dod khams ma mo kun gyi gtso/ /'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /de ltar lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam

༄༅/ /bskang ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mkha' 'gro'i nyams chags byung ba bskang / /'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa zlog /ma mo'i dal yams byung ba zlog /gshin rje'i khram kha btab pa zlog bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod/ /ban+de'i byad kha slar la sgyur/ /sde brgyad gnod pa thams cad zlog /gzhan gyi rbad 'dre phur kha sgyur/ /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo keg zla keg thams cad sgyur/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog /bdag cag rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa skong gyur cig /mchog dang thun mong la sogasapa'i/ /dngos grub ma lusastsal du gsol/ /tshe dang dbang phyug spel du gsol/ /

dpal dang grags pa bsgrub tu gsol/ /'khor dang bstan pa bsrung du gsol/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ra mdzod/ /legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol/ /bsam pa sgrub la re ba skongs/ /mthu stobs skyed la dpung gnyen mdzod/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ra mdzod/ /gzhan yang yid la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyed kyis sgrub par mdzod/ /cesarngog kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/ /de nasabashags pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ /'gro ba'i don du sku mchog 'jigasapa la/ /ma lus khyad par gsal bar mdzad pa ni/ /nga rgyal dregs pa can rnam 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyaga'achal lo/ /'da' dka' rdo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /bsrung bar dmabacasasku yi dam tshig la/ /sku yi spyod pa tshul bzhin ma rtogs

༄༅/ /te/ /khams gsum khyab pa'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /rnal 'byor gdung 'tshob bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnams/ /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi gtong yang / /klong du gyur pa'i gomasashas rtsal chung bas/ /ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /thugs rjes ngesapar gzigs pa'i lha mo la/ /dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa ma bshams te/ /phongasasems dbang gis mchod pa'i rgyu chung ba/ /rdzong mo dka' zlog sku la bzod par gsol/ /ma gcig sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugasal/ /don dang mthun par tshul bzhin ma bris te/ /'phagasama'i thugs rjesagayel bar gyur pa rnams/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /bu yi tshul gyis rgyu yi dam tshig la/ /le lo gnyid dbang g.yeng brel gtam la sogs/ /

thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /thugs rjes chen posatshangasapar stsal du gsol/ /dngos grub nas ba'i rgyud lasagasungs so/ /bskang bshags grangs bsags pa ra mosan/ bh+yo/ rnam med dbyings kyi rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar/ /gsang ba mchog gi sbas pa'i ma mo sa /rnam thar gsum gyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba mo/ /skye med dbyings la rang byung mdangs shar te/ /rgyu rkyen las 'das rol pa chen mo'i sku/ /phyag rgya rnam pa kun ldan zil gnon can/ /dbyings kyi rgyal mo 'jigs mdzad khrag 'thung ma'i/ /rtsol sgrub las 'das rang bzhin grub pa'i lha/ /ma skyes gsal rdzogs sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i ye shesasgyu ma'i rten/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin dbyings su bskang / /bdud rtsi sman dang nyon mongasachags chen khrag /gdod

༄༅/ /nas rnam dag ye shes klong du bskang / /bde stong phyag rgya bcu drug dga' bsasbyor/ /zhing bcu'i dregasapa tshim pa gsum gyis bsgral/ /snang srid gzhi bzhengs dag pa'i sder chen du/ /ma bcos kun bzlums thig le gtor chen bsham/ /don dam lhan skyes bzhi sbyor rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rang byung rgyal mo nyag gcig don gyi lhar/ /bde stong rdo rje rol pa'i rtsal gyis bstab/ /rang bzhin bsrung med dam tshig sa ma ya/ /'gal nyams 'das ral kun rtog bag chags sprin/ /spang blang 'dzin med nam mkha' klong du dengs/ /gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /sna tshogs ma nges a 'thas grub pa'i mtha'/ /mtha' bral 'od gsal klong du sor chud cig /'dod khams rgyal mo'i thugs dam thig le dpal/ /mthu dang rdzu

'phrul thogs med rdo rje shugs/ /g.ya' dam gnyan po 'gyur med rdo rje rgya/ /rtag khyab lhun grub phrin las mi 'gyur gzer/ /e waṃ zung 'jug bka' babs bzhi ldan gyi/ /nges gsang sgrub brgyud snying po dgyes mdzad bstan/ /phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang ro snyoms mdzod/ /cesasgrub brgyud pagaso/ /de ltar bshags nas tshogasamachod phul ba sogs tshogs la longs spyod/ thugs dam bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ bh+yo/ ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / /bsgrub pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel/ /bod pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / sha khrag bzan du bor nas khyod sgrub bo/ /lus srog 'ben tu btsugs nas khyed sgrub bo/ /dam rdzasarten tu btsugs nas khyod sgrub bo/ /phug pa zhwa ltar gon nasakhyod sgrub bo/ /

༄༅/ /rnal 'byor bu ni gtsang shod nya bzhin nyul/ /dam nyams dgra ni gangs stod seng bzhin rgyu/ /sasteng 'di na bdag la mgon med pas/ /ma gcig dam can thugs rjes mi dgos sam/ /'khor gyi tshogs la bka' nan mi mdzad dam/ /dam nyams dgra la phrin lasami mdzad dam/ /lha mo mi pham yi dam srog gi lha/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha mo/ /nag mo chen po char sprin mdog /dpal ldan lha mo thugs dam can/ /rdo rje lcam gcig las mkhan ma/ /srog gcod nad btang bong zhon ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ /dam nyams kun gyi bdud gcod ma/ /dam tshig can gyi che 'dzin ma/ /legs nyes kun gyi stangs 'dzin ma/ /'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /thugs

dam gnyan po ma bsnyel bar/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsam pa yid bzhin bsgrub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /nad gdon sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang / /dgra bgegs gnod byed brlag par mdzod/ /'khor rnams pho nya da thong la/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dam nyams 'di/ /bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /lo dang zla ba ma bzhag par/ /zhag dang za ma nyid du sgrol/ /rgyun gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces rgyud tshig mtha' bsgyur dang yogaso/ /hūm̐ bh+yo ༷ srid gsum dur khrod gnas mchog nas/ /khrag chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /keng rusari rab

༄༅/ /'bar ba'i steng / /bam ro pho mo bsnol ba'i steng / /ma mo mkha' 'gra'i ded dpon che/ /mi sdug dud pa'i sol ba can/ /nag mo 'bar ba'i dus la bab/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang sha wa ri/ /nā ro mar rngog brgyud par bcas/ /spyan sngar khyod kyis khas blangs pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang / /rnal 'byor sgrub po skyong ba dang / /dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar byed/ /de lta'i khas blangasadam bcas pa'i/ /da lta dgongasasam ma ma'i tshogs/ /dam la gnas pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /bstan pa srung ba'i ma mo che/ /sgrub brgyud bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /snol 'byor bdag gi bka' srung ma/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi dgra lha mo/ /ma mo dud pa'i sol ba ma/ /thugs dam bskul lo las mdzod cig /bh+yoX aspyi dha ri'i snyems pa mo/ /

ma mo mched lnga'i dus la bab/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gro mkha' spyod ma/ /phyag brnyan tshogs kyi dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ zhing skyong ḍā ki kun gyi gtso/ /las mdzad sprul pa'i phra men ma/ /gtso mo'i bka' sdod drag shul can/ /ha ra sid+dhi'i dusal bab/ /bh+yoḥ ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /thugs dam gnyan po gnad nas bskul/ /ma g.yel dam lasam 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i las kyi dgra bgegs rnams/ /sod cig thul zhig sa ma ya/ /zhes thugs dam bskul la/ gtor ma la sman rag kyang bran la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma mo las mdzad 'khor dang bcas/ /drang srong khros pa'i zhal gdang zhing / /ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rngam tshul gyis/ /cadagra bgegs sha la kha raṃ /bā hi/ /dgra bgegs khrag la kha raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bgegs rus par kha raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bgegasasnying la kha

༄༅/ /raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bgegasaklad par kha raṃ khā hi/ /rkang dang khu bar kha raṃ khā hi/ /chu ser lpags par kha raṃ khā hi/ /nang khrol rnams la kha raṃ khā hi/ /don snying rnams la kha raṃ khā hi/ /snod drug rnams la kha raṃ khā hi/ /rgyus pa rtsa la kha raṃ khā hi/ /dug lnga'i phung por kha raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bo'i las tshogs bzhes nasakyang / /rnal 'byor shes pa ye shes lnga'i/ /ngo bo nyid du 'tshang rgya bar/ /ye shes ma mo khyod kyis mdzod/ /oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī sapa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ ma hā mo sa/ /rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ bod+dhi tsit+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gogator ma tso/ bh+yo/ 'jigs byed dud pa'i sol ba ma/ /ḍā ki pho nya lasamakhan tshogs/ /sgrub gnas gnyan po 'dir gshegs la/ /'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ kha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes/ /

bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa bzhes/ /dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes/ /phrin las bsgrubs pa'i gtang rag dang / /bcol ba'i las kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /byur dang dal yams dgra la phobs/ /dam sri 'byung po bgegs la bh+yo/ /chags chen rmi ltas mtshan ngan zlog /don brgyud snying po'i bstan pa srungs/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe yun du srings/ /bslab gsum 'dus sde phyogs bcur spel/ /ma g.yel rnal 'byor stangs 'grogs gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med mdzod/ /ces sgrub brgyud pas so// bstong bsdusani/ bh+yoḥ lha mo nag mo mthu mo che/ /'phags ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'jig rten 'di na mthu rtsal che/ /bdag gis gus shing bstod lags na/ /bkra shis mchog grub gter gnas ma/ /yid myur rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can/ /

༄༅/ /ma mor byed cing 'jig rten skyong / /dpa' brtan rtags spyod brtson 'grus che/ /'thab mo'i g.yul las shin tu rgyal/ /gshin rje'i sring mo yin pa'i rtags/ /gos su zhing chen re lde gsol/ /spyan rtsa dmar la sdang mig can/ /spyan rtsa mthong na kun kyang 'ad ra/ /dad cing phyogs rnams kun sdud cing / /drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis ni/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis bstod/ /rma bya'i sgro ni rgyan cha byas/ /rtag tu 'jig rten sdud par byed/ /seṅge stag dang sbyang zhi dang / /dom dred wa spyang 'phar ba sogs/ /rtag tu kun gyis bskor bar byed/ /rdo rje dril chen dkrol bar byed/ /khyod la bstod de phyarge 96tsal bache/da/ /cesargyud lasagasungasaso/ /bsnyen sgrub sogs dmigasabasal gyi skabs su ma gtogasogator chogatsam la 'di'i man mi dgos so/ /rjesakyi bya ba ni/ cho ga'i rim pa la

lhag chad nor 'byul du gyur pa bshagasashing kha skong ba'i byi ra du/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /ma tshang ba dang nyams pa sogs/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur pa/ /ḍā ki dam can tshogs la mthol/ /ces yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ badz+ra lwa su rā ga yā mi hūṃ/ zhes me tog dang bcas dam tshig gi lha mo dang / le shes pa dbyer med par rten rdzas dang / bris sku'i thugs dar bsdu ba'am/ gtor ma de nyid gshegs pa yin na/ badz+ra muḥ zhesasegolabatab pas/ sgrub pa po khyod kyis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bya'o/ /zhesazhal gyis bzhesanasa'akhor dang bcas pa sho dir gyis gyes par bsam nas/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugasal sogatsang sar bskyal lo/ /de nasamajug tu smon lam 'debs pa ni/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas grol ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba

༄༅/ /dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gi dgrol/ /da lta nyid du rjesabacol ba'i/ /lam de nyid la gnas par shog /cesapa gdan bzhi'i rgyud lasagasungs so// zhes me tog dang bcas 'am/ gtor ma de nyid gshegs poyin na/ baji/the/ཿ zhesase gol btab pas/ bsam nas/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la sa gtsang sar bskya'angalo/ de nas mjug tu smon lam 'debs pa ni/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas grol ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gi dgrol/ /da lta nyid du rjes bcol ba'i lam de nyid la gnas par sgo ga /ces pa gdan bzhi'i rgyud lasagasungasaso/ /bsngo ba bya ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur

du 'chang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnam/sa ston byed cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /bdag ni mngon par byang chub te/ /rang rig ye shes mngon gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung slad du/ /khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /bkrashisani/ dag pa mkha' spyod mchog gi gseng lam nas/ /gdod ma'i rgyal sar sku bsnye'i dpal brnyes pa'i/ /bka' brgyud rig 'dzin grub pa rgya mtsho yis/ /rab 'byams phrin las ston pa'i bkra shis shog /zab gsang rgyud sde'i gnyer gyi gtso mo ste/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis srid gsum dregs pa 'joms/ /'dod dgu phrin las bsgrub la thogs med can/ /khrag 'thung dud so pa lha mo'i bkra shis shog /'dod khams dbang phyug gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gar/ /'gugs byed

༄༅/ /gsod byed gsum dang mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /gdong can brgyad dang sgo ma bzhi la sogs/ /las byed mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /cesadang / gzhan yang shisabarjod kyi tshigs subacad pa ci rigasaspel lo/ /de 3 ra rgyalaba'ibastan srung mdo rgyud ma mo yongs kyi gtso mor gyur pa 'di nyid bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod sogasabyas pa'i phan yonal mo spyi rgyud me lte 'bar ma dang / sgos rgyud dngosagrub 'byung ba/ rje btsun mar tog gi gsung sgros sogs las rgya cher 'byung ba ltar/ bstan pa'i dpu'aphang mtho/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan tshugs/ bshad sgrub kyi 'du ba 'phel/ phrin las3ma bzhi 'grub/ bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba lachosaskyong gzhan lasamathu myur zhing stobasache/ khyad par thebatsun dgyesamadzad sprulapa 'i lo tsā'i bka' brgyud 'dzin pas bstan srung gcig chog 'gran zla dang bral ba ste/ paṇa chen na ro pa'i gsung las/ khyad par chosaskyong rnam gsum las/ /dud sol lha mo rgyud srung mchog /bu tsha yang tsha'i don du ni/ /lo tsā ba yisaspyan

drongs la//dusagasum ba kla ma chagasamadzod//mchog thun dngos grub 'di las 'byung //chu bo gaṅgā phan chad la //de snga med pa'i chosaskyong yin//lasaslar godagongasanyamagasu longs//zhesagatsigs su gdams par mdzad pasamanga' bdag mar pa lo tswa'i baspu'i brgyud 'dzin pa yin phyin chad chosasrung 'di nyid srog ltar gcesapar bsten dgosapar snang ngo //rigasakun khyababadag ston pa mas//rdo rje rgyud las yang bsngags shing //rgya garagrub pa'i slob dpon dang //bod kyi grub thob rig 'dzin gyis//gtsigasasu bsten cing yang mchod pa'i//'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma//thub bstan srung ba'i thu bo ste///rnga gi palagyisabaskrun gnasamin//nges gsang mar pa bka' brgyud kyi//don brgyud yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//bsre bslad mnol ba'i dri ma rnams//byi dor byed pa'i phyag brnyan mchog/'di ni nyi tshe'i rdzu'aphrul mkha' la rgyu ba yi//ko lang gdug pa'i dregs byed ma rungs min//'di ni stong nyid snying rje rang gzug kyi//stobasabacami 'jigs bzhi(gsargyal yum mchog/

ra༅༅//mdo rgyud rab 'byamasalhang po grub pa'i bcud//chos sku gseng lam 'od gsal phyag rgya che'i//phrin lasargya mtsho 'jig rten gsumakhyab te//don brgyud bstan pa 'bar ba'i dge legs shogagrub dbang stag sham rdo rje'i gdan sa chen po thub bstan chos 'phelanas/bka' brgyud bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mchod chog phyogasabasgrigasaganang ba'i skabasasaphrin chog rngams pa'i nga ro la'aphri snon ci rigasashig byas te rang gnas kyi spyil bu sgrub brgyud ñtsa nga lo can du bkod pas/dbyings kyi rgyal mosaphrin lasami zad parasbyin pa'i rgyur gyur cig///dge legs 'phel//

༄༅/ /rdo rje spun khro semasacan yongs la 'tshe/ /ma nyes log lta gang du 'grogs pa rnams/ /gtum po khyod kyis tshar gcod brlag par mdzod/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cesa'ajig rten mgon pos mthad/ pa'o// sto yum gyi brnyed pa/ bh+yoḥ lha mo dus mtshan re ma ti/ /e ka dza ṭi ral gcig ma/ /phyag bzhi ma la 'jigs ma ste/ /phyag g.yas ral gri tri shu la/ /g.yon pas mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin/ /ral

pa'i phur bu sal drud/ /sku mdog nag mo dre'u zhen/ /yang 'khor ma mo bye bas bskor/ /brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /rmi lam ngan sogasazhi ba dang / /lo skag zla skag thamasacad bzlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod// sto da4pobazhi ma/ bh+yoḥlha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ /dbang phyug sras mo dkar mo dung skyong ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad/ /lha mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do// bh+yoḥ klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo dpal 'bar ma/ /gtsug na rin chen bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /rol pa'i mtsho bdun gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad/ /klu mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do/ /bh+yo gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma/ /gang ba bzang po'i bu

༄༅/ /mo shing grib can/ /nags tshal drwa ba can gyi gtso mo mdzad/ /gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do/ / bh+yo bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo dpal 'bar ma/ /re lde mgo nyag bu mo re ma ti/ /bdud mkhar rtse dgu gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad/ /bdud mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cesapa 'di rgyudanasabyung ba'o/ /dge'o//
— — — — ———— — —— — ——— — — — —— ——— — —— — — — — —— — — — — dzha — rna ————————— kro sgo/ /bstan srung a phyi'i rgyun gsol wen las myur mgyogs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /— ———— — — — —— —— — ——
/mchod pa/ bdun pa mchad pyi ju sa bcol ba'o// lko mchad dharma swa bha wa shud+dhi3hi 'i sa bon las ram̐ yam̐ /

byung mchod rdzas ma da ga pa'i dngos po bsregs/ yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags ngan pa thams gcad gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung gnis 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/slar yang traṃ 'phros te/ traṃ rat+na tre+e lo kya bh+rūṃ/ cesapas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i ma chod rja sa 'jig rten gyi /bams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥlhaḥgasum gyis/ zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon bka' srung ribar bcas dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi /khyab par gyur/ ces ngamegs pa/ oṃ badz+ra a: blo'ihūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pās raXhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pa/ a hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥlha/snye oṃ baju kyis spo ke 0sna// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe atihūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi rdu āḥlha/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta ruhuhūm̐/ oṃ 25 pa badz+ra āḥ&/ oṃ shap+ta badz+ra tsosahūm̐/ oṃ garnye badz+ra tsotshohūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badz+ra bye〉lha/ oṃ sparnye badz+ra āḥ&/ ma hā bo d+dhi tsit+ta sarba pa/ñtsa a mṛ

༄༅/ /ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ ma hā ba li ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhesabyin gyisabarlabs pa'i rol mo sgrog cing / / mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang chen po rab tu 'bar zhing brjid pa'i klong du/ rang rang gi rten gzhon pa dang bcas pa'i steng gi dbus su/ ma gcig dpal ldan dbyings phyug chosakyi sgrol ma 'khor dang bcasapa/ shar du drag byed las kyi mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcasapa/ lhor ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gtsug na nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa/ nub tu dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa/ byang du las mdzad dbang gi mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa/ rang rang gi tshul dang mthun pa'i sprul pa 'khor 'bum sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyang sku mdog dang gzhon pa ma nges pa du mar ldan

zhing phyag mchan sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis bka' srung dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te spyan drangs par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ dang po bzhengasasu gsol ba ni/ / kye dgung sngon dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /nam mkha' mthing gi khang bzang nas/ /chos kyi sgrol ma sku bzhengs shig /shar phyogs dbyings kyi sgo phye las/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /lho phyogs dbyings sgo phye las/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /nub phyogs dbyings kyi sgo phye las/ /dam tshig mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /byang phyogs dbyings kyi sgo phye las/ /dbang gi mkha' 'gro sku

༄༅/ /bzhengs shig /sku gsung thugs gyi las mkhan ma/ /las byed ma gsum sku bzhengs shig /yon tan 'phrin las gter gyi mdzod/ /snying skul spu gri sku bzhengs shig /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og nas/ /sprul pa'i ma tshogs sku bzhengs shig /gnyisapa ni/ / hriḥ rang bzhin ye nas lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /ma skyes gsal rdzogs gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i bstan srung ni/ /ye shes las la sprul pa'i ḍā ki ma/ /bka' dang dam laganasapa'i srung mamachog /chosakyi dbyingasalasasgyu ma'i sku sprul pa/ /ye shesa'ajig rten tshul 'dzin sprul 'khor bcas/ /thugasadam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /nam mkha' mthing bzang g.yu 'od 'bar ba'i klong / /khyad par mu le mthing brag gter sgrom

nas/ /che zhesachen mo a phyi sna nam bza'/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegasasu gsol/ /ye shes dbyings las sgyu ma'i skur bstan pa/ /las dang ye shes dam tshig dbang gi lha/ /rang rang rigs mthun rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung phyir/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor gdung ba'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /'bod rdzas cod pan g.yab mo lings se ling / /mchod gtor dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dam gtsang gnas 'dir dam tshig sa mā dza/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho/ a la la ho/ e h+ye hi bha ga wan ā dar+ṣa ya sa ma ya dza/ gsumapa ni/ / hrīḥ dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /thod mkhar rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ /pad+ma nyi zla baṃ chen gdan steng du/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gnyis

༄༅/ /med brtan par bzhugs/ /gnod byed gdug pa zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /za byed las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhugs su gsol/ /tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhugs su gsol/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang byed dam tshig mkha' 'gro bzhugs su gsol/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lasamadzad dbang gi mkha' 'gro bzhugs su gsol/ /yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshe dpal rgyasabyed lha mo bzhugs su gsol/ /'phrin las drag po e yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bstan srung mkha' 'gro 'khor bcasabazhugs su gsol/ /dharma tā ra dzñā na lo ka ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bzhipa ni/ oṃ dharma tā ra dzña na lo

ka ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wa ra na mo na ma/ lngapani/ hrīḥ dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang / /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying pa'i bar/ /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' ste/ /rtag tu khyod nyid sgrub cing mchod/ /khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /rtag tu bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /dam tshig gnyen po'i chad pa yis/ /rdo rje dmyal ba chen por lhung / /de bas dam lasam 'da' bar/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog la rol/ /sa ma ya ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta na rakan/ /drugapa ni/ / e shwa ri dharma tā ra sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ mdze ḍā zhi ni sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ sa ma ya ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta /khā hi/ oṃ wa sh+lau ḍā

༄༅/ /ki nī sapa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ dzñā na lo ka ḍā gi ni sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhesabadud rtsi khrul/ nyon ba ni/ / hriḥ dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /gtsang zhing yid 'ong dag pa'i gnasamachog 'dir/ /rin chen 'od 'bar nor bu bcal du bkram/ /lha rdzas yol ba bla bre 'phan gdugs bshams/ /rin chen nor sna spyan gzigs 'byor pas dkrigs/ /ro mchog bcud ldan zhal zasasna tshogs dang / /btung dang ldag gzhib bye brag mtsho ltar bskyil/ /mdangs ldan me tog sna tshogs rab tu bkram/ /ngad bzang sha chen bsreg sposasprin ltar gtibs/ /snang gsal zhun gyi mar me 'od du 'bar/ /dri bzang bcud ldan chab kyi bye brag gtams/ sha lnga bdud rtsi ldan

pa'i zhal zas tshogs/ /gzhan yang spyan du mdzesashing snyan dbang mchog /tshims pa'i dbyangasadang rol mo sna tshogs dang / /sbyar ba'i dri dang ljags su bstar ba'i ro/ /sku la reg 'jam byang sems don gyi mchog /'chi med ye shesabadud rtsi lha yi bcud/ khri/ rkyen sbyar ba'i rak+ta lku 'phreng 'khrigs/ /rab mdzes dpal gyi gtor ma brjid cing che/ /gdug can bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus kyis mchod/ /'bod pa'i dam rdzasagayab dar sngon po dang / /bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas dkor mdzod nor dang bcas/ /phyi yi rten rdzas 'bri sngon shel gong lug /rta mchog sngon pho 'brong chen rgya bong bcas/ /nang gi rten rdzas khrung khrung rgyal mtshan dang / /gsang rten gser g.yu 'bru sna leb brgan dar / /sku gzugs sba lcag srog 'khor sku yi rten/ /'dzab dang

༄༅/ /bstod dbyangs snyan phreng gsung gi rten/ /dri med dngul dkar me long thugs kyi rten/ /bzang drug sman sna dar zab yon tan rten/ /rol mo sil snyan sgra sgrogs 'phrin las rten/ /rtag rgyun ba ling gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /dam tshig nyams chags thams cad sor gsol la/ /yid smon mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus myur du stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /brgyadapa bstod pa ni/ | ka ma lo 'dab rgyas pa'i ge sar dbus/ /kha ba'i mdog mtshungs dpal ldan dbyings phyug zhal/ /ga zhe dang bral mtshan dpe'i smin legs ma/ /nga bdag dregs pa'i dgra 'joms dpa' mor 'dud/ /ca co ma rungs smra ba'i gdug can tshogs/ /cha lugasarnam pa du ma'i cho 'phrul

gyis/ /ja sogs ro la sred ldan 'du ba'am/ /nya mo lcagasakyusa'agugs mtshungs de la 'dud/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /tha dad mos pa'i bye brag sna tshogs su/ /da dung sprul pa'i snang brnyan mi zad pas/ /na ra'i 'jig rten 'dul bar mdzad la bstod/ /pa sangs lta bur zhi ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /pha rol gnod byed gdug sems pham mdzad cing / /ba spu'i dbyings las sprul pa'i tshogs spros te/ /ma lus sems can bde bar 'god la bstod/ /tsa ri ṭa sogasoganas gsum zhing skyong zhing / /tsha rngams mi bzad rnam 'gyur drag po yis/ /dza lang brnyas byed log lta ru trore sde/ /wa skyes la ni seng ge ji bzhen du/ /zha la'i ngos tsam bris pa'i sku la ni/ /za ma gcig tsam mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus/ci /'a cag 'dod

༄༅/ /pa'i dngos grub sbyin no zhes/ /ya mtshan mchog gyur bka' srung rgyal mor 'dud/ /ra ba thar med srid pa'i grong khyer nas/ /la la tsam las grol bar ma mthong na/ sha stag sdug bsngal gyis mnar sems can kun/ /sa mchog bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /ha cang gsol ba'i yugasu ma mchisakyang / /a la la zhes ya mtshan mchog gyur pa'i/ /'dod pa'i 'brasabu yid smon gang mchisapa/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pasa'agrub par mdzod/ / / hri/ rnam mang mkha' 'gro rgyu skar 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /rnam dkar nya rgyas zla ba tshes 'dra'i zhal/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo khyod/ /rnam dpyod snyan tshig phreng ba'i dbyangasa'adis bstod/ /kun+da zla phreng rgyasapa'i ge sar dbus/ /ma rungs sems ldan bsgral ba'i dbugs

bral steng / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i 'od phreng klong / /gsal stong chu nang zla 'dra lha ma'i sku/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan phreng 'chang / /sna tshogs legs nyes stangs 'dzin me long g.yas/ /sna tshogs dngos grub kun stsol yid bzhin g.yon/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'gro 'dul chos kyi sgrol/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir tsa ri ṭa sogs kyi/ /gnas kun nyul ba'i sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'jig rten ma mo'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /bstan dgra rab 'joms bstan srung chen mor 'dud/ /de ltar dbang po grangs ldan 'dis bstod pas/ /bud+dha'i bstan pa rin chen rgyas pa dang / /nā gārdzu na gnyis pa 'bri gung pa'i/ /chos dang rigs brgyud slob 'bangasadapal snyan grags/ /dbyar mtsho yar ngo'i d+me ltar 'phel rgyas shog /ces bstod/

༄༅/ /bh+yoḥ rin chen las grub rab gsal gzhal yas su/ /bdud bgegs ru ṭa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /hri las byung ba'i dpal ldan chos kyi sgrol/ /'gro ba'i gnyen mchog ma la bdag bstod do/ /sprosabral chos kyi dbyingasalas ma g.yos kyang / /brtse ba chen po'i 'gro la rab dgongs te/ /sna tshogs sprul ba sgyu ma'i gzugs bzung nas/ /snang srid dbang sdud ma la bdag bstod do/ /khyod zhal rab dkar zhi ba'i mdangs 'phrog gi /zla ba'i gzi brjid rnam pa 'phro ba bzhin/ /'dzum zhing mdzes pa'i 'gying bag dang ldan ma/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad ma la bdag bstod do/ /dus gsum thogs med spyan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /gsal dwangs dngul dkar me long g.yas na bsnams/ /yid bzhin re skong nor bu g.yon na 'dzin/ /dgos 'dod

kun 'byung ma la bdag bstod do/ /sku la lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /dung thod rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyisabargyan/ /bdud bgegs 'byung po ma lus bran du 'khol/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /khyad par 'bri gung gtsug lag khang chen du/ /bstan par bzhugasanas chosamadzad sgrub pa po'i/ /bsam pa'i don bsgrub mi mthun phyogs las skyobs/ /bar chad kun sel ma la bdag bstod do/ /ma gcig drag po'i las la bskyod pa'i tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang chu rta sngon po bcibs/ /glog 'gyu tsam gyis stong gsum khyab par nyul/ /bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad ma la bdag bstod do/ /phyag g.yas stong nyid ḍā ru drag tu khrol/ /g.yon pas snying rjes bdud khrag zhal du gsol/ /mi rkang gling bus ma tshogs dbang du

༄tsho/ /bsdus/ /ma rungs sgrol mdzad ma la bdag bstod do/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bshigs pa dang / /bla ma la smod chos 'khor 'joms pa'i dgra/ /rang bzhin ma rungs gdug pa'i sems ldan gang / /ma lus myur du bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i spyan snga sa /rgyud srung dam can skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /sdig can gzugs phung sha khrag gtor ma 'di/ /gsol lo rol cig 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /cesasto ra dzasasbyar ba'o// hūm̐/ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha gi na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs ya gi na/ /gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba/ /mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma/ /de la brten pa'i lha mo ni/ /gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /'khor ni 'jig rten sman mo bzhi/ /mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang ni/ /mi g.yo blo

bzang ma dang bcas/ /cod pan mgrin bzang ma dang ni/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang bcas/ /gtso 'khor thams cad mtshan nyid mthun/ /sku la dang dkar ral gu gsol/ /so so'i phyag mtshan phyag na bsnams/ /brtan ma bcu gnyisakhyod kyi 'khor/ /rdzu'aphrul chen po mnga' bas na/ /bdag gis gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyis/ /mchod gtor bzhes la dngos grub stsol/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal/ /bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ /snang gsal pra yi dngosagrub stsol/ /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ /rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ /che btsan mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ /rje btsun chen po'i spyan snga sa /khas blangs bzhin du dam la 'dus/ /rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par

༄༅/ /mdzod/ /cesapa 'di bas pa rdo rjesamadzad pa 'o// //rme nyer brgyad pasamadzad pa'i bskang ba ni/ skong rdzasarnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dhinyunya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du skong ba'i yo byad ri rab bas dpang mtho ba/ rgya mtsho bas gting zab pa/ khor yug bas rgya che ba/ gling bzhi bas bkod legs pa/ nyi zla bas mdangs gsal ba/skar phran bas grangasamang ba/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / skong rdzas sgrub rdzas rten rdzas la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di/ chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes kyi sgrol ma/ dam tshig gi sgrol ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul

'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs mchog gnyen po'i rgyud yongs su skong ba'i yo byad sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang zhig khyab par gyur/ paradamigs/ oṃ badz+ra arnya a'ihūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pus gitshohūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pu/ gi'i hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lhu paṃ yisahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke gisahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra garnye gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai li hūm̐ āḥ// oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥ&/ oṃ ru pa badz+ra āḥlha/ oṃ shap+ta badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ garnye badz+ra ukhyihūṃ/ oṃ ra sa badz+ra u3/ oṃ sparnye badz+ra yā hūm̐/ hūṃ bh+yo/dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgrol/ /bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /gshegs shig bu yi gnas 'dir gshegs/ /bu yi sgrub gnasadam pa 'dir/ /khyod la mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /gtor ma 'bru bcud sna lngas rgyan/ /gser skyems bdud rtsis bran pa 'dis/ /chosakyi

༄༅/ /sgrolama'i thugasadam bskang / / hūm̐/ chosakyi sgrol ma thugs dam can/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /'bul lo mthun rdzas sna tshogasa'abul/ /mchod do ma sring mkha' 'gro mchod/ /bcol lo 'phrin las rnam bzhi bcol/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul so sor bshags/ / hūm̐/ chos kyi sgrol ma thugs dam can/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugasadam bskang / /dpal ldan lha mo 'bod pa'i phyir/ /mda' dar sngon pos thugs dam bskang / /a phyi chen mo bzhugasapa'i phyir/ /dkor mdzod nor gyis thugs dam bskang / /rten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐/ dpal ldan chos sgrol 'khor dang bcas/ /rta sngon 'bri sngon lug sngon dang / /mthun rdzas sna tshogs dkor gyi nor/ /phyi yi rten gyis

thugs dam bskang / /khrung khrung dkar mo'i rgyal mtshan phyar/ /nang gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /gser g.yu 'bru sna leb brgan dar/ /gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /sku gzugs sba lcag sku yi rten/ /sku yi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /'dzab dang snying po gsung gi rten/ /gsung gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /dngul dkar me long thugs kyi rten/ /thugs kyi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /bzang drug sman sna yon tan rten/yon tan rten gyis thugasadam bskang / /rol mo dbyangs snyan 'phrin las rten/ /phrin las rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐/ ma gcig dpal ldan chosakyi sgrol/ /snyan gragasaphyi nas spel ba'i phyir/ /phyi yi mchod pasathugs dam bskang / /'phrin las rgyun du bcol ba'i phyir/ dzen gtor nar mas

༄༅/ /thugasadam bskang / /mi 'bral rgyun du 'grogs pa'i phyir/ rten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo mchod do thugasadam bskang / /chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugasadam bskang / /yid 'ong lha mo'i thugs da ma bskang / /srid gsum dbang sdud thugasadam bskang / /tshogasaganyisardzogasamajad thugasadam bskang / /phrin lasabazhi ldan thugasadam bskang / /yi da bzhin bsam 'grub thugs dam bskang / /dpal ldan snang/sgrol thugs dam bskang / /bka' srung chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /spyan gyi dbang po tshims pa'i phyir/ /gzugs mchog yid 'ong thugs dam bskang / /snyan gyi dbang po tshims pa'i phyir/ /sgra snyan rol mos thugs dam bskang / tanangs kyi dbang po tshimasapa'i phyir/ /bdug spos

ngad kyis thugs dam bskang / /ljags la ro mchog 'bul ba'i phyir/ /lha bshos gtsang mas thugs dam bskang / /sku yi rgyan du 'bul ba'i phyir/ /reg 'jam bde bas thugs dam bskang / /thugs mchog bskang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /chos nyid bde bas thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nang gi longs spyod spel ba'i phyir/ /mo sa rak+ta su ra ta/ /snying po 'dzab kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /a phyi chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /khyed dang rnal 'byar bdag cag gnyirā/ dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /kye/ gson dang dpal ldan chos kyi sgrol/ /grogs la gzhung ngan mi srid kyis/ /byams la drin med ga la srid/ /sngon gyi bka' las ma

༄༅/ /'da' bar/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /rbad na lha mo rtsal ma zhan / /bos na lha mo snyan ma sra/ /ma ltar bsnyen no thugs ma ring / /sring ltar bsten no rgyang ma ring / /grogs mor bsten no gzhung ma ngan/ /le lo phyed de ma mdzad cig /rgyang nge ldem me ma mdzad cig /mnyes pa'i zas gcig bu yis 'dren/ /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu ma yis byin/ /mthun pa'i rdzas gcig nga yis 'bul/ /mdza' ba'i sems gcig ma yis zungs/ /lasakyi gnyer gcig khyod la zhu/ /mthun pa'i gtam gcig sring gisasmos/ /khyod dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/ /bskal pa zhig kyang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /lhod de rgyang nge ma mdzad cig /brtse gdung sems ni ci cher mdzod/ /mthustobs rdzu 'phrul ci yod ltar/ /le lo snyom las ma mdzad

cig /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu ma mdzad cig /bdag gi dpal dang mgon mdzod cig /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /drag po'i las kyis myur du sgol/ /bdag gi lha tshogs mchod pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i longs spyod bdag la stsol/ /bdag gi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /ma khyod kyis myuzlo du bsal du gsol/ /rta dang glang po 'bru bang mdzod/ /'byar ba phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /gser dngul nor bu'i tshogs dag dang / /rin chen dbyig rnamasathob par mdzod/ /'bor dang rigs rgyud spel ba dang / /bu dang tsha bo 'phel bar mdzod/ /tshe ring nad med bde ldan zhing / /bgegs dang gnod pa med par mdzod/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo dbyings phyug mas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /'dzad med gter gyi dngos

༄༅/ /grub stsol/ /snyan grags chos kyi dngos grub stsal/ /srid srung rigs rgyud dngos grub stsol/ /mdzod ldan nor gyi dngosagrub stsol/ /rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ /che btsan mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ /bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /sa lam bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi la na tsha ma gtong zhig /phyugs la god kha ma gtong zhig /zhing la btsa' sad ser gsum ma gtong zhig /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bsgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon

du bsgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur/ /sdang ba'i dgra la rtags phyung zhig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha zlog tu gsol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / hrī/ bstan srung chen mo 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /phyi rten 'bri sngon shel sgong lug /rta mchog 'brong chen rgya bong bcas/ /nang rten khrung khrung rgyal mtshan dang / /gsang rten gser g.yu 'bru sna dar/ /sku rten sba lcag srog 'khor sku/ /gsung rten 'dzab dbyangs bstod pa bcas/ /thugs rten dngul dkar me long dang / /yon tan rten du bzang drug sman/ /dar zab sna tshogs rgyan dang bcas/ /'phrin las rten du rol mo'i tshogs/ /'bod pa'i rten du g.yab dar dang / /phyi mchod sna lnga mdzes shing brjid/ /

༄༅/ /nang mchod sman raka gtor ma bcas/ /gsang mchod bde chen dga' bde rol/ /spros bral gnasalugs don gyis mchad/ /bskang ngo bska9 4 ba'i thugs dam bskangs/ /bskang gyur dngos grub rnams gnyis stsol/ / hriḥ bstan srung 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sku gsuḥ ri thugs yon phrin las phyi nang gsang / /spyi dang khyad par bsrung bya'i dam tshig rnams/ /bdag cag rmongs pas don 'khrul 'gal nyams pa/ /nongs pa gang bgyis 'gyod pa'i sems drag pos/ /rab tu bshags so bzod par bzhes nas kyang / /sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa u3/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ zhes pa 'di rje chagakyi grags pa sa mdzad pa'o// / bh+yo/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug la/ /ban+de bla ma dam tshig nyams/ /skye bo

khrel dang ngo tsha bor/ /de'i tshe ma mo thugs khros nas/ /nad mug 'khrugs gsum sprin ltar g.yo/ /de dag khyed kyi cho 'phrul te/ /de phyir dam rdzas gtor bdud rtsi/ /rten bskang sgrub pa gsum gyi rdzas/ /ma mo 'khrugs pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i mthus/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zlog tu gsol/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zlog tu gsol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bdag gzhan mi shes le lo yis/ /sa lam bsgrod la 'gal ba rnams/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis sgordzog /nongasazugags ni/ hrīḥ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /ye nas ma bcos khyab bdal chen po'i ngang / /dug

༄༅/ /lnga ma spangs 'bras bu lhun grub la/ /gnyen po log sgom lam du ma khyer bshags/ /bstan srung ḍā ki 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs/ /log rtog 'brul 'dzin dbyings su ro gceg dngos/ /bka' srung mkha' 'gro'i 'phrin las yin pa la/ /rang ngo ma shes 'dod pas sgrib pa bshags/ /'phrin las sha za mkha' 'gro 'bor bcas dgongs/ /zhi ba dul med mnar med sdig ltung can/ /stong nyid snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig la/ /chags sdang dbang gis rgyu 'bras khyad bsad bshags/ /srung med srung tshul dam tshig bka' yi rgya/ /'da' med 'da' tshul snang ba ji snyed kun/ /bshags med bshags tshul 'gyod tshangs drag pos bshags/ /tshangs bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ dharma tā ra sa ma ya ma nu
