pā la ya/ dharma tā ra twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ su poṣ+ṭha me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yasmo sarba garma su tsa me/tsisto shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga ldan sarba ta thā ga ta/ dharma tā ra mā me mus dharma tā ra bha wa/ ma hā sam ya sa twa gis zhesabarjod/ dgu ba 'phrin las bcolabani/ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni yeḥ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig bka' srung ma'igasolakhagatongabar 'dod pasamachod gtaragyi yo byad sta gon dang ldan pasastanabade ba la'adugaste/ skyabasasu 'gro ba dang sems bskyed la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dhi3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming

༄༅/ /yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par dmigasal/ oṃ badz+ra arnya sa/ cha badz+ra pas ā ༷// oṃ badz+ra pu/ gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke gisahūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra garnye u// oṃ badz+ra ni wi bye gisahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta hūm̐/ byin gyisarlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shurnyo3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung /ram̐ lasame'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kai lasami mgo'i skyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i snyalas thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang

du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi dang gtor ma 'dod yon gyi longs spyod bsam gyisami khyab par gyur/ cesadamigasal/ bad bskor gyisaphyag rgya dang grelate/ yosa3ha hoḥhrīḥ ga gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangasaḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas/ /bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhesagadan 'bul/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā gī ni sa pa ri wā ra arnya pathu puspro dhu paṃ a lo ke garnye ni li hūm̐ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhesadang / mahwa.a mṛ ta khā hiḥ zhesabadud rtsi 'bul/ dngosagazhi ni bsnal

no༅༅/ /zan phud skyemasagator mar mtshams su sbreng zhing rol mo dang bcas pa thog mar bshams la'adi skad do/ / hoḥ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings gdal ba chen po'i zhing khams lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang bkod pa mchog gi rgyan gyis spras pa'i gnas 'dir/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa kun gyi spyi dpal dam par gyur pa/ dpal mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i sku can/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha lugs 'dzin pa'i ston pa rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi skur snang ba rnams dang / thugs rje chen po'i rang rtsal 'gags pa med pa'i 'khor sems dpa' dang sems ma/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro/ zhi ba dang khro bo'i cha lugs 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma yi dam

dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyisabazhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin gnasapa'i dbyings las thugs rje ye shes kyi skur bzhengs te smin grol mchog gi dngosagrub stsol bar mdzad pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sna nam bza' dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ a mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ g.yung drung rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' dbang phyug/ pe ka dbang rgyal/ bsod nams dpal/ ka thung gru bzhi/ mkhan po dar ma/ dkon mchog rin chen/ btsun pa 'bar/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ dbon bsod nams gragasapa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ thog kha ba rin chen

༄༅/ /seng ge/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po/ bshesaganyen don grub rgyal po/ bdag po wang / chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga'i mtshan can/ rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po/ mtshungasamed chos rgyal phun tshogs/ bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun dkon mchog rat+na/ khyab bdag rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma rā dza/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/ dpal ldan mgar

chen po/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma/ khyab bdag 'khor la'i mgon po bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ bka' drin mnyam med chos kyi rgyal mtshan/bstan 'dzin byang chub dbang po/ khri chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rin chen bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ rje btsun thugs rje nyi ma/ mtshungs med dharma ma ṇi/o rgyan nus ldan rdo rje/ 'dren mchog zhi ba'i blo gros la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang/rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa'i yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang zung du 'brel ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / khyad par du dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad bskyed par

༄7/ /mdzad pa'i yum chen mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gra'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ zag med ye shes kyi bcud dang ldan pa'i mchod gtor dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'bul lo gsol lo/ mchod do/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis yongasasu rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis bag chagasadang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyasakyi go 'phang rin po che thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyisapa ni/ | hrīḥ dbyings phyug dpal ldan chos kyi sgrol ma/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan pa/ /zhi mdangasacung zad khro ba'i nyams can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'od zer 'phro ba/ /dbu la dung thod rin chen brgyan pa/ /dar sna'i

cod pan rab tu 'phur ba/ /dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings shing / /sku la lha rdzas na bza' klubs pa/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ru 'khrol bas/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud cing / /g.yon pas thod khrag zhal du gsol bas/ /gnod byed gzugs phung rnam shes 'phrog pa/ /zhabs gnyis drag shul chen po'i stobs kyis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ /chibasasu cang shesagro sngon bcibs pas/ /mgyogs pa'i bang gis stong gsum bskor ba/ /dar gdan gser sga g.yu mthur dang ni/ rin chen du ma'i rgyan chas spras pas/ /dgos 'dod mchog gi re ba skong ba/ /zhi ba'i nyamasadang rgyas pa'i byin chags/ /dbang sdud rtsal dang drag po'i mthu ldan/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung ma mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams

༄༅/ /la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags nga/ sgrubs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ gsumapa ni/ / hriḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro gtsug na nor bu/ /sku mdog dkar ser mdangs dang ldan pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyisagayas na rin chen/ /dgos 'dod bsam pa yid bzhin stong ba/ /g.yon par thod pa rin chen 'dzin pas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsal ba/ /dar ljang na bza'

sku la gsol zhing / /rin po che dang rusapa'i rgyan 'chang / /chibs su 'brong chen kham 'gying la bcibs/ /sgrub la dngos grub myur bar stsal ba'i/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcasapa rnams la gsolalo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubasapa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin lasam lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ phapani/ / hriḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu/ /sku mdog dmar skya dri med mdangs ldan/ /

༄༅/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas na ne'u rkyal/ /mi zad nor gyi char pa 'bebs shing / /g.yon pas thod pa rin chen gang 'dzin/ /thun mong dngos grub yid bzhin stsol ba/ leb brgan dar gyi na bza' klubs shing / /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ /myur mgyogs shugs ldan rta dmar la bcibs/ /mgyogasapa'i bang ni glog gi zhags mtshungs/ /dam tshig sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ snang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen

zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin lasam lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ lngapani/ hri dbang gi mkha' 'gro khams gsum gzi 'phrog/ /sku mdog dmar mo byu ru'i mdog mtshungs/ /phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba 'dzin cing / /dgra bgegs ma lus srog rtsa gcod pa/ /g.yon pas lcags kyu rnon po 'dzin pas/ /dmigs bya'i bla srog rnam shes 'gugs pa/ /lha rdzas na bza' sku la gsol zhing / /thod pa skam rlan rin chen gyis brgyan/ /mkha' lding la bcibs myur ba'i shugs 'chang / /sgrub po'i re skong bar chad kun sel/ /dbang gi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs/ /'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang

༄7/ /bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ drugapani/ hri sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro chen mo/ /sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum rngams pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri 'phyar zhing / /dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar po rtsad gcod/ /g.yon pas thod pa snying bcas 'dzin pa/ /'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho rol ba/ glang chen zhing gi g.yang gzhi la sogs/ /dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ /chibs su bong bu dmar gur chibs te/ /stong gsum ma lus skad cig bskor

ba/ dze za lasakyi mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubasapa'i rtags phyung / 'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa ni/ hri gzhan yang sprul pa'i phyag brnyan chen mo/ /gzho dang la phyi spu rangasaganas nas/ /sgrub pos bos tshe skad cig rgyug cing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi legs nyes stangs 'dzin/ /dam tshig rjes gcod bka' yi srung ma/ /

༄༅/ /gsod byed za byed 'phrogs byed ma mo/ /dmar dang ljang mo le rgan mdog can/ /lcags kyu nad rkyal phyag na 'dzin cing / /mi lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon pa/ /drag po'i las la thogs med rtsal ldan/ /dam can sngags pas drag tu bos tshe/ /ha ha hi hi'i gad mo sgrog cing / /la sa kyi rlung dmar chibs su bcibasanas/ /skad cig nyid la 'phrin las sgrub phyir/ /bran gyi tshul du bka' nyan gsung stod/ /dgra la rbad tshe rngams pa'i stabs kyis/ /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis gcod cing / /bla tshe rnam shes hab kyis btab ste/ /sha khrag dren mo zhal du gsol zhing / /snying khrag dwangs d+me shul kyisa'adebasapa/ /rjes shul ming yang thal bar rlog pa'i/ /'phrin las khro mo dmar mo 'khor bcas/ /mkha' 'gro srog bdag bshan pa 'bum

bcas/ /mkha' 'gro srog gi spu gri 'khor bcas/ /sha za dmar nag stong dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod namasaspel/ dpal dang gragasapa sgrubs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegasathul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog ci bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ zhesa'abul/
༄7/ /che ring ma'i gsol kha bzhugs se/ /
dbang khrid skabs dang / sde ra bzang garwa ri3 pre — gdor spyan baji gas rngams bkram zhi nga /skyems bran zhing / spros ngakar dang a ru chosad rnge rje rnal 'byor ma/ra ga sa ra
/thugs ka nas hre dre/ /waṃ gsum 'phros/pas/ ocasaḥgīḥ gsum las byung ba yi/ 'a/ dgyes nga ra byed nas pa'i mchod pa'i sdi/ mkhar bla ma yi dazlo mkha' 'gro dam caX

snang ma lus pa khyab par spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dza: pad+ma ka ma snyer ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ gu ru de wa bud+dha ḍā kyi t+t+waṃ sa pa ri wā ra arnya pardu patre dhu paṃ a 'o ke gan+dhe sna we hūm̐ shagapra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hās mṛ ta ba thing ta /zwa lha/ dngapo/ / doḥ chas sku spros dang bra ra ba'i ngang las ma/ g.yosakyang / gzugasasku yan lag bdun snan gyi rol par 'char ba'i/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li shes rab bzang po/ nā ro ye shes dngos grub/ mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa/ rdo rje/ bkra shis tshe yi lha mo/ 'bri gung pa chos dbyings rang grol 5 ba dang rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / rgyal da nga rgya ra sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ khyad par du yang yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rigs bzhi'i ma/ba' 'gra'i tshogs dang bcas nga/ rnams la gsol lo/ /mchod

༄༅/ /do/ 'bul lo/ bdag cag khamasagasum sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ gnyisapa/ ༈ hotshogatso mo bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug /gangs dkar shel sogs gnasagasum skyong ba/ /bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srung ma chen mo/ /dam ldan sgrub pa'i grogs mo chen mo/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi bstan ma chen mo/ /srog gcod yongs kyi gtso mo chen mo/ mkha' 'gro yongs kyi phyag byed rje mo/ /nga nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos/ /'jig rten sman mo'i tshul du sprul pa/ /sku mdog dkar la 'dzum zhing bzhad pa/ /dar sna'i na bza' lhab lhub gsol ba/ /rin chen gser gyi do shal 'chang ba/ /dbu skra thor tshugs spyi bor bcings shing / /dung thod rin chen brgyan gyis mdzes pa/ /dar gyi

cod pan mkha' la 'phur ba/ /phyag g.yas dam tshig rdo rje rtse dgu/ /rab tu sdigs pas gdug pa kun 'joms/ /phyag g.yon 'chi med tshe bum bsnams te/ /'gyings pas sgrub la tshe mchog stsol ba/ /lha mi'i rat+na'i gdu bus sprasanas/ /chibs su seng chen 'gying ba la chibs/ /dar ldan g.yu mthur gser srab dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin lasamangon du mdzod/ snang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa/ / hoḥ sman btsun mthing gi zhal bzang chen mo/ /sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo/ /chu dar

༄༅/ /sngon po gos su klubs shing / /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis sprasapa/ /g.yas pas lha yi mda' dar g.yab cing / /g.yon pas dngul gyi me long 'dzin pas/ /snang gsal spra yi dngos grub stsol ba/ /myur mgyogs rkyang bu kha dkar la chibs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtagasaphyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bzhipa/ / hoḥ mkha' 'gro mi g.yo blo bzang chen mo/ /gtso ma dri bral gser gyi mdog can/ /dar chen sna lnga'i na bza' gsol ba/ /phyag g.yasathod pa bcud kyisayongasabakang / /g.yon gyi mtheb

srin gtor zhing mchod pas/ /zas nor dngos grub char ltar 'bebasapa/ /gcan gzan gtum po stag la chibs pa/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du mdzod/sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lngapa/ / hoḥ sman gcig cod pan mgrin bzang chen mo/ /sku mdog dmar mo byi ru ltar 'tsher/ /le brgan la sogs dar snas rgyan pa/ /g.yasapas yid bzhin nor bu 'phyar zhing / /g.yon pas rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ /mi bzad rat+na char du 'bebs pa/ /chibs su shwa ba yu mo la gnas/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum

༄0/ /gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ /dgyesapa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs/ /'phrin las mngon du mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ drugapa/ ༈ hotsholha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang chen mo/ /sku ni ljang sngon mar gad dang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' 'chang ba/ /phyag g.yas sbrul zhags dgra la 'phen pa/ /g.yon pas dur wa chun po 'dzin pa/ /rta glang nor sogs yid smon kun stsol/ /'jigs pa'i 'brug chen kha gdangs la chibs/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs/

'phrin las mngon du mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bdun pa / lhag mchad dang gtor ma phyogs mthun par/ oṃ a kwa ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+ma tā ta oṃ yisahūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ byin gyisabarlabasal/ / hoḥ gzhan yang bstan ma'i 'khor gyi tshogs ni/ /nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong na gsal zhing / /bar snang kun tu 'phyo zhing rgyu bas/ /sa gzhi'i skye 'gro dbang du mdzad pa/ /shar nas zhi byed dkar rma bdun ni/ /tshe stsol bar chad zhi bar byed pa/ /lho nas rgyasabyed ser mo bdun ni/ /dpal dang grags pa nor gyis phyug ma/ /nub nas dbang mdzad dmar mo bdun ni/ /gang 'dod dmigs bya ma lus 'gugs pa/ /byang nas drag po'i las byed bdun ni/ /

༄༅/ /dam nyamasam lusathal bar rlog pa'i/ /'khor du bstan ma yang ma skyong ma/ /sman mo bdud mo ma mo'idamag tshogs/ /nad dang rims kyi bdag mo rnamasal gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs/ 'phrin las mngon du mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ cesapa 'i 'dug tu/ gtor ma 'bul zhing skrun lasabacolab ni/ /ga' ma skyon dang bral zhing bskul ba la nang mcha branate/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ udu ṭak+kisno tā ta oṃ u3 phaṭa swā hā/ gtso gyis byin gyisabasas la/ ko dpal yeshes kyi dbyings las bzhengs te sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro'i skur snang ba rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag

dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / /'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag nyid du grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'phrin las bcol te rol ma'i sgra dang bcagate 'di skad do/ / bh+yoḥ shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /rnal 'byar bdun gyi gtso mo ni/ /dkar mo dung gi thor tshugasacan/ /drug ni chosakyi dbyings3 bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sku rugasal/ /de ltar g.yog 'khar bye ba yang / /'dir gshegs rgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ /khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig/ / bh+yo: lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /rnal 'byar bdun gyi gtso mo ni/ /ser mo gser gyi thor tshugs can/ /drug ni chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sku

༄༅/ /ru gsal/ /de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang / /'dir gshegs rgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ /khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig/ / bh+yoḥnub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byar bdun/ /rnal 'byar bdun gyi gtso mo ni/ /dmar mo byu ru'i thor tshugs can/ /drug ni chosakyi dbyingasan bzhugs/4 gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal/ /de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang / /'dir gshegasargyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ /khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig / / bh+yoX byang nas gshegasapa'i rnala'abyar bdun/ /rnal 'byor bdun gyigatso moni/ /ljang mo g.yu yi thor tshugasacan/ /drugani chosakyidabyingasan bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal/ /de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang / /'dir gshegs rgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ /khyod kyis drag po'i

lasamadzod cig /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces gtor ma gtsang sar 'bulalo/ /bce pa chad mdosathugasadam gnad nas bskul bani/ / bh+yoḥ sngon tshephaṭa rgyan dur khrod gzhal yas su/ /rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro'ispun snga sa /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yang sprul tshul bzang nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam/ /ji ltar zhal bzhesadam las ma 'da' bar/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byar bdag cag yon mchod 'bar bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen 'phrin las sgrubs/ /de 'og gter sgrom drag po'i gnas chen du/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga sa /las kyi ma mo'i tshul du sku sprul nas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam/ ji ltar zhal bzhes dam lasam 'da' bar/ /

༄7/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen 'phrin las sgrubs/ /de rjesasprul sku dngos su bstan pa'i tshe/ /rigs srasabazhi la bstan pa gtad pa ni/ /a phyi chosakyi sgrol mar mtshan gsol nas/ /ma 'ongs rgyud 'dzin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen 'phrin las sgrubs/ /de 'og 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du/ /skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan sngar sto /ma mo mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i skur bstan nas/ /bla med bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam/ / ji ltar zhal bzhes dam

las ma 'da' bar/ kha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen 'phrin las sgrubs/ /da ltar sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /bka' srung dam can 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sku gsum sgrub pa'i tshe/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes/ la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen 'phrin las sgrubs/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā gī nī sapa ri wā ra arnya pathu purmye dhu paṃ a lo ke garnye ni wi hūm̐ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rolamo dang bdud rtsisakyang ling do/ / sto bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ bzhin bzang dbyings

༄7/ /phyug dpal ldan chos kyi sgrol/ /sku mdog dkar dmar 'gyur med 'gying bag can/ 'khor ba'i log lta skem byed 'od mnga' ma/ /bde chen dga' ster rab dgyes dpa' mo ste/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi byed 'dzum pa'i sku/ /phyag g.yas ḍā ru snyan pa kun khyab sgrog /g.yon pas thod nang khrod bzhin nor bu 'dzin/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsal cing / /za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' sku la gsol/ /rin po ches brgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur/ /chibs su sprin gseb chu rta sngon po bcibs/ /g.yu mthur sngon po gser srab ser posabargyan/ /dar chen slo nan mu men yob chen 'brol/ /za 'og dar gdan gser gyi sga steng du/ /dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo bzhad pa'i chul/ /snying rje chen pos pho nya'i cho 'phrul ston/ /lha min gnod

sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyisabaskor/ /'phrin las bzhi ldan spros med ngang tshul can/ /phun sum tshogasaganasadapal gyi 'bri gung du/ /longs spyod spel phyir bka' srung kun mdzad ma/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugasadam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cesapa 'di yangaskyob pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'o/ /nongs 4bzod par gsol zhing bshags/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyisabasdu zhing shisapa brjod do/ /de ltar bka' srung a phyi'i gsol kha la le tshan 'di gnyisadon du gnyer ba 'gas bskul ba'i ngor 'bri gung bya bral ba rasnom spro lung gzhis gar brisapa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che'ispatsas su gyur cig /hriḥ dbyingadra'iphyug dpal ldan lha mo ye shes sgrol/ /sku mdog dkar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rgyasapa'i las mdzad phyag g.yas ḍā ru khrol/ /g.yon pas bhan+ta rin po che yis

༄7/ /bskang / /inā ni la'i dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi cod pan phur/ /chibs su 'brong bu kham pa rab chibs nas/ /rgyas pa'i las mdzad rang mthun 'khar gyis bskor/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ / hri/ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo dam tshig sgrol/ /sku mdog dmar skya rin chen 'od 'phro zhing / /dgos 'dod thams cad char ltar 'bebs mdzad ma/ /phyag g.yas ne'u le'i rkyal bas dngos grub ster/ /g.yon pas dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i nor bur 'dzin/ /be+eḍūr+ya dang pad+ma ra gas spras/ /rin chen char rgyun sgrub pa po la 'bebs/ /chibs su rkyang shes la chibs srid gsum nyul/ /'khor du dbyings phyug lha mo 'bum gyisabaskor/ /

dngos grub gnang phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul phyu g.yang longs spyod spel// hri/ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo dbang gi sgrol/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas gri gug 'phyar/ /g.yon pas zas nor sdud pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin/ /thod skam dbu rgyan thon rlon do shal 'phyang / /srid gsum dbang sdud chibs su mkha' lding bcibs/ /dbang gi las byed rang mthun 'khor gyis bskor/ /mi zad nor dang rkang bzhi rma g.yang zas/ /che btsan mthu dang snang srid gsal ba'i pra/ /srid srung rigs rgyud lo legs dngosagrub stsol/ /'dod pa'i don sgrub dbang sdud mkha' 'gro ma/ /dngos grub gnang phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ / hri/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro

༄༅/ /srog gi bdag /stobs chen drag mo sha za'i dus la babs/ /sku mdog mthing nag khrag 'thung snying 'byin ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu khros pa'i sku/ /phyag g.yas ral gri dam nyamasasrog rtsa gcod/ /g.yon pas thod khrag gtso mo'i zhal du stobs/ /glang chen ko rlon stag lpags sku la gsol/ /dur khrod chas brgyan bong bu gwa ma bcibs/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro sha za khrag 'thung ma/ /rang 'dra'i za byed bdud mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /rngams shing rngams shing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bka' gnyan bsgos pa'i las la rgyug /gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs kyi bla srog khug /sha khrag dmar gyis gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa drag tu srung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po srungs/ /zas
su dam rdzasabadud rtsi'i mchod gtor bzhes/ zhal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin lasa'agrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ nyi ma phyogasaphyogasapha ni na/ /sogasadang/rigs lnga mkha' 'grosogagagong bsto brjod/

༄7/ /che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur/ zhesamos la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ḍā ār+ya nut+pan+ma tā ta skyed gi9hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang / be+e shra ba ṇa sarba yak+ṣa rā ja kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum brjod la/ dpal ldan rnam mang thosasras ngal bsos dge ba/ sras dang btsun mo/ las byed mdung dmar ba/ 'brog gnas rta bdag brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor

bcas tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyasapa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs shing / 'phrin las mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ / be+e rin chen pho brang dam pa na/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng du/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ nor ster pa yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lusagazhom pa dang / /'byor ba'i longasaspyod phun tshogs shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub
༄༅//mdzad gsol//spyo rgyal r+pā gol ga' 'di brisapa dpasku phyag du lor pa dusalongs bsobakra shisapar ngesazhesadakon mchog ra0 so//
70/ sgo//dpal ldan 'ing skyong dbang po'i bsdod bskur bzhugs so// rdo

༄༅/ /ru dar nag po dmar gtor nam mkha' 'phyar/ /sde brgyad dbang sdud khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bdud kyi dmag dpon srin po khrosapa'i zhal/ /mthu rtsal drag shul myur mgyogs stobs dang ldan/ /bstan pa bsrung dang rnal 'byor skyong la brtson/ /nag po chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /dbugs bral bsnol ma cang shes dmar pa'i steng / /dar dmar ber gyon bdud mo seng gdong ma/ /g.yas g.yon phyag na rtse gsum dgra snying 'dzin/ /dam nyams srog

gcod khyod la bdag bstod do/ khyen tu mi bsrun bam ro pho mo dang / /tshar gcod phan 'dogs byed pa dregs pa'i 'khor/ /bka' gnyan bye ba stong phrag 'bum dang bcas/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa la bdag bstod do/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bdul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cesabastod nas/ drag shul chen pos dgra bgegs kun 'joms shing / /sgrub pa po la bu ltar brtse ba can/ /'jigs byed zhing skyong chen po khyod nyid la/ /mchog tu gdung shugs ldan pas rab bsten nas/ /dang du blang dang spang bar bya bsgyu yi/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dam tshig rmad byung ba/ /nyams na bshags shing legs par bsrung ba yis/ /khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig /dngos su 'byor dang

༄༅/ /yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /nyer spyod 'os pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /ma tshang med pa rgya cher spel ba yis/ /lha chen kun dga' gzhen nu'i thugs dam bskang / /rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta nag rting dkar dang / /g.yag nag ru sngon spu zhol brjid cing che/ /khyi nag dom bu gtum zhing 'jigasapa'i gzugs/ /lug nag brgyan ldan rnams kyis thugs dam bskang / /btsos pa'i sha dang 'bras chen bsregasapa'i bsur/ /khu khrag lha ba rkang mar rus pa'i tshogs/ /dbang po glo snying nang khrol rgyu mar bcas/ /dmar chen brgyan pa'i gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /dpa' bo dom nag tsit+ta ma nyams par/ /srog gi sa bon dam pa legs par bcug /cho ga bzhin du bris pa'i 'khor lo sogs/ /mi 'bral rten pa'i rdzas kyis

thugs dam bskang / /rtag tu dgyes bzhin 'khor zhing las mdzad pa/ /gnad du bskul dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa yi/ /lha khyod nye bar bsnyen pa'i tshul rnams kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas pas thugs dam bskang / /sna tshogasasha yi tshogs ni rdza ltar spung/ /myos byed dmar chen btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /mthun rdzas du mar sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'dis/ /dpa' bo las mkhan bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /ra yi rnam lnga sha chen khrag dang zhag /bshos bu dmar po sha rje dkar gtor chang / /bza' btung bye brag rnam pa mang por bcas/ /so so'i yid bzhin rgyas par sprul nas kyang / /dam can badz+ra sa dhu'i thugs dam bskang / /gshin rje rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /klu bdud nag po mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang / bdud

༄7/ /po bye ba gung ring thugs dam bskang / /btsan rgod yam shud dmar pa'i thugs dam bskang / /srin po na ra sing ha'i thugs dam bskang / /srog bdag tshangasapa dkar po'i thugasadam bskang / /ma mo rdo rje pha lam thugs dam bskang / /bdud kyi dmag tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugasadam bskang / /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas/ /dngosagrub ma lus dgyes bzhin stsal du gsol/ /de nas thugs dnga'agal ba rnams bshalas par mos la/ / // dpal chen 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /khyod ni ye shes chen po'i spyan dang ldan/ /bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur lus ngag sems/ /nongs pa'i tshogs ni ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dresapa dang / /dam
rdzas ma tshang bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba sogs/ /yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dang 'gal ba rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsole/ /de ltar bzod par gsol// dge'o// sarba maṅga lo// /
dhi 0 ༄//ma/brdes sprosad rar/zhes byabasdegasaso/// ——— bo

༄༅/ /bstod/ /hri/ ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i/ /pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la bstod/ /shes bya kun la ma rmongasapa'i/ /blo ldan mchog srid sku la bstod/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la bstod/ /rmongs pa'i mun sel 'gro ba 'dul/ /nyi ma 'od zer sku la bstod/ /log 'dren bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa'i/ shwakya seṅge'i sku la bstod/ /mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /seṅge sgra sgrogs sku la bstod/ /dregs pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /rdo rje gro lod sku la bstod/ /hri ༷ snang ba ma 'gags thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i yum/ /rdo rje phag mo yum

la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye 'gags gnyis su med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /thugs rje'i ma 'gags ci yang sprul pa'i sku/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang chen pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nor lha gter bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / / // bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba/ /'jig rten dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal po ni/ /rigs ni za hor rgyal pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ /o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad/ /bsil ba'i tshal du dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes/ /'jig rten khams su gdug pa can rnamasabatul/ /kha ba can du bstan pa rgyasapar mdzad/ /lho nusamatshamagasu srin po'i kha gnon mdzad/ /mya ga mi 'da' 'gro ba'iganyenagacig pu/ /

༄༅/ /sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru ka/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran/ /gsang sngags rgyal pos gnas 'dir byin phob la/ /rkyen ngan bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang / /mchog dang mthun mong dngosagrub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sku yi byin gyisarlabs tu gsol/ /lusakyi sgrib pa sbyong du gsol/ /lha dbang lusal bskur du gsol/ /lus skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /snya gsung gi byin gyisabarlabasadu gsol/ /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong du gsol/ /gsung dbang ngag la bskur du gsol/ /ngag snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /sems kyi sgrib pa sbyong du gsol/ /chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol/ /sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlabs/ /dbang bzhi
bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ /sku bzhi grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshig dbang don mchog rtogasapa dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /
tsho༅ 'ja4 / dpa/snyer gshin rje'i bsdod pa/ bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /sbyor yum ma mo khrag mig ma/ /dmar nag gcer bu brkyang bskum khro mo'i tshul/ /lcags kyusa'agugasashing don snying dmar la rol/ /bde stong gnyis med rol pa'i ma/ba' klong las/ /thugs rje'i dbyings sprul ya ma rā dza ni/ /khrag rul mdog mtshungs bshan gyis dgra bgegs sgrol/ /khros pa'i zhal gdangasadagra snying dmar la rol/ /khro rgyal sku yi phyag rgya rol pa las/ /'chi bdag nag po'i g.yas g.yon ri rab dang / /dgra stu 'bar bas dgra bgegasaganon cing

sgrol/ /chu glang steng na zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad/ /gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag nag po ni/ /dmar nag dug sprul ral pa mun ltar gtibs/ /be con zhags pas dgra bgegs brdung zhing 'ching / /dor stabs rab bgrad las kyi rlung dmar zhen/ /yab yum sras bcas sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs la/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas phyag 'tshal te/ /rang rtsal ye shes mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs kyi dam bskang mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /'bor ba'i mun rngam gnas pa'i bdag 'dra yis/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje'i cha yi zer mthong nas/ /gus pas bstod 'dis byang chub mchog thob ste/ /rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun grub shog /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon

༄tsho/ /slob mi nor 'khor/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa dang / /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /tshe dpal 'byor tshogs rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /mos snyeng khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /bstan gasnod phyi nang dgra bgegs thal bskre rlog /cesagrags r+ṣa da/'a bo'ila'an rje tshe bdag 'khor dang bcasapa zhal gzigs dus/ rig 'dzin chen po gnam lta gas me 'bar gyisamadzad pa'o// //
