—— byebakarke dā sna dra ra gyi bye kā bsdo ༵ ༷ge ra :bsnga na zlu sa ringarje ngh+ru/ da cing bskur pa riji riskar byaḥpre/ cha: par gsur//sto tre 4pre ci — ci ri cing sne āḥ hūm̐ ta sdoḥhriḥ ces gsu / gyis / sman raka gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha /drag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen jo/ra gyur: ces pa dashā sas cis:ci ri snye — —— — /ci ka rica nyi sding /ba raka twe lu ru (sdu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ dzaḥdra : baju sa dhu tre snyenang ngo:ngo:hrīḥshag ru raka raṃ na ge tsit+ta traṃ / ——— ————— ——— ——————— — — ————

—— — ———— — — —————— ——— ——— ——ngh+ru/ /ma/ ma skreng za 'grar+sha lhe ke sha pa ke rte shes rten dra/dra'agra bo'i dbu'e rtser rngams/rnakhreg snyer chum/rkyi tri co thim ja yam/ chod shā gtor/ che srog co co khaṃ /waṃ phaṭa/ sgrub sngags kyi cingajug sakyis / rdo ci/ be rngarto ba liṃ ta ma/ hā sha hūm̐ mo sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro ca na keṃ ni ri ti ba su ta bo d+me cit+ta la /bā lha:'es gsum gyisakhadabu pa shing / dzaḥ nga )seng ngaXngs/ k+tsi dkyi la mibor na: kun bzang ma gcig khros pa 'i sku: e ka co nyi ra la kā ——— —————————— ——— ——— ————

gcig ma: zhal na tshem/sa gcig dgra srog gcod: da pral na spyan gcig bstan pa bsrung : brang na nu gcig sgrub mchog skyong : srog gcod kun gyi gtso mo ste: phyag g.yas dgra snying da mar la rolaḥ g.yon pas thod khrag zha la du grubaḥ dgra bo'i snying khrag 'jibs snyel shog: bstan pa sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: de yi dbugs spong rnam shes snye'aphrog: sngags srung khro mo dgra la bh+yo: sprul pa /'bum sde da gra la bh+yo: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes snyel:drag pa'i 'phrin snyems snye'agrub par mdzod: hrī: lho nub mun rum me dpung dbusaḥ srog bdag gza' bdud rā hu la: mgo dgu srin nyarus sprul 'jug can: spyan stong me dpung lta bur 'bar: g.yas pas nyi zla zor du 'phen: g.yon pa sa spu gris dgra srog gcod sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon rje:

༄tsho/ /zhing gang dal yams thog ser bdag khyod ni 'jigs byed ma rungs pa rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dam can ste bdag ni de yi brgyud pa 'dzin dam tshig gnyan las khyod ma 'da': bstan la 'tshe zhing rnal 'byor smod chos la ya ga byed pa yi sdang byed dam nyams dgra bo 'di lo dang zla ba ma bzhag cig zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang par gza' yi bcar phob 'di la thong sde brgyad dmag dpon dgra la bh+yo: da mar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hrīḥ byang shar badz+ra swa dhu stsal: dmar nag 'jigs tshul ra skyes bcibs dar dkar ber dang smyug zhu gsol drag po'i am gtsigs khro gnyer bsdus g.yas pas rdo rje'i dgra mgo choms g.yon pas snying zhags ru dar 'phyar: sangs

rgyas rnal 'byor bstan pa skyong :mched 'dur sum brgya drug cus bskor:than dang ltas ༅ bdag po ste:mi sdugamatshan ma sna tshogasaston:dam nyams dgra bolasangan la mi rung ltasag da thong smo wa la spre'u wo sgo khyi ngu :ming nasa'abod cing m+wa nga brdung :'dab gas skad sgrogasarigasami mthun:a tsar mon pa'i cho 'phrul phob:smug nag lcam dral 'khor dang bos rgyalab dgongasapa'i thugasamadakrugs:rig 'dzin ra yi don sla'achol:gangazag brgyud pa'i bka' ma bcog dam nyamasalas pha ma bsgral na:rdo rje dmyal ba ོ por lhupade bas dmar gyi gtor malong :dgra bo skul ba'i lon lasamadzod ceyoyistod cingabaskyangab byaca//de nas ha ra'i snyebyang ni/ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ gtsi/rtsi〉mā ra ya ja yo.ā/ ha ho hrīḥ.i n+d+ra:gyilha lhu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa hri

༄༅/ /ha ra nag po sam ya sarba sha rtsu ma ha paṃ sal spyi: ma hā rak+ta laspyi ma hā tsit+ta la :: ma hāgo ro tsan la zhi ma hā ba suta lazhi ma hā keṃ ni riti la :: ma hā pañtsa.a mṛ ta la lha ma hā ba lita la kha two zhogalan gsumagyisagator maphral hri: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: chagasasdang rang brgyud 'khrugasapa las gza' rgod ki rkang thog 'bebasadang : klu mo nag mo bsgosapa'i bu ha ra mi zan nag po che srid gsum sha za khrag 'thung ba'i mibasrunadrag po'i khro gtum can gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang : mar me mjad kyi spyan snga nges khas blangs dam la bzhag nas kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang :khyad par slob dpon pad+ma yis: bka' bsgosaganyer gtad bstan bsrung bcol o rgyan rdo rje gling phug tu ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:

bdag cag mchog bsgrub rnal 'byor la zhing bcu dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: mu stegs ban bon byad ma yis gdug cing 'tshe bar gyur pa na ha ra nag po dam la 'dus mdog nag mi gdug chu srin mgo ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes: thog dang thun ser lag na thogs lus la mig stong me 'bar 'brug sprul mjug g.yosapa'i rgya mtsho skyoms tsha grang 'brug pa'i sgra skad sgrogs thog dang ser ba gri 'thab gtong ཿ mngon sum rtags ston bza' klu'i rje 'bod do 'bod do gnas 'dir byon sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma long : bdag la brdo ba'i dgra bgegasakun skad cig thal ba'i rdul du rlogaḥ swa mā yu: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa yang rat+na'i brisapa las 'don cha khol phyung rdzogasaso/ /dge'o/ /
༄༅/ /gza' bdud kyi sgrub thabs me rlung /ri/cil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /dang posasprul zhags/ 'og ma gnyis rwa'i mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ sku smad sprul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ sku lus thams cad spyan stong gzigs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can 'jigs su rung ba drang srong skems pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ de'i phyogs bzhir gdong mo bzhi/ shar du stag srin zor ba gdong zor ba bsnams pa/ lhor bam srin dred ma'i gdong rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ nub tu kong srin ba glang gdong lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du 'brog srin chu srin gdong

ri rab 'degs shing klad la bskor ba/ lus mi la mgo tha dad cing dkar ser dmar ljang rim pa bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad la lha ma srin sde brgyad las/ shar du lha dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje smug nag ral pa bsnyigs shing be con 'dzin pa/nub tu klu bdud nag po sprul mgo'i gdengs ka can sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ljang ser ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rgyal po dkar ser bam dbyug 'dzin pa/ lhor nub tu btsan dmar pos zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dmu ljang ser nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ byang shar du nag po bdud mdung nag 'dzin pa/ de'i shar phyogs su smin drug la sogs pa bdun/ lho nub byang gsum du bdun bdun te nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni mdog sna

༄7/ /tshogs can bum pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir mi nag po 'o dod 'bod pa/ bud med nag mo ral pa snyigasanasadud mo rdul ba/ khyi nag dgra la zug pa/ stag zhes bya/ gzig byi la/ dom/ dred/ spyang ki/ dur bya la sogs pasayongasasu bskor bar gyur/ ༈ /ཿ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /khas blangs dam bcas nag po mthu bo che/ /gza' chen sde brgyad rgyu skar btsun mor bcas/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan pad+ma ka ma lwa ye s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ hoḥ ba lidha kha kha khā hi lha/ oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hū la/ ra tsa ra tsa biṣ+ṭa ra tsa/ bdud po ra tsa/ drang srong dkar ser/ /khyab 'dug chen po/ du ba 'jug ring / gdong mo mched bzhi/ rgyusgar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/

snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i dam ba l+la ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhesabadun gyisalabul/ de na sa'adi skad do/ / ko ྅/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /pha ni srin la ma ni klu/ /klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che/ /rig 'dzin dgra lha 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di/ /gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ 'jigs gzugs du ba 'khyil 'dra'i sku/ /dbu dgu'i sdang mig dgra la gzigs/ /ltas ngan bya rog dgra la sgrogs/ /phyo phyo sdang ba'i dgra la phyo/ /phyo phyo gnod pa'i bgegs la phyo/ /g.yas zhal 'dzum dang ldan pa yis/ /sgrub pa po la dngosagrub stsol/ /g.yon zhal rgod cing bshe ba yis/ /dgra bo'i yul du dalayams phob/ /dbus

༄༅/ /zhal 'jigasasu rung ba yis/ /lha srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdud/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba yis/ /rang gi phyogs rnams rgyal bar mdzod/ /klu sbrul zhags pa g.yug pa yis/ /dgra bo'i bla srog khug la sgrol/ /ra yi mda' gzhu 'gengasapa yis/ /dgra bgegs dpung rnams rdul du rlog /phyo phyo dgra bo'i yul du phyo/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung phyo/ /dal yams nad kyi bu yug phyo/ /phung byed ltog pa gzer thung phyo/ /dgra bgegs yul du dmag sna drongs/ /dmag dpon khyab 'jug chen pos mdzod/ /srog gcod srin mo bzhi yis mdzod/ /ltas ngan sde brgyad yongs kyisathong / /khyab 'jug chen pa'i dmag dpung ni/ /rngams pa'i bshugs glu di ri ri/ /nad kyi bu yug thu lu

lu/ /mtshon gyi char pa si li li/ /dgra bgegasasteng du da phyo cig /gza' chen brgyad po da phyo cig khyu skar nyer brgyad da phyo cig /gdong mo mched bzhi da phyo cig /lha srin sde brgyad da phyo cig /yul lha gzhi bdag da phyo cig /badz+ra ging kur ging ka ra/ dha sha gh+ri wa dha sha gh+ri wa/ yasga gh+ri wa yaka skyi wa/pra yi shaka pra yi shaka /'u ru wa 'u ru wa/ thun thun/ srog la bh+yoḥbh+yo/ gza' bdud li tsho yang gsang bla med kyi sgrubathabasa'adi/ thegapa mchog gi rnala'abyor pa klong 'a rab 'byamasakyisabakod pa lasa'adon cha kholaphyung re zhigardzogasaso / dge'o// sarba maṅga la// //
༄7/ /rgyal ngo/ sku lnga'i gso la /ba bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /rdo rje'i gseg shang thogs/ /'thibasazhu gsol zhing dom nag spyon pa khrid/ /sku yi rgyal chen gsol lo 'phrin las mdzod/ /gnod sbyin nag po stag sprul g.yang gzhis brgyan/ /g.yas g.yon stu gri bdud zhags dgra la 'debs/ /khyung dgu dbang sdud srid pa'i g.yu 'brug khrid/ /yon tan rgyal chen gsol lo 'phrin las mdzod/ /dgra lha skyes gcig dar nag 'jol ber gsol/ /g.yas g.yon sba mkhar tsan+dan beng chen bsnams/ /spyang mo khrid cing pho nya bya khra

gtong / /gsung gi rgyal chen gsol lo 'phrin lasamadzod/ /dpe har zhal gsum phyag drug tshag zhu gsol/ /lcagasakyu mda' ral spu gri gzhu dbyug thogs/ /dar dkar gsol zhing stag chas seng ge chibs/ /'phrin las rgyal chen gsol lo 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal po sku lnga 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sman raka sha khrag gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /nyams bshagasayul 'khor longs spyod bstan pa srungs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'bri gungapa bya bral rat+na bu phro pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /kye/ bskang ngo gsol lo mchod pa ni/ /thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin che/ /sku yi rgyal po mon bu ste/ /yon tan rgyal po shing bya can/ /gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes/ /phrin lasargyal po dpe dkar che/ /sprul pa lnga dang yum chen lnga/ /blon

༄༅/ /po lnga dang gnam gyi yab/ /gnod sbyin thog 'bebs lha'i dge bsnyen/ /mgon po thang nag pa tra dang / /pu tra srog bdag dmag dpon rje/ /rgyal mtshan bdun bdag ru 'dren tshogs/ /spu gri mched lnga stong dpon bdun/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni/ /rta dkar khrum dmar sprin ltar 'phyo/ /spre'u dkar ngo dmar glog ltar 'byug /bya dkar ze dmar gnam du 'tsher/ /'bag seng gar mkhan rtse shing rol/ /lha khang sder bzo byis pa sogs/ /ra tsa'i cho 'phrul ya ma zung / /dkor mdzod nor dang sba dkar smyug /mkho dgu'i longs spyod sna tshogs kyis/ /dpe har rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / /dgra lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /stong dpon chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugasadam bskang / /

thugs dam bskang la 'phrin lasasgrub/ /kye rta dkar khrum dmar spre'u dkar ngo dmar dang / /bya dkar zer dmar 'bag seng gar mkhan sogs/ /lha khang sder bzo byis pa dkor mdzod nor/ /sba smyug rgyal mtshan brgyad sogs mthun rdzas kyis/ /dpe har dgra lha'i rgyalapo'i thugs dam bskang / /
༄tsho//chos skyong gamod sbyi na chen po'i gsol /spa bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /gi bka' nyan pa che btsan rol pa skya bdun ni: phal cher sku mdog dmar po la: phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: tshur spyon tshur spyon gnas 'dir byon shu la hrī: badz+ra sa ma ya dza bh+yo bcan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na: sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab: yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzes dam tsheg gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan / kye/ skyes bu rol pa mched bdun ni 'phrin

las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab pad+ma dbang gi bka' stsal pa: dam tshig gnyer bdag khyod la bstod gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul lo:bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar ma/dzod:arnya bi shudhe swā tsho gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs me tog snang gsal dri mchog dang zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzod:puṣ+ṭi dhupe ā lo ke gharnye ni wi traṃ shap+ta pu dza ha kye skyes bu srog gi bdag po ni 'jigs byed rol pa sde bdun tshogs:khyod la dgyes pa'i longs spyod ni sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing bur gtams: spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkram: rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs glu dbyangs

༄༅/ /snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcas dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskang : btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : sde brgyad sdongs zla'i thugs dam bskang: dkor srung dam ldan thugs dam bskang: las bzhi'i pho nya'i thugs dam bskang: :/ gser mkhar dmar po ldems se ldem dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru: ba dan dmar po yangs se yang : dregs pa'i mda' 'phen springs se spring lasabyed bshan pa ro lo lo: bshugs pa'i 'bod sgra di ri ri: bh+yo: che btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga phu thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la khri srong lde'u btsan rje rigs dang rnal 'byor dam ldan brgyud par bcas dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba dang: sku la bsto ba'i rigs rgyud chod log lta'i sde

dpung cham la phob sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma 'bral bcol lo gnyer ro mthu rtsal bskyed yal yol bri khol ma mdzad cig ngo bsrung zas phyir ma 'breng mdzod: thugs dam 'gal ba de bskangs la: bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongs zhesaphud gtsang phyogasages gtor zhing bskul bar bya'o drag btsan mched bdun gyi gsol kha'i lasabyang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis mdzad rje'i sku ltar bsngags rgya rgya rgya pad+ma dbang chen gyi bka' srung ngo ཿ kha the pad+ma rgyal po rol ba rtsa/ gyis mtshimasaphu be tsa'igling nas gdan drangasapa'o bh+yo/ gnod sbyin rgyal po tsi'u dmar che/ /dregs byed rol pa skya bdun dang / /btsan dmar bye ba'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzasani/ /rak+ta'i arnya lbu 'phreng 'khrigs/ /bshos bu dmar po rdza ltar nyil/ /gser skyemasamached pa mtsho ltar bskyil/ /tshil chen

༄tsho/ /mar me nyi ltar gsal/ /spos bsregs dud pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /spyan gzigs 'byor tshogs skar ltar bkram/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /brag dmar shing dang srog 'khor rten/ /sku 'bag bla rdo bris sku yis/ /gnod sbyin skuyi thugs dam bskang / /rkang gling yi wang rgyud mang dang / /zangs dung sil snyan rol ma'i sgra/ /snying po rbad bsad sngags rnams kyis/ /gnod sbyin gsung gi thugs dam bskang / /dam ldan bslab pa gsum gyis phyug /pad+ma'i rjes 'brang sgrub la brtson/ /dam tshig sel gyis ma gos pa/ /gnod sbyin thugs kyi thugs dam bskang / /btsan mkhar dmar po rim gsum la/ /ngar dmar ru mtshon phyogs bzhir btsug /ba dan dmar po mkhar la sgreng / /steng na bya tshogs lding zhing

'babs/ /nang na btsan gyi dmag tshogs 'grim/ /logs na sha rkyang sha ra ra/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag ri ltar spungs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul gzhal yas 'dis/ /gnod sbyin yon tan thugs dam bskang / /mdung dmar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i lo ma can/ /dur khrod ro skra las byas pa'i/ /gri khrag gis byug btsan zhags dang / /gri lcags shasti 'bar ba las/ /gzhan yang kun bzang mchod sprin bzhin/ /tshogs drug dbang po tshims byed pa'i/ /mdzes shing bkram pa bshams nas ni/ /srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /dregs byed rol pa skya bdun po/ /sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /gri thang dmar po gnasabacas nas/ /srid gsum zas su za ba'i tshe/ /rta mchog khros nas sdang mig gzir/ /rdo

༄༅/ /rje'i dam tshig dam ma chad/ /da ltar rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /dgra lha gnyen po khyod bsten tshe/ /rol pa skya bdun 'khor dang bcas sgrub po de ni rgyang ma ring / /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /phyo phyo de ni dmag la phyo/ /dmag dpung bskyod la ru mtshon phyor/ /dgra dpung sod la bgegs dpung thul/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dpal dbang thang 'dod dgu spel/ /bka' srung gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi/ /bka' 'gal dam nyams brlag par mdzod/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i yid smon rnams/ /'grub par mdzod cig mthu rtsal rten/ /kyi gser khrab rmog dang mdung dmar ba dan gri/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs sha rus khrag myos byed/ /'dod yon bza' btung rnga dang mkhar rnga dang / /spyan gzigs sna

tshogs stong gsum gang ba yis/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / /rgyasapani/ kye yang cig thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ /kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /lus la rol pa'i skya drug dang / /btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /bskang ngo gsol lo mchod par bgyi/ /bse rmog gtum po 'od du 'bar/ /gser khrab zangs kyi ri ltar brjid/ /mdung dmar ba dan me ltar 'phyo/ /ral gri mda' gzhu la sogs pa/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs ri ltar spungs/ /sha khrag rus pa myos byed sogs/ /'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba bcas/ /rnga dang mkhar rnga 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /spyan gzigs sna tshogs stong gsum gang / /dgyes par byed pa'i mchod rdzas kyis/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar thugs

༄0/ /dam bskang / /lha btsan dgra lha'i thugs dam bskang / /yang le ber gyi thugs dam bskang / /btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i thugasadam bskang / /bskang gyur 'phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod/ /gnod spyin chen po'i bshags pa ni/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /rab 'byams gsar rnying rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /gnasadang yul gyi mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho bstan srung bka' nyan pa/ /pad+ma'i spyan sngar rdo rje'i dam gnos te/ /gtsug lag khang dang chos 'khor sde skyong pa/ /las kyi mgon po tshangs pa ging chen po/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po dpe har 'khor dang bcas/ /khyad par pad+ma dbang gi bka' gnyan mchog /bstan pa'i bka' srung nag phyogs 'joms pa'i gshed/ /rol pa skya bdun sde dpung bcas

pa rnams/ /'di gshegs bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rmongs blo ma rig gti mug gis/ /non te chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog sogs/ /nyon mongs drag po'i bsam pas nyer bslangs te/ /nyes pa gang byas khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /mkhan slob spangs dang pham lhag sbom po sogs/ /'dul ba las gsungs nyis brgya lnga bcu yi/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang 'gal ba/ /dpang gyur tshogs dang srung ma'i dbang por bshags/ /dkar nag chos bzhi blang dor g.yel ba dang / /sems/ can blos spangs par phyin drug ma spyad/ /byang chub sems dpa'i khrims dang 'gal ba rnams/ /dpang gyur tshogs dang srung ma'i dbang por bshags/ /snying nas slob dpon smod dang mched lcam la/ /ma gus bgyis sogs

༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa yi/ /dam las 'gal ba'i nyesapa gang bgyis pa/ /dpang gyur tshogs dang srung ma'i dbang por bshags/ /tshe rab snga ma'i las kyis bskyed pa dang / /tshe 'dir mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te/ /srung ma'i dbang po'i thugs dang 'gal ba rnams/ /gnong 'grod drag po'i snying nas bshags lags na/ /khro gtum drag shul gdug pa'i sems spangs nas/ /brtse chen byams pa'i thugs kyis nyer dgongasate/ /tshe nor chosal bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /nyer bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /tshe dang lang tsho stobs dang gzi brjid sogs/ /srid na dge ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /ji ltar yar ngo'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /sde snod gsum 'dzin bslab

gsum brtson pa dang / /rim gnyisasgom sogs lung rtogs bstan pa yi/ /bya ba bgyis la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /bsam don ma lusachos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa yang shing mo sprul gyi lo 'bri gung pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi masasbyo lung gi namamakha' mthing bzang du bris/ ༈ bshagasapani/ / hri/ tsu95 kun 'dus gzugs pad+ma thod phreng gi/ /bstan dang der bzhugs rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams/ /skyong mdzad gnod sbyin chen po tsi'u dmar che/ /dregs byed 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni gsang chen rdo rje'i dam gnas kyang / /blang dang dor bya'i gnas rnams ji bzhin du/ /rtogs par byed pa blo yi mthu chung bas/ /nyes pa bgyisapa'i las kun mthol lo bshags/ /khyad par gnod sbyin chen po chos skyong gi/ /mchog

༄7/ /tu bstan pa g.yar dam bcas lags kyang / /bstan sgrub mchod pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang dang / /dus kyi mchod gtor chags par mthol lo bshags/ /grangs dus rtags kyi bsnyen sgrub ma them dang / /gnad dang mi ldan dus min las la sbyar/ /de sogs srung ma dam can thugs dam dang / /'gal pa gyur ba de kun mthol lo bshags/ /de ltar nongs par bshags pas dgyes bzhin du/ /tshangs pa bstsal nas byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun pa'i don rnams kun/ /ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig /bshags pa co bsduga'adi bla mar zur rgan nas so skyi /chos skyongaganod sbyin 7po'i bstod pa 'phrin las ༅ 'bub cesabya ba ni/ / lhu/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /las smon mthu lasagrub pa'i dam tshig can/ /

chas skyongaganod sbyin chen po zhes grags pa'i/ /bka' stod stobasaldan khyod la bdag bstod do/ /rab 'jigasabaskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /khro gnyer bzhin /sdud e gtsigs sdang mig bgrad/ /mdung dmar zhags pas ru tra 'ching zhing sgrol/ /dam nyams gshed ma khyod la bdag bstod do/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma'i rjes 'brang spyan snga sa /ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam mi g.yel zhing / /dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur bar khang du/ /smon lam gcig bsdus lha sras 'dus pa'i tshe/ /bka' yi thugs dam gnyan po ji bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang brgyud par bcas pa yis/ /dam chos sgrub la tshul bzhin skyong ba dang / /gtan gyi dgra lha chos skyong khyod gsol na/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel/ /bar chad

༄༅/ /bgegs thul sdang ba'i dgra bo sod/ /chos 'khor gnyan skyongs mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /rje bas rasnomamadzad pa'o/ /gnod sbyin chen po'i drag bskul ni/ / kye/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na/ /nyi ma nub phyogasapha gi na/ /g.ya' dang spang gi mtshams shed na/ /btsan yul ri thang phyed pa na/ /zangasabrag gnam du zangs se zang/ /rtsel rgod smug lings se ling/ /logs na sha rkyang sha ra ra/ /rtsa na chu sngon zu lu lu/ /sku mkhar de yi steng shed na/ /bse mkhar smug po ldems se ldem/ /gser gyi ba gam stams se stam/ /dung gi sgo mo khrigs se khrig /lcagasakyi sgo lcags khro lo lo/ /mu men them skas sha ra ra/ /sku mkhar de yi nang sherdo na/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po bzhugs/ /mi

gcig po la ming mang ngo// /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bsam yas dbus su mtshan gsol ba/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po tsi'u dmar zhes/ /bon po ltag la me 'bar gyis/ /ra sa 'dzims su mtshan gsol ba/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po la/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis/ /mnga' ris stod du mtshan gsol ba/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po yang le ber/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa la/ /sku la gser khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la gser rmog dmar po gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar dgra la 'debs/ /g.yon pas/ zhags pas dgra bo 'ching / /gser skad rin chen sked la bcings/ /zhabs la sag lham khra bo gsol/ /mu men byi ru'i do shal can/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /chibs su gro bo g.yu rngog

༄7/ /bcibs/ /rta dmar 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /btsan khyi dmar po rol du khrid/ /bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo/ phyo phyo de ni dmag la phyo/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /btsan dmag dgra bo'i yul du drongs/ /snga dgra dang ba rtsad nasachod/ /phyi dgra sems pa drungs nas phyung / /sdang byed dgra bo rdul du rlogs/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ /bod pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dbang du bsdus la thal ba rlogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di sngags lang ra ston gyi ngor/ lha'i btsun pa rnam rgyal grags pa rin tshan gyisabu tshapa bde ba can du sbyar ba'o gnod sbyin chen bo'i gsolakha ni/ / kye rang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yasanas/ /gnod sbyin dmar

po gtum byed mthu bo che/ /sku mdog dmar po khrag ltar ya la la/ /khrag mdog mche ba dmar po gtsigs se gtsig /gnod sbyin gdug pa kun gyi stong dpon mdzad/ /drag shul mthu ldan stong dpon rdzu 'phrul can/ /g.yas pa'i ba dan dgra ba'i snying la gzer/ /g.yon pa'i zhags pas dgra bo'i ske nasa'aching/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rngamasapar mdzod/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ /byur dang ltas ngan thams cad dgra la bzlog /rnal 'byor chags chen nyams nga zlog tu gsol/ /rtag tu 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / / sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ /dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel/ /snyan pa'i dar phyar

༄༅/ /gragasapa'i dung bus la/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod/ /rgas med lang tsho ldan pas lus stobs rgyas/ /mig la ya mtshan ltad mo che ba dang / /rna ba rtag tu snyan ba'i gtam thos shing / /dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral zhing / /zas skom 'byor bsaro 'dzin tshimasapa dang / /lus la reg 'jam bde ba kho nas 'tsho/ /yid la rnam par rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /zag med bde bas nam yang ngomasapar mdzod/ /khyod gsol khyod mchod khyod bsgrub khyod bsten na/ /mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod/ /gzhes la bkra shis longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /byes su lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod/ /'jigasapa'i dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs/ /mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /bdag

dang mtha' yasasems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad ma lusazhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par ma dzod/ /kye gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal ba mdzad pa yi/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag sogs bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ / / kye shar phyogs kyi shel ging dkar po la gsol lo mchod/ /rgyal po shel ging dkar po la gsol lo mchod/ /rgyal po shing bya can gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugasacan gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /zhal gsum stod kyi mi bo che'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /sku la 'char ba'i 'od po che'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /'phangs pa pad ging

༄༅/ /mthu bo che'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /dge bsnyen gtor len gter srung gi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i skyes gcig po'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mkhan bshan pa rnams kyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /rgyal po gnam lha byang chub kyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /rdo rje ging po'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /rdo rje gsang sngags gter gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /dgra lha chen po dpe dkar gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /pha seng bdud yar lha shod kyi skyes to re'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /ma bdud pad+ma dbyings phyug ma'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /sring mo pad+ma gar gyi dbyings phyug ma'i zhal du gsol lo

mchod/ /yum shan ti ro zan ma'i zhal du gsol lo mchod/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa dpa' bo stag chas brgya'i zhal du gsol lo/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa nyan thos dgu bcom brgya'i zhal du gsol lo/ /sngon gyi shul mtshon pa bud med nag mo brgya'i zhal du gsol lo/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang pa ban+de phur thogs brgya'i gsol lo/ /sna zun mon bu pu tra'i zhal du gsol lo/ /don po dang bha dra'i zhal du gsol lo/ /nang gi blon po rdo rje dbyings phyug gi zhal du gsol lo/ /g.yog po shad grol khyi grol gyi zhal du gsol lo/ /khol po 'dzin pa rdol po'i zhal du gsol lo/ /dpe har sku yi rgyal po'i zhal du gsol/ /dpe dmar gsung gi rgyal pa'i zhal du gsol/ /dpe nag thugs kyi rgyal po'i zhal du gsol/ /rgyal po byes chas ke ru'i zhal du

༄tsho/ /gsol/ /stag ltar du rngams pa'i zhal du gsol/ seng ltar du 'chong ba la gsol/ khyung ltar du lding ba la gsol/ khra ltar du 'dzum pa la gsol/ spyang ltar du rgyugs pa la gsol/ gzhan yang rgyal po dpe har dang / btsun mo blon po/ phyi blon nang blon/ ru 'dren dang sde dpon 'khor dang bran g.yog rnams la gsol lo/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs/sngags 'chang bdag gi bstan pa srungs/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ snang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegasathul/ bar chad kyi rkyen zlogacesabarjod/ rgyal po chen po'i sgos gsol rdzogs so/ /rat+na'i rno myur ro/ /dpe dkar phyi sgrub kyi bskul byang ni/ / rtu/ bdag gi bka' gnyan las byed mthu bo che/ /steng phyogs

rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /'gro ba'i don du chos skyong rgyal po'i sku/ /dpe har dgra lha gnyen po sku bzhengs shig /lha yi dmag dpon chen po sku bzhengasashig /bdud rgyal nag po mig gcig sku bzhengs shig /srog bdag nag po zhaX gsum sku bzhengs shig /lha yi dge bsnyen rdo rje klu 'brug 'dul/ /dmu tsha klu 'brug chen po'i dus la babs/ /nag po tshe bdud chen po'i dus la babs/ /sgrol ging bshan pa dmar po'i dus la babs/ /gter srung gnyer len chen po'i dus la babs/ /stong dpon chen po dmag dpon dgra 'dul rtsal/ /chibs su gcan gzan mgyogs pa stag la bcibs/ /g.yas kyi phyag na zhing gi dbyugs pa 'phyar/ /g.yon pas bhan+ta dgra bgegs khrag bkang bsnams/ /dbu skra kham nag 'bar

༄༅/ /ba gyen la brdzes/ /sku la 'jigs pa'i ber smug dgu brtsegs gsol/ mi zad khro gnyer ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren dpa' bo stag chas brgya/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren bud med nag mo brgya/ /sngon gyi shul tshon dge slong dgra bcom brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang ban de sngags nag brgya/ /khol bu mon bu pu tra lag 'dzin no/ /g.yog po shad grol khyi grol tshogs/ /sprul pa 'bag seng dom dred bcas/ /'khor bcas bha ta hor gyi bdag /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /steng phyogs rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i dgra bos srog chod cig /chu ltar khol bsadagra bo tshos la shog /mun ltar 'thibs la dgra bo lkug du chug /

dkar nag snying gi dkyil du rgyobs la sod/ /glang thabs mun nag 'bar ba'i nad kyis sod/ /khong khrag 'thung la klad khrag zho ltar spyod/ /bla tshe rten dang phrol las khrid la shog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la thong / /hā swā li dun tsa ra/ chadagra bo ma ra ya rbad/
༄༅/ /dam can dang thang lha tshangs pa dge bsden ba/zhi bcas kyi gsol kha bzhugs so/ /

bgel pakhebage sku geg bsgyu tsho ————— rwasnangagar te zhes ———— ———rte bstodzo—— — ——————— nge ri gshes — ste ༄༄sgo// gas nyas stangs 'dzan pa'/ /dag bsnan chan pa/ rda rja gas pa / /'jag na skyang ba'i lha la bdag bstod do/ /khyod ni yab yum dmu bdud gshos pa'i sras/ /sngon las dag pas sangs rgyas chos dang mja pa// pre me kun pa dbang bsgyur rdophrul can/ /dmu bdud dkar po khyod la bdag bstod do//don dam nges pa'i bden pa ma mthong yang //skyes mchog khyad par can gyi gang — —— ———— ————— ————— —gangag stse ba sgo —4 12 spros ———4 ṣ+ṭha ————44 spre — sku zheng spre gedhe spro ge 044

ci gle dzo rta ——— nerdzo —tshoshe ༄ la khu r+shayo ltos —— ste —3—— ——7 — ——————————— ri ༄ge gos/ /dbaskre bskur ming btag sa mestan pa'i gnyerngo ——rte dū —tshang sang ra khyedaphye do/ /khyod ni mthu stobasardo 'phru pa che ba yes/ /sku mdog pya ga ma'agacig twe mcho khros kyang / /sngagasakyi dam tshig phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams/ /rnge rje /re/gas nga khyod pa bdag bstod do/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gdor ma 'ji bzhes la/ /stes bu dge bsnyen thugs dam das la babs/ /ma/ched sko rikhor sum ban sdig bcu'i sgo ——— nga ————— 4 ——————— spre —4 — 4 —————snye —— 6 — ༅pho sgo d+ngha — — — 4 ——— ————44 — ci — —

༄༅//tshogs dang bcas//sangasargyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i lasamadzod cig/thang lha'i bstod pa ni//hriḥchos dbyingasarnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yasanas//dus gsum sangs rgyas thugasakyi sprul pa che//dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga ldan pa//chosaskyong thang lha yar bzhugasagayi gyi rje//sku mdog phyag mas gcig tu ma ngesate//sna tshogasabakod pa'i cho 'phrul du ma yis//zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i lasarnamasal//'bral med stsolaba'i rju'aphruladapa' bo che//yab yum 'khor dpang tshogasadang bcasarnam sa kyis//sangs rgyasabastan pa gto po skyong ba dang //chosabyed sgrub po rnams kyi gdong grogs mdzod//tshe dpalalongasaspyod snyan gragasa'aphel bar mdzod//mi dang mi min ma rungasarutra'i tshogs//bstan la gnod byed gang mchisathalabar rlog/

than dang ltas༅ cho 'phrulasna tshogasadang //dme 'phrug nad ma' thogaser dgra laphob//dmigasapar gang byasadagralnga'i bla tshe khrag/srogardzo dbugasalong myur du sgrol bar gyis//dam rdzasogakho ma'adidang 4spyo du bzhes//'dodadagu'ibasam don yid bzhi 'grub par mdzod//tshago'ibazhipani//ho rnamamang thosasrasadamar r+ya ngo bo ṣ+ka//kha ba dung mdogaldom pa'i bawo rasaho//dar thod dkar po nam ga'akhrur bayi//das mardzogasumagyi dbu 'phang bstod par byed//g.yasapas shelagyi gri ring bsnams pa yis//dgra bo'i rigasangargyud yulabacasarlog par byed//g.yon pasanyi zer zhagasapa 'debasapa yis//dgra bo'i ske nasa'aching zhing 'gugs par byed//lha rta dkar po ngang zhun chibasapa yis//stong gsumaskad cig nyid labaskor bar

༄༅//byed//bstan srung sgosapa 'khor dang bcasapa yi//dam rdzas༅ pa'igator ma 'di bzhesal//thugasadam brgyud bskul bcolaba'i phrin lasamadzod//dgebasten/ so'i bstod pa ni//kye bar lha gnyan po dge bsnyen dpal dang ldan//zhi bar brten cing sgrub pa'i bar chad sel//gangasadakar gnas bcasadabyingasanasakun tu rgyu//sprul ba'i yum srasalha dmag bcas la 'dud//rdo rje 'bar ba sog ra dregasabyed tshogs//ye nasazhi yang bstanapa bsrung ba'i phyir//ma ngesatshul gyisacho 'phrul sna tshogasakyis//bayi dmag dang yosam yosagashed mar 'dud//chu 'kho nāg ra paṃ sgrub yi//lto 'gro dugasprul nag po'i rgyan lang zhing //blo ga ldan la mdze nad thog ser 'bebs//klu gto sa bdag mang posabaskor la 'dud//gter sgrom sman mo dam

tshigashugasa'agro ma//gzho stodaganasaskyong lo 'brasartsi shing srung //rnal wor masasnab pad+ma'iganas kyi bdag/sman rigasamang phobaka' skrurakhyo da la'adud/tam rgyaladagar po sangasargyasabs pal//marga par phyogasapa'igatsug lag khang skyong snyo //ma ngesamalugasaldan pa sdugasna'i r+pā//yid kyi gzugasacan masasarje bor bod//de ltar mnyamamed skyob pa yab srasakyi//spyan sngar khasablangasadamasasadran gyisal//chosarje'i dge bsnyen bzhi 'a/ bstod par bgyi//mas rdzasakyisamar yid smon tso phrulamadzod//kyegang zhigayid ladran pa 4gyisakyang //'dod pa'idangosagrub sngo ba mdzad pa yi//srung mayid bsto nor bu khyodarnamasakyis//bdagasngosab4 don ma lusabasgrubapar mdzod//
sgo/ /gnam chos las gong ba'i rma thos gsol mchong b.lags so/ /ri ba/ la spro sa'i ri ga ni// ri

༄༅/ /stobs 'byor dngos grub stsol/ /yul khams thams cad dbang du sdud/ /sdang dgra'i dpung tshogs 'cham la phobs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ku lu mi min swā hā/ i dam ba ling ta khā hi/ sarba pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ku lu mi min wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas la/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di phul bas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam don 'grub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan par 4rgyas pa'i
snyomadzod//dasto//
/snye ༄7/ /gsang ba gso ra 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la mthu rtsal che ba/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ming rdo rje drag rtsal can/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rnal 'byor pa rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bgyi ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gnyan po 'di la

bzhugs nas/ /bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i bde ba chen po'i lam gyi bar chad dang bdud bzhi'i 'jigasapa las rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bsu ma phrad par mdzod cig de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'gro zhing thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/ /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyas par gyur cig /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du zhing dus dang gnas skabasathams cad du 'phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur

༄༅/ /nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogasapa med pa bde blag tu stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegasal sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogasathams cad las rgyal te/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyas par gyur cig /gsang ba gsol gdab 'di da4pa rga los mdzad pa byin chubasacan du grags pa yin rma// / ma hrīḥ sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis/ ma chosakyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs/ye shes kyi dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang gisa'aphrin las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nying du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ yum a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes kyi sgrol ma/ dam tshig gi sgrol ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za lasakyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra

shisatshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma/dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams la/ ye shes la gsal 'grib mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ /byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ mthu stobs la thogasapa mi mnga' ba/khyed rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sku'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyisabarlabs tu gsol/ yon tan gyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ 'phrin las kyi sgo nasabyin gyis

༄༅/ /brlabs tu gsol/ 'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bsu ma dang 'phrad par mdzod cig de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'gro zhing thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyas par gyur cig lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du zhing dus dang gnasaskabs thams cad du 'phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngosagrub thogs pa med

pa bde blag tu stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/ bkra shis dang bde legasaphun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyas par gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ sidhi sidhi/ pha la pha la hūṃ/ mnga' gsol ni/ ko ྅/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yis/ khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba/ /nag po dur khrod ro langs bdag /mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje yis/ /khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba /nag po mna' zan yongs kyi gshed/ mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /khyod la gsang ba'i

༄༅/ /mtshan gsol ba/ /dge bsnyen legs ldan nag po che/ mtshan nasa'abod do da tshur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /bcam ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba/ /mthu chen log 'dren bgegs kyi gshed/ mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mnga' gsol ba/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis mnga' gsol ba/ /khrims kyi cha lugs gsum dang ldan/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /rigs gsum mgon pos mnga' gsol ba/ /dpral bar khro gnyer gsum dang ldan/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /rigs gsum khro bos mnga' gsol ba/ /zhal gyi mdangs bcad gsum dang

ldan/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /lha chen brgyad kyisamanga' gsol ba/ /dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'bar/ chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /lha rnams kun gyis mnga' gsol ba/ /gso sgra chen po gsum dang ldan/ mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /klu chen brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba/ sku dang yan lag sprul gyis rgyan/ /chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /gza' chen brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /smin ma glog ltar 'byug pasagazigs/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /rgyu skar rnamasakyisamanga' gsol ba/ /sku smad sme ba'i spyu gus rgyan/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /dpung pa rin chen 'bar bas rgyan/ chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /nor lha rnams kyis

༄༅/ /mnga' gsol ba/ /phyag g.yas dang pos shing thog bsnams/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /dpa' bo ging gis mnga' gsol ba/ /phyag g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'jin/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /ma mo rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /phyag g.yon dang pos thod khrag 'dzin/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /dbang phyug chen pos mnga' gsol ba/ /phyag g.yon 'og mas rtse gsum/ 'dzin/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /u ma de was mnga' sasol ba/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mtshan nasa'abod do da chur byon/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /'chi bdag gshin rjes mnga' gsol ba/ /zhal gyi mche ba zur gsum gtsigs/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /zhing skyong rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /mi mgo

rlon pa'i do shal can/ /chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /nag po bdud kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'od du 'bar/ /chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /srin po rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /khrag zhag 'bar ba'i thig les rgyan/ chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /khro rgyal rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /gsus khyim che zhing mthur du 'phyang / /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /tshe bdag rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /sku yi lte ba zur gsum zab/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /gcan gzan rnams kyisamanga' gsol ba/ /dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs gsol/ /chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /sman mosnams kyisamanga' gsol ba/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i snyan pa sgrogs/ chosaskyong mgon po nag po la/ /dur khrod brgyad kyisamanga' gsol ba/ /

༄༅/ /bam chen ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /yi dwags rnams kyisamanga' gsol ba/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i do ger can/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po la/ /dmyal ba rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/ /spyan nasabaskal pa 'i me chen 'bar/ /shangasanas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub/ /zhal nas bskal pa'i chu chen 'bab/ /mgon po'i thugs dam rgyud bskul lo/ /ma srin yum gyis thugs dam bskang / /gtsug tor dkar mo sku yi yum/ /ar+ya pa lo gsung gi yum/ /rdo rje sgeg mo thugs kyi yum/ /lam bo tā ra yon tan yum/ /byi to ta ma las kyi yum/ /u tsu sma ra 'od kyi yum/ /gar+sha pa ni phrin las yum/ /dam ka ri ni pho nya'i yum/ /ma sring yum gyi thugs dam bskang / /rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /

bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /cesadang / bstan bsrung ma'i mnga' gsol ni/ / hriḥ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chosakyi sgrol/ /nyi shar gangasaltar dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan/ /gzugs bzang gzi brjid 'od 'phreng drwa ba 'gyed / /lta sdug yid 'ong a phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs/ /zhabs 'og bdud bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mnan/ /phyag g.yas dngul dkar me 31nga mdzesapa bsnams/ /srid gsum gsal mdzad a phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /phyag g.yon yid bzhin nor bu rin po ches/ /rgyal ba ma lus mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang / /sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod re skong ma/ /tshogag gnyis rdzogs mdzad a phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /lha min gnod sbyin mkha'

༄༅/ /'gro'i tshogasadang bcas/ /bdud 'joms lha min g.yul ngo bzlog par mdzad/ /dkar po lha yi chab srid dbugs 'byin ma/ /'phrin las bzhi ldan a phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /srid gsum dbang sdud 'gro ba ma lus skyong / /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa chos bzhin sgrub mdzad ma/ /yid bzhin bsam 'grub kyis phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /byang chub thugs gar kun bzang chos kyi sgrol/ /lha mi 'jig rten kun gyis mchod gyur ma/ /gling bzhi kun tu rgyu ba'i drag mo rgyal/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sgrol mar mnga' gsol lo/ /deng sang bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan/ /dang/la gyi 'bri gung pho brang brtan bzhugs nas/ /chos mdzad sgrub nga/ po rnams skyong mdzad ma/ /bka' srung yang dag a phyi mnga' gsol lo/ /

bslab gsum rgyan ldan sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zhing bsam dngos su rten cing 'brel bar 'byung/ /ma nor tshul bzhin sgrub nas mchod gyur na/ /ci 'dod dngos grub ster la mnga' gsol lo/ /bdag gis khyod la mchod cing gsol ba yis/ /'gro drug chu bor bying ba'i ma rgan rnams/ /nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du mi gtong zhing / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par chos rje'i bka' srung thugasadam can/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /zas su dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ko ྅/ hrī yig las byung a phyi ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /gzugs bzang gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro/ /lha mo

༄༅/ /khyod la mnga' gsol lo/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma dam par yis/ /dbyings phyug lha mo mnga' gsol lo/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ /a phyi chen mo mnga' gsol lo/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba sras bcasakyis/ /chos kyi sgrol ma mnga'agasol lo/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro yis/ /ye shes sgrol ma mnga' gsol lo/ /chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /dam tshig sgrol ma mnga' gsol lo/ /a phyi sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor 'dasakun gyis mnga' gsol lo/ /dngul dkar me long snang srid gsal/ /g.yas kyi phyag tu mnga' gsol lo/ /lha klu mi gsum nor bu mchog /g.yon gyi phyag tu mnga' gsol lo/ /ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭī sogs/ /phyag mtshan du mas mnga'agasol lo/ /rin chen sna tshogs du masakyang / /mdzes pa'i

brgyan du ma nga' gsol lo/ /lhab lhub dar gos sna tshogs kyi/ /na bza' dam pas mnga' gsol lo/ /'khor lo pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /bzhugs pa'i gdan du mnga' gsol lo/ /pho brang bang mdzod nor gyis bkang / /bzhugs pa'i gnas su mnga' gsol lo/ /rta mchog sngon po rgyan gyis spras/ /'byan pa'i chibs su mnga' gsol lo/ /'bri lug 'brong dang rgya bong sogs/ /dkor nor du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mu tig gser g.yu dngul la sogs/ /rin chen du mas mnga' gsol spo/ /'bru sna sman sna bu ram sogs/ /'dod yon du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /rgyal srid bdun dang rdzasartags brgyad/ /phyi nang mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /mda' dar me long sba lcags sogs/ /rten rdzas du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan gtor skong

༄༅/ /gtor rgyun gtor sogs/ /dam rdzas gtor mas mnga' gsol lo/ /tshogs 'khor rak+ta bdud rtsi sman/ /bla med mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /srog 'khor bla rdo bskyed rim 'dzab/ /sgrub pa'i snying pos mnga' gsol lo/ /lha mo khyed la mnga' gsol bas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / /sems can bde skyid ldan pa dang / /bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /dngos grub stsol cig srung skyob mdzod/ /bar chad sol cig lung bstan mdzod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi gang dgos rnams/ /thogs med nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ /cesapa 'di sto kirtis sbyar ba'o/ / / tshe ring rma/ched lnga'i mnga' gsolani/ | hrīḥ lha sman tshe yi dbyings phyug ma/ /dkar gsal rgyan phreng du

mas mdzes/ /rdo rje bum 'dzin 'phrogs byed chibs/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo/ /mthing gi zhal bzang sku mdog sngo/ /lha yi ba dan me long bsnams/ /chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo/ /mi g.yo blo bzang gser gyi mdog /thod pa bcud kyis bkang ba 'dzin/ /stag mo gru ma chibs su bcibs/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo/ /cod pan mgrin bzang byu ru ltar/ /dmar mo rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin/ khwa ba yu mo'i steng na 'gying / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang mar gad mdog /durla'i chun po sprul zhags 'dzin/ /chibs su na bun gos can bcibs/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro mnga' gsol lo/ /brtan ma yang ma skyong ma dang / /sman phran 'bum sde'i

༄7/ /'khor dang bcas/ /sangasargyasabastan srung chosabyed kyi/ /stong grogs 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di rje pad+ma'i rgyal mas gyis mdzad pa'o// / bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /nag po chen po lcam dral tshogs/ /chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /gshegasashig bu yi gnas 'dir byon/ /bu yi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ /khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /g.yag lug nag po mar gyis byugs/ /dar nag ru mtshon rwa la brgyan/ /sog par dgra bgegs ling ga bskyon/ /gser skyems bdud rtsis bran pa 'dis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /bya rog gdong can la sogs pa/ /'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'grosabaskor/ /zhun chen snang gsal mar me dang / /sha chen spos

kyi dud sprin gyis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang / /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin skyongs/ /dar nag lcags kyi ru mtshon gyis/ /bya rog gdong can dpon dang g.yog /thugs dam gnad nasabaskul ba'i tshe/ /myur du byon cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ro langs gcan gzan sna tshogs dang / /bstan srung bka' yi bya ra byed pa rnams/ /bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rnal 'byor g.yar dam bskang du gsol/ /rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ༈ bshags par bya ba ni/ | hrī: lha chen ma hā kā la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /ma hā kā la'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas/ /'da' dka'i dam tshig nyams pa gso rgyu la/ /bka' ltar ma gyur gzhung

༄༅/ /bzhin rngo ma thogs/ /bsnyen sgrub dus 'das phud dang gtor ma chag /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun/ /rdo rje srin po'i tshogs la mthol lo bshags/ /bstan srung mthu yis dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /lug nag gcan gzan bya rog rgyal mtshan sogs/ /bka' yi las mkhan rten du ma btsugs te/ /bya rog gdong can thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /bka' srung drag po'i tshogs la mthol lo bshags/ /dpal chen mchog la grub mchog ltang bzung nas/ /dus bzhi phud dang nang nub mchod rgyu la/ /mchod pa'i 'byor tshogasachung te sku ma mnyes/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /ming tshig long gtam bar du chod gyur nas/ /nag po srog snying gnad nasam bskul te/ /bzlasabarjod sngagasakyi dam tshig nyams pa

kun/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yi dam rtse gcig gzhung bzhin bsgom rgyu la/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang du chud gyur nas/ /ting 'dzin rtse gcig ma gsal nag por bskyed/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /dar nag rak+ta bhan+ta dam rdzas sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten la le lor gyur/ /rten rdzas ma tshang yan lag dam tshig nyams/ /nag po 'khor dang bcasal mthol lo bshags/ /dur khrod gnas na sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /pho nya las byed 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan dag /nongs gyur gang lags khyed la bzod par gsol/ /mthol lo mthol lo ye shes lha la mthol/ /bshags so bshags so srung ma'i tshogs la bshags/ /mthol bshagasabazod gsol dam pa yar bzhes la/ /tshangs pa
༄7/ /las kyi mgon po'i gsol kha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
r+sha —1—

kau badz+ra ru pa badz+ra rgya9hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta badz+ra āḥ// oṃ badz+ra blo badz+ra sparnye badz+ra phya9hūm̐/ ma hā pa/ñtsa a mi ta /rā lha/ ma hā bhik+ṣu a tsa ra sa pa ri war i da ma ba ling ta kha /khā hi /zwa tho thu ku ma ra tsa ma ra sa nga/ ri wa ra 6de dam ba nang ta

/sta lha /khā lha/ lan gsum/ lko nyu/ rdo rje ldan dang na len+d+ra/ bi ka ma la'i gcitsug la ga rgo /dkor gyi srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /bya rog gdong gi sprul nga/ ste/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul brjod las 'das/ /mgon po a tsang mched gsum ni/ /—rgyun du bstan da nga chos 'khar skyongs/ /skabs su rnal 'byor srung ma mdzad/ /res 'ga' khro chul dgra bo sgrol/ /bstan pa'i srung ma ribar dang sacas/ /dam rdzas sman rag mchod gtor dang / /'dod yo na yid sprul 'ji bzhes la/ /nad gdon mi mthun zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod dpal /'byor spongs spyod spe pa/ /'dod dgu da bang bsdu da dgra dang bgegs/ /gyod byung mi kha sgrol ba dang / /bzlog pa'i 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /rkyen ngan 'tshe ba'i gzugs can dang / /gzugs med bsam sbyor log pa

༄༅/ /kun/ char gcod srung dang bzlog par mdzod/ /nad dang nye ba 'tshe ba sol/ /gzhi byesalam 'phrang chu sogasalas/ /skyel ma lta bu stong grogs mdzod/ /dgra kun jag sogs bag med las/ /nyin mtshan mel tshe rgyun du mdzod/ /bdag gi zaganor bkor cha rnams/ /srung ba'i gnyer btad khyod la bcol/ /gzhan yang bdag 'khor longs spyod rnams/ /rtag tu g.yel med srung ba mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam pa'i lung / /de las chos skyong ma 'da' ba/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin lasagrub pa mdzod/ /

༄༅/ /mkhan pho nyar bcas/ /phyag drug beng 'dzin ma ning zhal bzhi sogs/ /nag po chen po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / / hrīḥ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yang sprul chosakyi sgrol/ /sprul pa yang sprul lha sman mched lnga bcas/ /smug nag lcam dral sngags srung kun gyi gtso/ /ha ra nag po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /gnasayul zhing skyong bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong / /yab yum bka' sdod sde brgyad yang 'khor dpung / /drang srong gza' bdud dpe har rtsi'u dmar sogs/ /

rang 'khor dpung tshogasabacasapa'i thugasadam bskang / /lha btsan klu sman dge bsnyen rnam bzhi dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba tshangs pa dung thod can/ /rdo rje legasapa rnam rgyal dkar po sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /gter khyim gtsug lag dregs pa nyi shu sogs/ /pho mo klu bdud kyis bsdus bye ba 'bum/ /snang srid dregs pa'i tshogasakyi thugs dam bskang / /ngalabaso sargyal po nor bdag pho mo sogs/ /lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcu/ /dpal mgon bdun bcu gnas bdag gzhi bdag bcas/ /sdong grogs srung ma'i tshogasakyi thugs dam bskang / /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags rgyu chung phud nyams sogs/ /rtsa

༄༅/ /gsum dam can srung ma'i tshogasarnams kyi/ /thugasa'agal nongs pa thamasacad bshagasapar bgyi/ /de ltar thugs dam bskang shingangagags pa'i mthus/ /'bri bstan dar rgyas bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /chos srid mnga' thang tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhid mthun rkyen 'phrin las mdzod/ /cesabashagasashing yis/ brgya brjod/ cesapa 'di'ang dhame rā dzagabrisapa dge'o/ / hrī/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas/ /dpal zu/gon phyag bzhi dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol/ /lha sman tshe ring ngal bsos rgyal po dang / /smug nag lcam dral bdud mgon rā hu la/ /rgyal chen sku lnga chos skyong yang le ber/ /

dge bsnyen rnam bzhi dri za tshangs pa bcas/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pa/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul gyur pa dang / /ting 'dzin ma gsal bzlas brjod chad lhag dang / /rgyu chung phud nyamasalhag ma 'dres pa dang / /dus kyi mchod gtor 'gyang zhing g.yel ba sogs/ /mdor na 'gal 'khrul nyams chag gang mchis pa/ /mthol lo bshags so bzod pa bzhes nas kyang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen tshe bsod spel/ 'bri bstan rin chen spyi dang bye brag gi/ /bstan 'gro'i bya ba lhag bsam gang mchisarnams/ /

༄༅/ /gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ zhes ga'adi ni rje rin po che bstan 'dzin chosakyi nyi masamadzad pho// / hrī phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzasatshogs/ /ma tshang med pa legasabakram pas/ /chosakyi sgrol ma'i thugasadam bskang / /ye shesasgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang / /dbang gi lha mo'i thugasadam bskang / /las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugasadam bskang / /las byed ma gsum thugs dam bskang / /snying sgul spu gri'i thugs dam bskang / /sprul pa'i ma tshogasathugs dam bskang / /lha sman mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang / /brtan ma bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang / /sman phran 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam

bskang / /bshags so thugs las 'gal ba bshags/ /dam tshig gnyan las khyod ma 'da'/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i lasarnams kun/ /da ltar nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ /sangasargyasabastan pa bshigs pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / /bdag cag chos bzhin byed pa la/ /sdang zhing gnod pa'i dgra bgegasarnams/ /dbyingasaphyug ma yis bsgraladu gsol/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas mthu ma chung / /nyamasapa'i dgra bgegasasteng du bh+yo/ /bstan dang de 'dzin bdag sogs la/ /pha rol mi dang mi min gyis/ /sring pa'i khram kha gtong ba zlog /byad kha phur kha gtong ba zlog /'byung po'i thun zor 'phen pa zlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba zlog /bdud kyi khram kha 'debs pa zlog /ma mo'i

༄༅/ /khrag zor 'phen pa zlog /klu yi byad du bcug pa zlog /mu stegs bar chad byed pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'grog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegasarigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /gdon rigasasum brgya drug cu zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo skag zla skag thams cad zlog /zhag skag za skag bdun zur zlog /zhang zhung gtso mar 'phen pa zlog /sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa zlog /brnye'i sngags zor 'phen pa zlog /bon po'i thun zor 'phen pa zlog /sngags pa'i gtor zor 'phen pa zlog /bdud dang srin po gshin rje dang / /btsan dang ma mo rgyal po dang / /klu

gdon gnod pa thams cad zlog /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /thamasacad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /thams cad bar chad rkyen la bh+yo/ /za 'dre shi gshed steng du bh+yo/ /bzhes shig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ /cesapa 'di yongasa'adzin chosagragasakyi ngor rjepad+ma'i rgyal mas gyisamadzad pa'o// ko dpalaye shes gyi mgon po'i bskang bzlog ni/ / /ཿ bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang / /bstan pa gnyan po srung ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang / /sgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba dang / /mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog pa'i phyir/ /ma hā ka la'i thugs dam bskang / /bstan srung chen mosathugs dam bskang / /sa bcu'i mgon po'i thugasadam bskang / /bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang / /gsang ba'i yum chen thugs dam bskang / /seng ge'i gdong gi thugs

༄༅/ /dam bskang / /mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang / /nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang / dze za 'bum gyi thugasadam bskang / /ma mo bye ba'i thugasadam bskang / /gnod sbyin khri yi thugs dam bskang / /rgyal chen bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /phyogs skyong bcu yi thugs dam bskang / /lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bshags so thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar/ /bdag gi 'phrin lasa'agrub par mdzod/ /bzlog pa ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhigs pa dang / /ngakon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /bdag cag sgrub pari byed pa la/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa gang shom par/ /nag po chen pos bsgral du gsol/ /bya rog gdong can la sogs pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa mthu ma chung / /khram kha

bsgyur ba'i mthu bo che/ /do nub srid pa'i khram kha bsgyur/ /do nub lha 'dre'i dmag sna drongs/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ /gzhan gyis phur kha ngan pa bzlog /'byung pos thun zor 'phen pa bzlog /gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog /bdud kyis khram kha 'debs pa zlog /ma mosakhrag zor 'phen pa zlog /klu yis byad du bcug pa zlog /mu stegs bar chad byed pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog /blo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo skag zla skag thams cad zlog /

༄༅/ /zhag skag za skag bdun zur zlog /zhang zhung gtso dmar 'phen pa zlog /sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa zlog /brnyes sngags zor 'phen pa zlog /bon pos gtor zor 'phen zlog /sngags pas gtor zor 'phen pa zlog /skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa zlog /bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog /bdud dang srin po gshin rje dang / /btsan dang ma mo rgyal po dang / /klu bdud gnod pa thams cad zlog /thams cad snang ba'i dgra la bh+yo:thamasacad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo thams cad bar chad rkyen la bh+yo: za 'dre shi gshed steng du bh+yo: bzhes shig rol gcig kha raṃ khā hi/ /zhes pa 'bri gung pa chosakyi grags pas mja nga pa'o// / // mgon po seng gdong yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam dag thugs kyi re ba yongs bskangs shing / /nyes

pa 'i tshogs rnams mi 'chab bshags pa las/ /bdag cag 'ashesar dang bcas la gnod pa yi/ /srid pa'i khram kha thams cad dgra la sgyur/ /lha 'dre'i dmag tshogs ma lus dgra la drongs/ /pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i las brtsams pa/ /byad kha phur kha rbod gtong drag po dang / /mtshe zor rbad 'dre yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog /sa bdag klu yis byad du bcug pa dang / /the'u rang 'byung pos bsris rkun byed pa bzlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bdud kyi khram 'debasadang / /mu stegasangan pa'i bar chad byed pa bzlog /rgya' bsen rnamasakyis spyo 'bog gtong ba dang / /drang srong gza' dang klu gdon gnod pa bzlog /zhang zhung bh+yoḥzor sum pa'i glang zor dang / /bon po rnams kyis gtor zor 'phen pa bzlog /ban+de'i sngags zor skye bo'i

༄༅/ /mda' zor dang / /bud med rnams kyis dmod zor 'phen pa bzlog /bdud kyi gshed bzhi ro langs 'byung po dang / /ma mo rnams kyis khrag zor 'phen pa bzlog /mo rtsis ngan dang rmi lam mtshan ma ngan/ /ltas ngan mi rungs brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ma lus dang / /gdon rigs nyi khri chig stong tshogs rnams bzlog /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs ma lusadang / /ye 'brog chen po sum (rgya drug cu bzlog /gdon chen bco lnga lo zla zhag dus skag /mi mthun phyogs rnams dgra bgegs steng du bzlog /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa brgyad rnams dang / /ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra bo'i steng du bzlog /ma hā kā la seng gdong mthu rtsal can/ /yab yum mi bsrun sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams/ /

'phrin las drag po shin tu mi bzad pas/ /sod cig thul zhig dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /gtad do gnyer ro srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /le lo btang snyoms g.yel bar ma mdzad par/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston mdzod cig /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /da lta nyid du grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma gtsang sang dbul/ /de ltar dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po'i bsnyen sgrub mched gsum dpa' bo rnam par rol ba'i mchod sbyin klag pasa'aphrin lasaskrub pa zhesabya ste/ kholakyi grags g.ye shesadab pa bzang pos mdzad gola'adon cha kholabyung bskrun pore zhig rdzogs so/ /dkor cha gnyer du gtad pa ne+e/ hūṃ/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtshogason/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /khyod la gnyer gtad 'phrin bcol ni/ /dgon gnasadagon gzhi'i rten gsum dang / /mchod cha dpe

༄༅/ /cha ka cha dang / /rta dril nor phyugs grwa 'khor bcas/ /srung ba'i srung ma khyed rnams bskos/ /thams cad bdag tu bzung mdzod la/ /nyin mtshan g.yel bar med par srungs/ /dgra dang bgegs la ma sgormer cig /gal te dgra kun jag pa yis/ /khyer na ra mda' de ma thag tanan tu 'jigs rungs cho 'phrul gyis/ /sngangs skrag 'jigs pa skyed mdzod la/ /rgya mtsho'i steng du khyer yang khug /grwa slob mi chor longs spyod bcas/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /khyed na mas mngon shes spyan ldan zhing / /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul thogs med pas/ /ji ltar bcol bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /mthu rtsal nus pa/ ci 'dug lta/ /rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum ston/ /ma g.yel khas blang dam bcas dgongs/ /dus la babs

po sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa rā ga a phye slad zhol du phyung ba'o/ / / byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /thugs bskyed dam bca' mi nyams bstan 'gro'i don/ /skal med thar ba'i sa bon 'debs pa la/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i ru nga phrag dog spong / khen tu 'dul daske' las 'brel med pa'i rigs/ /bka' srung drag po'i za kha zug pa la/ /phyi tshul 'jam pos 'brel ba bzhag na yang / /bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs kyis za ngu gyis/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rgyal bstan dar rgyas 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /dmag jag chom sogs las ngan rgyun bcad nas/ /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /lakugs bzhugs ri/ sto na mo/ rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/ /

༄༅/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang / /sngagasa'achang bdag gi sngags dang ting 'dzin dang/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa'i mthus/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin smod/ /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la shoms/ /da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /kha 'jam snying rtsub zhe nas smod pa dang / /do bsdo phod btsug bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed/ /mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du bsnyag /dmag sna jag sna rku sna ston pa dang / /bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang dam sri sogs/ /yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di nyid kyi/ /rnam shes bla tshe srog dbugs bcas pa rnams/ /gnam sa gling bzhi'i gling phran ri rab gseng / /nyi zla'i

go bar chos skyong srung ma'i skyabs/ /gang na gnas kyang gtor ma 'di nyid la/ /khug cig badz+ra e ku sha ya dza/ /ske nas chings shig badz+ra pa sha hūṃ/ /yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra pho ṭa baṃ/ /myos pa gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho/ /phyesashig badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa/ /dbyer med stims shig a we sha ya ā/ /bdag mdun thugs las dza yig dmar nag 'phros/ /bsgral bya'i sna bug gshang lam gnyisanasazhugs/ /snying khar phyin pasazangs lcagasa'akhor loganyis/ /g.yas g.yon 'khor bas sha khrag bla tshe gtubs/ rnam shes a yig rgyal ba'i thugs skar 'phos/ /tshe bsod mre yig ljang gu bdag la bstims/ sha khrag bdud rtsi gyur pa srung mas gsol/ /dgra bgegs kyi ma hā me sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā la hi/ de nasathun gtor labulabar

ra༅༅/ /'dodakyi pas/ gtor ma btegs bu'i khar stegs te bdud rtsi bran la/ sgrub po yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dgugasabazhugagalegasapar byas la/ bya seng las la bskul ba 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /thung la sbom pa'i gsus po che/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogasabacur gzigs/ /dgra bgegs thams cad zil gyisaganon/ /yang 'khor nag po stong gisabaskor/ /lce spyang mang po 'bros 'ded byed/ /bya nag mang po gshog sgra rdebs/ /mchu sder brdar zhing dgra sha za/ /rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// / :/ sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral gri thod khrag

g.yas dang g.yon/ /yang 'khor sha za 'bum gyis bskor/ /rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /cesogator ma gtsang sad gshegs par bya'o// ༈ rjes gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ / tshi shrī he ru ka ma hā ka la sa pa ri wā ra arnya pathu pur+sha dhu pe a lo ke garnye ni wi hūm̐ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ gto rag gi mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ / yo āḥlhaḥ da/pal ldan he ru ka yi sprul pa mchog /gdug pa kun 'dul gsang ba'i mgon po ni/ /yab yum zhal sbyor bya rog sprul pa 'gyed/ /thub pa'i bstan srung 'phrin las mdzad la bstod/ /bzod gsol sna/ / gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyesagyur gang / /gang phyir lus can skyon gyur pa/ /de kun mgon posabazod par gsol/ /bdag cag lasadang pogang༄ga tu

༄7/ /gyur pas/ cho ga la lhag chad du gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin la thang lhod du gyur pa/ khasalen gong du ches pa/ nyamasalen 'og tu chung ba/ cho ga'i gra chags pa/ zur nyams pa bzlas brjod ma dag pa/ mchod pa'i 'byor tshogs chung ba la sogasapa nongasapa'i tshogasaci mchis pa thamasacad mgon po thugs rjes chen po dang ldan pa/ srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags pas byang zhing dag pa dang / bdag gi tshe 'di'i rkyen phyi ma'i sgrib pa/ sa lam gyi bar chad/ dngos grub kyi bshegs su mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ sto bstan 4tshisani/ bye brag tu yang ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten gnyan po 'di la brtan cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan cing brtan parabazhugs nas kyang / bdag

sogs sems can thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i zhing / bsod nams bsags pa'i dpal mgon dam par 'o༄spyar bar mdzad du gsol/oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhesadang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /theg mchog dam chos rin chen bsgrubs nas ni/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro kun theg mchog bdud rtsi'i chos/ /rin chen dri ma med pa 'grub gyur cig / / shisabarjod ni/ / rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang / /mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa/ /phag mo gru pa rgyal ba 'bri gung pa/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas gtso la yon tan mchog mnga' ba/ /

༄7/ /skye dgus bstod cing smon lam sprin tshogs 'dus/ /go 'phang mchog brnyesabastod pa'i char 'bebs pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /skyob pa'i chos la legs pa'i mchog mnga' ba/ /shin tu phan dang bde dang des gsungs pa/ /'khor ba rtag bde mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs rbestog /dge 'dun sde la mthun pa rmad byung ba/ /bslab gzhi legs bcas brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bde mgon chen po sgrub pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /zab gsang rgyud sde'i gnyer gyi gtso mo ste/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis srid gsum dregs pa 'joms/ /'dod dgu phrin las bsgrub la thogs med can/ /khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /

dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan srung che/ /'jigasabyed mi bzad drag po'i las rnams mjad/ /rngams pa'i nga ros srid gsum thal bar rlog /mgon po bya rog mtshan gyi bkra shisashog /bskal pa'i me 'dra ye shes me dpung klong / /pad nyid dgra bgegs bsnol ba'igadan steng du/ /nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /deng 'dir bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /nag po chen po bde legasargyas pa dang / /dpalaldan lha mosa'adod dgu sbyin pa dang / /pho nya lasabyed 'phrin las sgrub rnams dang / /chosaskyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpal ldan ma hā kwa la mkha' 'gro brgyad/ snye bstan srung tshogasakyisabaskor ba'i srung ma mchog /phyogs bcur rgyu ba gdug pa'i bsam pa can/ /ma lus tshar gcod mgon pa'i bkra shisashog / / srid gsum

༄7//dbang sdud 'gro ba malusaskyong //sangasargyas stong gobastan pa bsrung bar mdzad//'gro ba'i bsam pa chosabazhin sgrub mdzad ma//yid bzhin bsam 'grub gnyi bkra shis shog//nor gyi dbang phyug rin chenagater mnga' zhing //gnod spyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyigatso//byang phyogasaskyong ba'i ar+ya j-i bha lha//dngosagrub mchog stsal nor lha'i bkra shisashog/gnyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yula'ams kun gyi gtso//nye ba'i mthung spyod dpal gyi tsā ritu//rab 'jigs dur khrod chen por rtag tu rol//ga ya dha ra khyod kyi bkra shis shog//srin po gzugasa'achang gdug pa 'dul//tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' yi//mtshan srung gza' bdud ra hu la//bka' srung bzhi yi bkra shis shog//sku gsung thugs ni chosakyidabyingasadang mnyam//'phrin lasamathar

phyin khyung chen klu sprul 'dul//drag tu bskul bas dgra bgegasadabang du sdud//sprul pa'i chosargyal sku lnga'i bkra shisashog//gang zhig yid ladran pa tsam gyisakyang //'dod pa'i dngos grub stsolab mjad pa yi//chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i bkra shisashog/bdag sogs bsam don malusa'agrub par mdzod//sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga sa/sgrub par mdzad pa'igangajag la//bu bzhin skyong ba zhal bgodapa'i//chosaskyong srung marnams kyi bkrashisashog//hrī/bla ma yi dam rnamasakyi bkra shis shog/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shisashog/chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shisashog/nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shisashog/mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog/yan lag drug stogasung gi bkra shisashog/mtha' braladri med thugasakyi

༄༅//bkra shisashog/rgyal ba'i skugasung thugs kyi bkra shis shog/gnas 'dir nyin rdzobade legasamatshan bde legs//nyin mo'igung yang bde legasashing //nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa//dkon mchog gsumagyi deng 'dir bde legs shog/de nas yigebargya pasalhanas khagang /ba0'a golarjodathos/stobasdubya'/༈rang gi thugasaka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phrosasnod bcud 'od du zhu/gzhal yasakhang lathim/gzhal yasakhang 'od du zhu/lha slobazhi la thim/lha mo bzhi 'od du luyum la thim/yum 'od du zhu/yab la thim/yab 'od du zhu thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/hūm̐ yig zhabasakyu la/de ha la/ha khogabol/khogaya mgo bo la/mgo bo zla tshes la/zla tshesathigale la/thig le nā da la thim zhing /nā da yang midamigasapa gyur//stong pa'i ngang lasarang nyid thun mtshams

kyi he ru 5sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyisardo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/g.yasabarkyang ba'i stabs kyisabazhugasapa'i gnas gsumayi ge gsum gyisamatshan par gyur /༈cha/zhes phyag rgya spyi bor bzhanapasalu byin gyi༄tsos/snya'aphyag rgya mas yos 'ganyisatsusprad pas ngag i gyisalhos/hūm̐/spyordo rje bsasaphogargyasnying kharasbyarabasayid byin gyisasas/'olhalha/hūm̐ satsā/zhesaphyag rgya dang 'don pa stor bzlog chabasa'ir bya'o//khabasngochomu rgyal posto dbang ra②zheganyisapadzisaraga' go' chogadu gyo༄4mid sgoyong posamajad pa la/7rgyapodabaparas g.yong /7rje chos kyi grags pa'i go phi 3 ra chagasasnga phyir mdzad khrug cing /'di ni 7rje bha dra'i tsos kyi dusanasad lta'i bar thub bstan yang ri sgar gyi chosagrwa r+pā por gsung rgyun ji lta ba bawo lasagayi gis i don gyi cha la bcos sbyang skru i med parasgag 'grosasu bkod pa'o//dge'o//

༄༅/ /slar smras pa/ srid pa'i mun pa las nyon stug po khrod/ /sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i yid can 'gro/ /gtan bde zhi ba'i go 'phang snyeg byed ni/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i 'od snang gcig tu nges/ /des na dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul kun gyi phul byung nyid/ /gsung mchog chos kyi sde snod 'di yin phyir/ /sngon bsags bsod nams dam pa'i dpal smin pa'i/ /dad ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal mtshan nas/ /gsung gcig du

mar 'phrul ba'i chos sbyin bgyis/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i snang ba mchog 'dis mtshon/ /'khor 'das dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dges/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu bde dgu'i dpal/ /yid can 'gro ba ma lus spyod byed cing / /bde nas bde bar bgrod pa'i lam zhugs te/ /mthar phyin mchog gi go 'phang myur 'grub tshadag /ces 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i chosasde chen po grub dbang sgrub brgyud dgon chen du/ sgrub brgyud shesarig nyamasagaso khang nas chosasbyin gyi phyi mo dpar gzhir bsgrigs pa'i

༄༅/ /dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal ba bzang / /longasaspyod rgya chen kun thob cing/ /zhi dang rgyasal sogasapa yi/ /las bzhi'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyisabadag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsal/ /dus min 'chi ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi

lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ye shes pa rnams rten dang dbyer med cing / /'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su bsdu/ /slar yang he ru ka yi sku ru ldang / /bkra shisashog/ //

༄༅/ /bstan 'bar ma bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang / shwakya thub pa go tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can don dubadag gis sngon/ /dka' ba gang zhig spyad gyur pa/ /bdag gi bde ba btang ba yis/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /ngas sngon nad pa'i chede dag tu/ /rang gi 'tsho ba yongs btang bas/ /sems can phongs pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang //nor dang glang chen shing rta dang / /rin chen byang chub phyir btang bas/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bdag gis sangs rgyasarang

sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos pha dang ma dang ni/ /drang srong dag la mchod byas pas/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bskal pa bye ba du mar bdag /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gyur cing / /byang chub don duthos btsal bas/ /bstan pa ldan ring 'bar gyur cig /bdag gis tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / /dka' thub yun ring bsten byas shing / /phyogs bcu'i sangasargyasangs mchod pas/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bdag sngon brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ /rtag tu brtan cing pha rol gnon/ /sems can thams cad bsgral don du / bdag bstan yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bzod brtul rtag tu bsten byas shing / /sems can nyon mongs snyigs ma yi/ /sems
rdzo ga spre mchi2 /sa / nga rir+sāchozu chus nya ci nerdzo la chob de ca4 tsho tsho pa ne(dz+ra 〉tsā
